title_zh: Reflexion：基于语言强化学习的语言智能体
one_line: Agent verbally reflects on binary/scalar task feedback after failed trials and appends reflections to a bounded episodic memory used in retries of the same task.
one_line_zh: 智能体对失败试次的任务反馈进行语言反思，把反思写入有界情景记忆，供同一任务重试时使用。

title_zh: ExpeL：大语言模型智能体是经验学习者
one_line: Agent gathers train-task trajectories, contrasts failures with successes into an insight list maintained by add/edit/upvote/downvote operations, and recalls insights plus successful trajectories on unseen tasks.
one_line_zh: 在训练任务上收集轨迹，对比成败提炼洞见并以增改投票维护，测试时调用洞见与成功轨迹。

title_zh: Think-in-Memory：回忆与事后思考赋予大语言模型长期记忆
one_line: LLM post-thinks after each conversation turn, storing relation-triple thoughts in an LSH-indexed memory organized by insert, forget and merge operations; no outcome signal drives updates.
one_line_zh: 每轮对话后事后思考，把关系三元组式想法存入LSH索引记忆，并以插入/遗忘/合并维护，无结果信号驱动。

title_zh: 想象国中的大语言模型：通过模拟试错进行工具学习
one_line: LLM imagines queries for each API, executes and self-reflects with short/long-term exploration memory, and keeps GPT-4-filtered tool-use examples as an ICL demonstration pool or fine-tuning data.
one_line_zh: LLM为API设想查询并执行、反思，借短/长期记忆探索，经GPT-4过滤的工具用例作为示例池或微调数据。

title_zh: 思维缓冲区：大语言模型的思维增强推理
one_line: A buffer-manager distills high-level thought-templates from solved problems into a meta-buffer that is retrieved and instantiated for new problems and dynamically updated as tasks are solved.
one_line_zh: 缓冲管理器从已解问题中提炼高层思维模板存入元缓冲区，新问题检索并实例化模板，随求解动态更新。

title_zh: 自我进化GPT：终身自主经验学习者
one_line: For each self-categorized task type, the LLM transfers experience from similar tasks, practices on web-grounded self-generated questions, contrasts correct and incorrect answers into task experience stored in memory.
one_line_zh: 按自生成任务类型，从相似任务迁移经验，在网页支撑的自生成题上练习，对比正误归纳经验存入记忆。

title_zh: 具备反思与记忆增强能力的自我进化智能体
one_line: Assistant agent refines outputs under a checker's feedback, stores self-reflections in long-term memory, and manages short/long-term memory with Ebbinghaus-curve retention thresholds.
one_line_zh: 助手智能体在检查者反馈下迭代改进，把自我反思存入长期记忆，并以艾宾浩斯遗忘曲线阈值管理长短期记忆。

title_zh: AutoDAN-Turbo：自主探索策略以越狱大语言模型的终身智能体
one_line: Attacker LLM explores jailbreaks scored by a scorer LLM; a summarizer contrasts lower- and higher-scoring attack pairs into strategies stored in a response-keyed library retrieved for later attacks.
one_line_zh: 攻击LLM在评分LLM打分下探索越狱，摘要器对比高低分攻击对提炼策略，存入以响应为键的策略库供后续检索。

title_zh: 大语言模型作为持续学习者：改进软件问题中缺陷代码的复现
one_line: A reflection LLM distills experience from issue-reproduction trajectories into a hierarchical pool of general and repository-specific entries maintained via add/remove/merge/endorse/modify actions.
one_line_zh: 反思LLM从问题复现轨迹中提炼经验，存入通用与仓库专属两层经验池，并以增删合并认可修改操作维护。

title_zh: AGrail：具备有效且自适应安全检测的终身智能体护栏
one_line: Analyzer and Executor LLMs retrieve, revise, merge, add and delete action-keyed safety checks in memory during test-time adaptation, invoking tools to validate checks before guarding agent actions.
one_line_zh: 分析器与执行器LLM在测试时适应中检索、修订、合并、增删以动作为键的安全检查，并调用工具验证后护栏智能体动作。

title_zh: Table-Critic：面向表格推理的协同批评与改进多智能体框架
one_line: Judge, Critic and Refiner agents iteratively correct table-reasoning chains; after a Judge-verified success a Curator adds distilled critique templates to a self-expanding error-type tree.
one_line_zh: 裁判、批评、改写智能体迭代修正表格推理链；裁判判定正确后，策展者把提炼的批评模板加入自扩展错误类型树。

title_zh: A-MEM：面向大语言模型智能体的智能体式记忆
one_line: Zettelkasten-style memory: each interaction becomes an LLM-annotated note linked to similar notes, and new notes trigger updates to neighbors' context, keywords and tags; no outcome signal.
one_line_zh: 卡片盒式记忆：每次交互生成LLM标注笔记并链接相似笔记，新笔记触发邻居描述、关键词与标签更新，无结果信号。

title_zh: MobileSteward：融合多个面向应用的智能体与自我进化以自动执行跨应用指令
one_line: A StewardAgent schedules app-specific StaffAgents and, after judged-successful executions, writes staff expertise and task guidelines into memories reused for later scheduling and execution.
one_line_zh: 管家智能体调度各应用专属员工智能体，判定成功后把员工专长与任务指南写入记忆，供后续调度与执行复用。

title_zh: MDTeamGPT：面向多学科团队医疗会诊的自我进化大语言模型多智能体框架
one_line: Multi-agent medical consultation where answers checked against ground truth are archived as correct-case summaries or error reflections in two knowledge bases retrieved for later cases.
one_line_zh: 多智能体医疗会诊，答案对照标准答案后分别以正确案例摘要或错误反思存入两个知识库，供后续病例检索。

title_zh: 动态备忘单：基于自适应记忆的测试时学习
one_line: A curator LLM self-assesses each test-time answer and rewrites a persistent cheatsheet of strategies and code snippets, adding, refining, pruning and consolidating entries without labels.
one_line_zh: 策展LLM在测试时自评每个答案，无标签地增补、修订、剪除并合并策略与代码片段，持续改写备忘单。

title_zh: Mem0：构建具备可扩展长期记忆的生产级AI智能体
one_line: An LLM extracts salient facts from each conversation turn and chooses ADD/UPDATE/DELETE/NOOP against similar stored memories (optionally a graph); no task-outcome signal drives the store.
one_line_zh: LLM从每轮对话抽取关键事实，对照相似记忆选择增/改/删/不变（可选图结构），存储不受任务结果信号驱动。

title_zh: 上下文经验回放：语言智能体的自我改进
one_line: Web agents distill environment dynamics and reusable skills from past (offline or online) trajectories into a buffer whose retrieved entries are replayed in context for new tasks.
one_line_zh: 网页智能体从离线或在线轨迹中提炼环境动态与可复用技能存入缓冲区，新任务时检索并在上下文中回放。

title_zh: 以人在回路指导使自我改进智能体在测试时学习
one_line: Agent self-assesses uncertainty via structured self-dialogue, queries human experts within a budget, and integrates their guidance into a timestamped knowledge repository with conflict detection and obsolescence marking.
one_line_zh: 智能体以结构化自我对话评估不确定性，在预算内向专家求助，把指导写入带时间戳并检测冲突、标记过时的知识库。

title_zh: MetaAgent：通过工具元学习迈向自我进化智能体
one_line: A minimal help-seeking agent routes requests to tools, distills self- and verified-reflection experience into context for later tasks, and indexes browsed content into a persistent in-house knowledge tool.
one_line_zh: 极简求助式智能体经路由调用工具，把自我反思与验证反思经验注入后续任务上下文，并将浏览内容建成持久内部知识工具。

title_zh: HealthFlow：面向自主医疗研究、具备元规划的自我进化AI智能体
one_line: Meta, executor, evaluator and reflector agents: after an evaluator-judged success, the reflector distills the trace, including corrected failures, into typed strategic experiences retrieved for future planning.
one_line_zh: 元规划、执行、评估、反思四智能体：评估判定成功后，反思者把含纠错的轨迹提炼为结构化策略经验供后续规划检索。

title_zh: 通过经验驱动的终身学习构建自我进化智能体：框架与基准
one_line: Proposes a conceptual experience-driven lifelong-learning framework (exploration, memory, skills, internalization) and the StuLife benchmark; experiments evaluate LLMs and hand-designed system prompts, not a self-modifying loop.
one_line_zh: 提出经验驱动终身学习概念框架与StuLife基准；实验评测LLM与人工设计的系统提示，而非自我修改闭环。

title_zh: ArcMemo：基于终身LLM记忆的抽象推理组合
one_line: Distills verified ARC solution traces into abstract, parameterized concept entries that revise existing concepts, and selects a relevant subset per new puzzle via reasoning-based retrieval.
one_line_zh: 把经验证的ARC解题轨迹提炼为抽象、参数化的概念条目并修订已有概念，新题时以推理式检索选取相关子集。

title_zh: PRINCIPLES：面向主动式对话智能体的合成策略记忆
one_line: Offline self-play with a critic reward: successful turns or failures repaired by backtracking revision become 'when X, do Y rather than Z' principles retrieved for strategy planning.
one_line_zh: 借评论模型奖励进行离线自我对弈，成功轮次或经回溯修正的失败被提炼为“当X时应Y而非Z”原则，供策略规划检索。

title_zh: ReasoningBank：以推理记忆扩展智能体自我进化
one_line: Agent distills strategy memory items from LLM-judged successes and failures on a test-time task stream, appends them, and uses parallel/sequential test-time scaling to supply contrastive signals.
one_line_zh: 智能体在测试时任务流上从LLM判定的成败中提炼策略记忆并追加，并借并行/串行测试时扩展提供对比信号。

title_zh: 免训练的组相对策略优化
one_line: For groups of rewarded rollouts with clear winners and losers, an LLM distills a natural-language 'semantic advantage' and applies add/delete/modify/keep operations to an experience library used as a token prior.
one_line_zh: 对有明显胜负的奖励化rollout组，LLM提炼自然语言“语义优势”，以增删改保操作更新经验库作为token先验。

title_zh: 模拟中的进化：具备双重记忆的AI智能体学校以实现高保真教育动态
one_line: Teacher and student agents in a simulated school write interaction records and derived insights into dual experience/knowledge bases with short/long-term tiers retrieved to drive role behavior.
one_line_zh: 模拟学校中的师生智能体把交互记录与衍生见解写入分长短期的经验/知识双库，并检索以驱动角色行为。

title_zh: 基于落地经验的自我抽象以实现计划引导的策略改进
one_line: A SWE agent's first rollout is abstracted into a concise plan that conditions a second attempt on the same task; nothing is retained across tasks.
one_line_zh: SWE智能体把首次rollout抽象为简洁计划，用于同一任务的第二次尝试；跨任务不保留任何内容。

title_zh: FLEX：基于经验前向学习的持续智能体进化
one_line: A frozen agent reflects on its successes and failures on training problems to grow a structured experience library, retrieved at test time and transferable across models.
one_line_zh: 冻结的智能体在训练题上反思成功与失败，构建结构化经验库，测试时检索使用，并可在模型间继承。

title_zh: MetaMem：通过自反思符号优化演化用于知识利用的元记忆
one_line: Reflects on judged-correct/incorrect sampled answers to ADD/DEL/MOD a meta-memory of memory-utilization experiences, built in mini-batches and reused at inference.
one_line_zh: 对经评判正误的采样回答进行反思，以增删改操作维护“如何利用记忆”的元记忆，并在推理时复用。

title_zh: AutoSkill：基于技能自进化的经验驱动终身学习
one_line: Extracts reusable SKILL.md artifacts from users' repeated requests, with a judge deciding add/merge/discard and versioned merges, then retrieves skills into later responses.
one_line_zh: 从用户反复提出的要求中抽取 SKILL.md 技能，由判定器决定新增/合并/丢弃并版本化合并，后续对话检索注入。

title_zh: SkillNet：创建、评估与连接 AI 技能
one_line: Infrastructure that mines skills from trajectories, repos and documents, filters them by multi-dimensional LLM evaluation and deduplication, and links them in a skill graph for agent reuse.
one_line_zh: 从轨迹、代码库和文档中挖掘技能，经多维评估与去重筛选后组织成技能图谱，供智能体检索复用。

title_zh: AutoAgent：面向自适应智能体的演化认知与弹性记忆编排
one_line: Agents revise prompt-level descriptions of tools, peers and skills by comparing intended actions with observed outcomes, alongside an elastic memory that compresses interaction history.
one_line_zh: 智能体比较预期行动与实际结果，修订关于工具、同伴与技能的提示级认知描述，并以弹性记忆压缩交互历史。

title_zh: MineEvolve：面向长时程具身 Minecraft 智能体的知识累积自进化
one_line: Converts typed execution feedback into skills (from successes) and remedies (from failures), validated and merged by a curator, then used to repair unfinished plans.
one_line_zh: 将类型化执行反馈转为技能（来自成功）与补救规则（来自失败），经策展器校验合并后用于修复未完成计划。

title_zh: VeriAgent：面向 PPA 感知 RTL 代码生成、具备演化记忆的工具集成多智能体系统
one_line: An EDA-tool-in-the-loop multi-agent RTL generator whose memory manager extracts trigger-guided optimization nodes from trajectories and inserts, refines or discards them.
one_line_zh: EDA 工具闭环的多智能体 RTL 生成系统，记忆管理器从执行轨迹中抽取带触发条件的优化经验节点，并决定插入、精炼或丢弃。

title_zh: 面向自我改进 LLM 智能体的经验反思学习
one_line: After each single attempt, the agent reflects on trajectory and binary outcome to write a trigger-conditioned heuristic; an LLM retrieves top heuristics into later tasks' prompts.
one_line_zh: 每次单次尝试后依据轨迹与成败结果反思生成带触发条件的启发式，后续任务由 LLM 检索相关启发式注入提示。

title_zh: 学会提交：通过在线仓库记忆生成“有机”的拉取请求
one_line: Agent blindly attempts historical commits, contrasts its patch with the oracle diff, and CRUD-updates a repository skill document used on chronologically later PRs.
one_line_zh: 智能体盲做历史提交任务，将自身补丁与真实 diff 对比反思，以增删改更新仓库技能文档，用于时间上更晚的 PR。

title_zh: EffiSkill：基于智能体技能的自动化代码效率优化
one_line: Mines operator and meta skills by contrasting slow/fast program pairs, clusters and merges them into a library, then retrieves and composes skills to optimize unseen programs.
one_line_zh: 对比慢/快程序对挖掘算子技能与元技能，聚类合并成技能库，再检索组合用于优化未见程序。

title_zh: SkillFoundry：从异构科学资源构建自进化的智能体技能库
one_line: Tree-guided loop mines scientific resources into executable skill packages, admits only those passing execution/system/synthetic tests, and merges or prunes the library by coverage.
one_line_zh: 以领域知识树引导从科学资源中挖掘可执行技能包，仅保留通过执行/系统/合成数据测试的技能，并按覆盖度合并或剪枝。

title_zh: Combee：为自我改进语言模型智能体扩展提示学习
one_line: Scaling layer for ACE/GEPA-style prompt learning: parallel-scan aggregation with duplicated, shuffled reflections and a dynamic batch-size controller keep playbook updates specific at high parallelism.
one_line_zh: 为 ACE/GEPA 类提示学习提供并行扩展层：并行扫描聚合、反思复制洗牌与动态批大小控制，使高并行下的 playbook 更新不丢失细节。

title_zh: SkillX：为智能体自动构建技能知识库
one_line: A strong agent's training rollouts are distilled into planning/functional/atomic skills, iteratively merged and schema-filtered, expanded by exploration, and plugged into weaker agents.
one_line_zh: 将强智能体训练轨迹蒸馏为规划/功能/原子三级技能，迭代合并并按工具模式过滤、通过探索扩展，再插入较弱智能体使用。

title_zh: PRIME：面向以用户为中心智能体、基于迭代记忆演化的免训练主动推理
one_line: Distills credit-assigned multi-turn trajectories into golden/warning/preference memories, evolved by mutation, generalization, crossover and pruning, retrieved to guide frozen user-facing agents.
one_line_zh: 基于回合级信用分配将多轮交互轨迹蒸馏为成功/警示/偏好三区记忆，经变异、泛化、交叉与剪枝演化，检索指导冻结智能体。

title_zh: SkillClaw：借助智能体演化器让技能集体进化
one_line: An agentic evolver reads pooled multi-user sessions per skill, refines or creates skills from contrasted successes and failures, and deploys only updates that win nightly execution validation.
one_line_zh: 智能体演化器按技能汇总多用户会话，对照成功与失败来精炼或新建技能，仅部署在夜间真实执行验证中胜出的更新。

title_zh: 基于长短期反思与优化的可进化机器人操作具身智能体
one_line: A VLM manipulation agent reflects on successes and localized failures to update long-term (general) and short-term (task) prompt memories, filtered for generality, deduplicated and capped.
one_line_zh: VLM 操作智能体针对成功与定位后的失败进行反思，更新长期（通用）与短期（任务）提示记忆，经通用性筛选、去冗余并限制条数。

title_zh: SpaceMind：面向自主在轨服务的模块化自进化具身视觉语言智能体框架
one_line: Modular VLM space-servicing agent with routed skill files; after each episode a reflection step writes gated, deduplicated learned skills injected into repeated runs of the same task group.
one_line_zh: 模块化 VLM 在轨服务智能体，技能文件动态路由；每轮结束后反思生成经质量门与去重的习得技能，注入同一任务组的后续回合。

title_zh: Evo-MedAgent：超越一次性诊断——会记忆、反思与改进的医学智能体
one_line: A chest X-ray agent, after ground truth is revealed per case, reflects to update episodic records, utility-tracked procedural rules via patch edits, and per-tool trust labels.
one_line_zh: 胸片诊断智能体在每例揭示真值后进行反思，更新情景记录、以补丁编辑维护带效用统计的程序规则，并记录工具可信度。

title_zh: 从程序性技能到策略基因：迈向经验驱动的测试时进化
one_line: Controlled study showing compact 'strategy gene' experience objects (keywords, strategy, AVOID warnings) beat documentation-style skill packages as test-time control and as carriers for accumulating failure history.
one_line_zh: 受控实验表明紧凑的“策略基因”（关键词、策略、AVOID 警示）作为测试时控制信号和失败经验累积载体均优于文档式技能包。

title_zh: 利用结果揭晓前信号构建未来预测智能体
one_line: Revisiting an unresolved forecasting question, the agent contrasts checkpoint notes to extract pre-resolution signals and applies bounded add/revise/deprecate patches to a typed question-local harness.
one_line_zh: 在多次重访同一未决预测问题时，比较各检查点笔记提取“揭晓前信号”，对类型化的问题级 harness 施加有界的增/改/弃补丁。

title_zh: 超越元推理：面向自我改进 LLM 推理的元认知巩固
one_line: Reasoner/Monitor/Controller traces are distilled per batch from best and worst instances into micro-lessons, then consolidated over a sliding window into role-specific meta-knowledge prompts.
one_line_zh: 将推理者/监控者/控制者的轨迹按批次从最好与最差实例中提炼为微经验，再经滑动窗口巩固为各角色的元知识提示。

title_zh: 通过观测上下文压缩实现高效终端智能体的自进化框架
one_line: Terminal agents learn structured observation-compression rules: added for uncovered outputs, replaced on over-compression complaints, and written to a confidence-ranked global pool only if reliably applied.
one_line_zh: 终端智能体自学结构化观测压缩规则：未覆盖输出时新增，遭遇过度压缩反馈时替换，仅可靠生效的规则写回按置信度排序的全局规则池。

title_zh: Forage V2：自主智能体组织中的知识演化与迁移
one_line: Evaluator and Planner agents each write post-mortem lessons into an append-only knowledge directory that seeds later runs, including weaker models, under enforced method isolation.
one_line_zh: 评估者与规划者智能体在每次运行后各自写下复盘经验，存入只追加的知识目录，供后续运行（含较弱模型）继承，并以物理隔离保证方法隔离。

title_zh: EvoAgent：融合技能学习与多智能体委派的可进化智能体框架
one_line: A foreign-trade agent that, between sessions, extracts or restructures multi-file skills from dialogue history and usage/success statistics, matched by keyword, embedding and LLM routing.
one_line_zh: 面向外贸场景的智能体，在会话间根据对话历史与使用/成功率统计抽取或重构多文件技能，并以关键词、向量与 LLM 三级匹配调用。

title_zh: 扁鹊：面向在线系统运维、支持灵活技能编排的智能体框架
one_line: O&M agents use LLM-generated, execution-validated Skills mapping events to data and knowledge; practitioner corrections refine Skills and are distilled into a deduplicated, pruned knowledge base.
one_line_zh: 运维智能体使用由 LLM 生成并经执行校验的技能来映射事件与所需数据/知识；工程师纠错同时精炼技能并沉淀为去重剪枝的知识库。

title_zh: Web2BigTable：面向互联网规模信息检索与抽取的双层多智能体 LLM 系统
one_line: A run-verify-reflect loop on 20 gold-labelled training queries grows orchestrator decomposition skills and worker execution skills, frozen for held-out web-to-table and deep-search evaluation.
one_line_zh: 在 20 条带标准表的训练查询上通过运行-验证-反思循环积累编排器分解技能与工作者执行技能，冻结后在留出的网页制表与深度搜索任务上评测。

title_zh: Ace-Skill：以优先级采样与聚类演化自举多模态智能体
one_line: Bootstraps multimodal agent knowledge by prioritizing under-mastered training samples via decayed Beta proficiency and storing merged, capped experiences and skill documents per semantic cluster.
one_line_zh: 以带衰减的 Beta 熟练度优先采样未掌握的训练样本，并按语义聚类分别存储经合并与限容的经验池和技能文档，自举多模态智能体。

title_zh: 通过定制化智能体推理赋能VLM进行小样本多模态时间序列分类
one_line: Generator-Reflector-Modifier refine an atomic bullet knowledge bank from labeled few-shot classification errors, then cautiously update it at test time via self-recheck and pseudo-labels.
one_line_zh: 生成-反思-修改三角色依据小样本分类对错原子化更新知识库，测试时再经自检和伪标签谨慎更新。

title_zh: Swarm Skills：面向协同工程的可移植、自演化多智能体系统规范
one_line: A portable multi-agent skill specification whose evolutions.json records are created from successful trajectories and patched from execution friction, curated by effectiveness/utilization/freshness scores.
one_line_zh: 可移植的多智能体技能规范：从成功轨迹创建技能、按执行摩擦打补丁，并用效果/使用/新鲜度评分筛选。

title_zh: Robo-Cortex：基于双粒度认知记忆与自主知识归纳的自演化具身智能体
one_line: An embodied navigator turns episode success/failure into guiding/cautionary principles and merged confidence-scored heuristics, retrieved into later planning; heuristics transfer from seen to unseen episodes.
one_line_zh: 具身导航智能体把成败回合提炼为指导/警示原则并合并成带置信度的启发式库，用于后续规划并迁移到未见场景。

title_zh: FlyRoute：基于数据飞轮的自演化智能体画像用于自适应任务路由
one_line: A router grows per-agent success stores from LLM-judge-gated routed traffic, periodically distills them into capability descriptions, and explores under-profiled agents by uncertainty.
one_line_zh: 路由器用LLM评审门控的成功交互扩充各智能体成功库，定期蒸馏为能力描述，并按不确定性探索画像不足的智能体。

title_zh: DeliCIR：面向组合图像检索的多智能体协作记忆引导测试时深思
one_line: Offline, group-contrasted reasoning rollouts on a constructed CIR experience set yield 'semantic advantage' guidelines, condensed into a frozen library that guides tournament-style test-time reranking.
one_line_zh: 离线在构造的经验集上组内对比推理rollout提炼“语义优势”，压缩为固定经验库，指导锦标赛式测试时重排。

title_zh: 检索即推理：基于LLM-Wiki的自演化智能体原生检索
one_line: Compiles documents into a linked Wiki; an Error Book turns validator-detected compilation errors into root-caused constraint rules injected into later compilation batches, with periodic repair and closure.
one_line_zh: 把文档编译成互链Wiki；错误簿把校验器发现的编译错误归因为约束规则注入后续批次，并定期修复与关闭条目。

title_zh: MUSE-Autoskill：通过技能创建、记忆、管理与评估实现自演化智能体
one_line: An agent creates skill packages in its runtime loop, gates registration on generated unit tests or sandbox checks, keeps per-skill memory, and refines, merges or prunes skills.
one_line_zh: 智能体在运行循环中创建技能包，以生成的单元测试或沙箱检查门控注册，维护技能级记忆并精炼、合并、剪枝。

title_zh: ESC-Skills：面向情感支持对话的技能发现与自演化
one_line: Induces SKILL.md emotional-support skills from state-action-outcome units of successful and failed dialogues, then refines and adds skills from simulated-seeker traces under simulation-based verification.
one_line_zh: 从成功与失败对话的状态-动作-结果单元归纳情感支持技能，再依据模拟求助者交互轨迹修订、新增技能并经仿真验证。

title_zh: 越用越好：用于循证健康社区注释的自演化LLM智能体
one_line: A note-writing agent has an LLM utility judge grade each trajectory, and an evolver distills phase-tagged trigger/strategy memories retrieved for later posts in the stream.
one_line_zh: 注释生成智能体由LLM效用评审为每条轨迹打分，演化器提炼分阶段的触发-策略记忆供后续帖子检索。

title_zh: PhotoCraft：面向深度图像搜索的分层自演化记忆智能体推理
one_line: A photo-search agent distills trajectories whose F1 exceeds a threshold into de-entitified skill entries, merged by query similarity and retrieved as hints for later queries.
one_line_zh: 照片搜索智能体把F1超过阈值的轨迹提炼为去实体化技能条目，按查询相似度合并，并作为提示供后续查询检索。

title_zh: FederatedSkill：面向智能体技能演化的联邦学习
one_line: Clients reflect on verified trajectories into add/edit/delete skill patches; a server agent tracks a capability matrix and memory to merge and personalize each client's library.
one_line_zh: 各客户端依据验证奖励把轨迹反思成技能增删改补丁，服务器智能体维护能力矩阵与记忆，为每个客户端合并并个性化技能库。

title_zh: EpiEvolve：面向体制转移下流式疫情预测的自演化智能体
one_line: A frozen LLM forecaster stores delayed-label outcomes with reflections in hierarchical episodic memory, distills confidence-tracked predicate rules, and uses drift-aware retrieval in a chronological stream.
one_line_zh: 冻结的LLM预测器在按时间流式评测中，把延迟标签结果与反思存入分层情景记忆，提炼带置信度的谓词规则，并做漂移感知检索。

title_zh: Skill-3D：面向智能体3D空间推理的场景感知技能演化
one_line: On training splits, a skill manager distills successful scene-specific tool-use trajectories into scene-aware skills, attaches failures as lessons, gates merges, then freezes the library for testing.
one_line_zh: 在训练集上，技能管理器把成功的场景工具使用轨迹提炼为场景感知技能、把失败附为教训并门控合并，测试时冻结技能库。

title_zh: TabClaw：面向表格操作与表格推理的交互式自演化智能体
one_line: An interactive spreadsheet agent records completed workflows, distills recurring tool sequences into user-approved skills, keeps preference memory, and revises skills that draw negative user feedback.
one_line_zh: 交互式表格智能体记录完成的工作流，把重复工具序列提炼为经用户批准的技能，保存偏好记忆，并依据负反馈修订技能。

title_zh: ProPlay：面向自演化LLM智能体的程序性世界模型
one_line: Induces procedures from reward-productive trajectory prefixes into a merged procedure graph with reward-weighted transition reliability records, used to preplay a soft plan before each episode.
one_line_zh: 从获得奖励的轨迹前缀归纳程序并合并入程序图，转移带按奖励加权的可靠性记录，每回合前据此预演软性计划。

title_zh: KBSpec：基于演化领域知识库的LLM形式化规约生成
one_line: A JML knowledge base seeded from docs is evolved on a training corpus by adding verifier-passing generation/repair trajectories and scoring items by counterfactual helpfulness to prune unhelpful ones.
one_line_zh: 以官方文档初始化JML知识库，在训练集上加入通过验证器的生成/修复轨迹，并按有无该知识的反事实效果打分剔除无用条目。

title_zh: QueenBee Planner：面向高token效率LLM多智能体系统的技能演化通信拓扑
one_line: With frozen workers, a planner generates communication DAGs and distills traces into Preserve/Modify/Avoid design rules admitted only through held-out, variance-aware gates with deduplication.
one_line_zh: 工人智能体冻结，规划器生成通信DAG，并把执行轨迹提炼为保留/修改/避免设计规则，仅经留出、方差感知门控与去重后入库。

title_zh: ManimAgent：面向可视化教育的自演化多模态智能体
one_line: A Manim-coding agent writes VLM-gated success rationales and validated failure-to-success lessons into a dual-channel memory, frozen and evaluated read-only on disjoint probe tasks.
one_line_zh: Manim代码智能体把经VLM门控的成功理由与失败到成功的教训写入双通道记忆，冻结后在不相交探针任务上只读评测。

title_zh: 面向LLM智能体规划的自演化世界模型
one_line: A frozen LLM world model accumulates executed transitions online and turns prediction-observation mismatches into evidence-scored rules, exposing only confident foresight to a frozen agent.
one_line_zh: 冻结的LLM世界模型在线积累已执行的转移，把预测与观测不符之处转为带证据分的规则，只向冻结智能体提供高置信预见。

title_zh: ISM：面向持续数学推理的自我改进策略记忆
one_line: A frozen math solver uses a schema bank whose content and retrieval hooks are maintained by audit, correct, merge, prune, reinforce and antipattern mechanisms, each gated by symbolic verification.
one_line_zh: 冻结的数学求解器使用策略模式库，其内容与检索钩子由审计、修正、合并、剪枝、强化与反模式机制维护，均经符号验证门控。

title_zh: 通过累积行为规则自我改进的AI编码智能体：一个闭环框架
one_line: Each accepted human code-review comment that names a recurring mistake class becomes a rule in a version-controlled instruction file and self-review checklist loaded in later sessions.
one_line_zh: 每条被接受且指出可复发错误类别的人工代码评审意见被写成规则，存入版本控制的指令文件与自查清单，供后续会话加载。

title_zh: 为编码智能体学习全局可复用技能
one_line: From failure traces a coding agent proposes DSL skill edits aware of a Skill Relation Graph, clusters locally replay-validated proposals into general skills, and replay-verifies against regressions before merging.
one_line_zh: 编码智能体从失败轨迹提出感知技能关系图的DSL技能编辑，把局部回放验证通过的提案聚类为通用技能，合并前再回放防回归。

title_zh: SkillForge：面向项目特定问题修复的自蒸馏智能体
one_line: Before real issues arrive, an SWE agent solves test-grounded synthetic issues made by masked re-implementation of repo code, distilling entity-linked global and local skills injected on file access.
one_line_zh: 在真实问题到来前，SWE智能体求解由遮蔽重写仓库代码生成、以测试为依据的合成问题，蒸馏出与代码实体关联的全局与局部技能。

title_zh: ForeDreamer：面向未来事件预测的自演化双智能体记忆架构
one_line: A forecasting agent evolves a textual experience bank and a tree of evidence-processing guides and tools from resolved rollouts, admitting edits only when a small validation pool improves.
one_line_zh: 预测智能体依据已结算的rollout演化文本经验库及证据处理指南与工具树，仅当小验证池成绩提升时才接纳改动。

title_zh: PILOT in the Loop：长程智能体的实时自我改进
one_line: A supervisor steers a live worker and records skills and memory mid-run; across benchmark sweeps, only updates from verifier-passing runs are merged into the shared harness.
one_line_zh: 监督者实时引导工作智能体并在运行中记录技能与记忆；多轮基准遍历中仅把验证通过运行的更新合并进共享harness。

title_zh: RSIAgent：面向新环境递归自我改进的自主探索
one_line: Curriculum, actor and verifier agents explore a new software environment broad-then-deep, consolidating verifier-approved causal knowledge into memory that is frozen for target tasks.
one_line_zh: 课程、执行与验证三智能体先广后深地探索新软件环境，把验证通过的因果知识整合进记忆，冻结后用于目标任务。

title_zh: TEMPERA：基于强化学习的测试时提示编辑
one_line: Trains a PPO prompt-editing policy that edits instructions, exemplars and verbalizers per query, rewarded by score difference before vs after each edit.
one_line_zh: 用PPO训练逐查询编辑提示（指令、示例、verbalizer）的策略，以编辑前后得分差作为奖励。

title_zh: Retroformer：基于策略梯度优化的回顾式大语言模型智能体
one_line: Fine-tunes a local reflection model with policy gradient, rewarded by the frozen actor's return improvement between consecutive trials after appending its reflections to the prompt.
one_line_zh: 用策略梯度微调本地反思模型，奖励为冻结执行者在追加反思后相邻两次尝试的回报提升。

title_zh: AutoFlow：面向大语言模型智能体的自动工作流生成
one_line: A generator LLM writes natural-language workflows, a frozen interpreter executes them, and the generator is updated by REINFORCE (or in-context) on average task score.
one_line_zh: 生成器LLM写自然语言工作流，冻结解释器执行，以平均任务得分用REINFORCE或上下文方式更新生成器。

title_zh: 大语言模型能否发明改进自身的算法？：通过强化学习进行递归自我改进的算法发现
one_line: An algorithm-factory LLM generates model-merging code, merged models are scored on a dev set, and the factory is DPO-trained on top-vs-bottom algorithms over iterations.
one_line_zh: 算法工厂LLM生成模型合并代码，在开发集上评分，并以高低分算法对进行DPO迭代训练工厂。

title_zh: 基于智能体超网的多智能体架构搜索
one_line: Trains a query-conditioned controller over an agentic supernet with cost-aware Monte Carlo gradients while textual gradients jointly edit operator prompts and structure.
one_line_zh: 用成本感知的蒙特卡洛梯度训练基于查询的超网控制器，同时用文本梯度联合修改算子提示与结构。

title_zh: ScoreFlow：基于得分偏好优化的LLM智能体工作流掌控
one_line: An 8B generator writes a per-problem code workflow; executed scores form preference pairs, and the generator is fine-tuned with score-weighted Score-DPO over iterations.
one_line_zh: 8B生成器为每个问题写代码工作流，执行得分构成偏好对，用按分差加权的Score-DPO迭代微调生成器。

title_zh: MAS-GPT：训练大语言模型构建基于LLM的多智能体系统
one_line: Builds consistency-filtered query-to-MAS-code pairs from executing a pool of multi-agent systems, then SFT-trains a 32B LLM to emit a query-specific MAS in one pass.
one_line_zh: 执行多智能体系统池构造一致性筛选的查询-MAS代码对，再监督微调32B模型一次生成查询专属MAS。

title_zh: 面向多智能体通信的自适应图剪枝
one_line: Collects top-scoring sampled agent sub-graphs per task, then trains a GCN to output per-query agent masks and edge weights in one forward pass.
one_line_zh: 收集各任务得分最高的智能体子图作监督，训练GCN一次前向输出查询相关的智能体掩码与边权。

title_zh: Memory-R1：通过强化学习增强大语言模型智能体的记忆管理与利用
one_line: RL-trains a Memory Manager choosing ADD/UPDATE/DELETE/NOOP, rewarded by a frozen answer agent's correctness on the updated bank, plus an RL-trained memory-filtering Answer Agent.
one_line_zh: 用强化学习训练选择增删改的记忆管理器，以冻结回答代理在更新后记忆上的正确率为奖励，并训练筛选记忆的回答代理。

title_zh: Mem-α：通过强化学习学习记忆构建
one_line: GRPO-trains a memory-writing agent over core/episodic/semantic memory tools, rewarded by frozen-RAG QA accuracy plus format, compression and LLM-judged content-validity terms.
one_line_zh: 用GRPO训练写入核心/情景/语义记忆的智能体，奖励为冻结RAG问答正确率加格式、压缩与内容有效性项。

title_zh: 面向带技能库自我改进智能体的强化学习
one_line: GRPO-trains one agent over two-task chains so skills it writes on task one are rewarded when reused successfully on task two, accumulating a code-function skill library.
one_line_zh: 在两任务链上用GRPO训练同一智能体，前一任务生成的技能在后一任务被成功复用时获得奖励，积累代码技能库。

title_zh: Agentic Memory：为大语言模型智能体学习统一的长期与短期记忆管理
one_line: Exposes long- and short-term memory operations as tools in the agent's policy and trains them with three-stage step-wise GRPO, broadcasting the final task reward to earlier memory actions.
one_line_zh: 把长短期记忆操作作为工具纳入智能体策略，用三阶段逐步GRPO训练，将最终任务奖励回传到早期记忆动作。

title_zh: ARISE：分层强化学习中基于内在技能演化的智能体推理
one_line: One GRPO-trained policy selects skills by log-probability, solves math problems, and summarizes successful traces into a two-tier skill library, with a bonus for correct skill-augmented solutions.
one_line_zh: 单一GRPO策略按对数概率选技能、解数学题并把成功轨迹总结进两级技能库，对借助技能的正确解给予额外奖励。

title_zh: 学会自我演化
one_line: RL-trains a 4B model to rewrite an instruction field from batch feedback, rewarded by holdout accuracy improvement over the pre-edit context; UCB tree search composes edits at test time.
one_line_zh: 用强化学习训练4B模型依据批次反馈改写指令字段，奖励为相对改写前的留出集准确率提升，测试时用UCB树搜索组合编辑。

title_zh: SEARL：面向自演化智能体的策略与工具图记忆联合优化
one_line: Jointly RL-trains a small agent policy and a growing MCP tool graph, registering highest-reward created tools and assigning step advantages grouped by shared tool anchors.
one_line_zh: 联合强化训练小模型智能体策略与不断增长的MCP工具图，登记高奖励新工具并按共享工具锚点分组计算步级优势。

title_zh: 通过世界知识探索训练LLM智能体实现自发、无奖励的自我演化
one_line: Trains a web agent (SFT then rejection sampling) to explore a site and write a world-knowledge document, rewarded by downstream task success gain over the no-knowledge baseline.
one_line_zh: 先监督微调再拒绝采样训练网页智能体探索站点并撰写世界知识文档，奖励为相对无知识基线的下游任务成功率增益。

title_zh: 面向长时程任务的LLM决策智能体与技能库智能体协同演化
one_line: A GRPO-trained skill-bank agent segments rollouts into contract-bearing skills and curates the bank, while a co-trained decision agent retrieves and executes them in games.
one_line_zh: GRPO训练的技能库智能体把轨迹切分为带效果契约的技能并维护技能库，协同训练的决策智能体在游戏中检索执行。

title_zh: SkillOS：为自演化智能体学习技能整理
one_line: GRPO-trains a skill curator that edits a Markdown SkillRepo after each task in related-task streams, rewarded by a frozen executor's later-task success plus validity, compression and quality terms.
one_line_zh: 在相关任务流上用GRPO训练技能整理器逐任务编辑Markdown技能库，奖励为冻结执行器后续任务成功率加有效性、压缩与质量项。

title_zh: Evolving-RL：智能体内经验驱动自演化能力的端到端优化
one_line: One shared policy extracts textual skills from source trajectories, rewarded by mean success when the solver uses them on retrieved related tasks; solver trajectories train utilization jointly.
one_line_zh: 共享策略从源轨迹提取文本技能，以求解器在检索到的相关任务上使用技能的平均成功率为奖励，并联合训练技能利用。

title_zh: SAGE：面向结构感知联想记忆的自演化智能体图记忆引擎
one_line: A GRPO-trained graph-memory writer is rewarded by how well a graph-foundation-model reader recovers answer evidence from its graph, with the reader recalibrated to each evolving graph.
one_line_zh: GRPO训练图记忆写入器，奖励为图基础模型读取器从其图中恢复答案证据的效果，读取器随演化图重新校准。

title_zh: 基于强化学习的LLM代码生成提示优化
one_line: A PPO controller picks among keep, genetic lexical mutation, and semantic rewriting of a task prompt for frozen code models, rewarded by shaped unit-test pass ratio.
one_line_zh: PPO控制器为冻结代码模型在保留、遗传词汇变异与语义改写之间选择提示变换，以单元测试通过率塑形奖励。

title_zh: CODESKILL：为编码智能体学习自演化技能
one_line: GRPO-trains a 4B skill manager that extracts, evolves and maintains coding skills, rewarded by rubric quality plus frozen agent's verifier gain over no-skill, gated by skill-use alignment.
one_line_zh: GRPO训练4B技能管理器提取、演化并维护编码技能，奖励为评分细则质量加冻结代理相对无技能的验证增益并按技能遵循度加权。

title_zh: ExpHarness：通过可训练框架实现模型无关的经验学习
one_line: PPO-trains a retrieval copilot choosing graph-diffusion and utility-weight controls over a skill/lesson experience graph whose utility estimates update from with-vs-without-experience score feedback.
one_line_zh: PPO训练检索副驾驶在技能/教训经验图上选择扩散与效用权重控制，图条目效用由有无经验得分差反馈更新。

title_zh: SkillComposer：学习演化智能体技能以兼顾特化与泛化
one_line: SFT-trains a 4B composer on rejection-sampled create/merge/improve skill operations kept only when they raise executor pass rate; libraries evolve offline, online or hybrid at inference.
one_line_zh: 用按执行器通过率增益筛选的创建/合并/改进技能操作数据监督微调4B组合器，推理时离线、在线或混合演化技能库。

title_zh: daVinci-kernel：通过强化学习协同演化GPU内核优化中的技能选择、总结与利用
one_line: One shared LLM is RL-trained as skill selector, kernel-writing policy and skill summarizer; summarized skills enter the library only after re-execution verifies a first-turn speedup gain.
one_line_zh: 共享LLM经强化学习同时充当技能选择、内核编写与技能总结代理，新技能须经重新执行验证首轮加速提升后才入库。

title_zh: OPD-Evolver：通过在策略蒸馏培养整体式智能体演化器
one_line: One policy selects, uses, writes and maintains a four-tier memory online; outcome-calibrated memory attribution feeds a privileged hindsight teacher whose on-policy distillation trains all four abilities.
one_line_zh: 单一策略在线选择、使用、写入并维护四级记忆，结果校准的记忆归因构成特权后见教师，经在策略蒸馏训练四项能力。

title_zh: SkillRise：面向跨任务技能演化的智能体强化学习
one_line: One RL policy alternates solving related tasks and rewriting a carried skill document; solving gets the current reward, curation gets discounted later-task rewards.
one_line_zh: 单一RL策略在相关任务间交替求解与改写传递的技能文档，求解获当前奖励，整理获后续任务的折扣奖励。

title_zh: Harness-R1：从智能体失败轨迹学习编辑可执行运行时框架
one_line: A 9B harness engineer, SFT then GRPO-trained, turns a frozen agent's failure packets into validated lifecycle-hook patches, rewarded by the same-batch success change after rerun.
one_line_zh: 9B框架工程师经监督微调与GRPO训练，把冻结智能体的失败包转为经验证的生命周期钩子补丁，奖励为重跑同批任务的成功率变化。

title_zh: 基于“梯度下降”与束搜索的自动提示优化
one_line: Rewrites a task prompt from LLM-written textual gradients over minibatch errors, keeping candidates via beam search with bandit best-arm selection.
one_line_zh: 用LLM对小批量错误生成文本梯度改写提示，通过束搜索与赌博机最优臂选择保留候选。

title_zh: PromptAgent：基于语言模型的策略规划实现专家级提示优化
one_line: Refines a task prompt from LLM reflections on base-model errors, searching rewrite paths with MCTS and keeping the highest-reward prompt on a held-out reward split.
one_line_zh: 让LLM反思基础模型错误来改写提示，用蒙特卡洛树搜索规划改写路径，按留出奖励集保留最高分提示。

title_zh: EASYTOOL：用简洁的工具说明增强基于LLM的智能体
one_line: One-pass LLM rewriting of tool documentation into concise unified tool instructions with execution-checked usage examples; no feedback loop or iterative retention.
one_line_zh: 用LLM一次性将工具文档改写为简洁统一的工具说明并以执行校验示例；无反馈闭环或迭代留存。

title_zh: 多步任务中的提示优化（PROMST）：融合人类反馈与启发式采样
one_line: Evolves agent prompts for multi-step tasks from rule-based human-designed error feedback summarized by an LLM, filtering candidates with an online-learned score predictor.
one_line_zh: 针对多步任务，用人类设计的规则反馈经LLM汇总来改写智能体提示，并用在线学习的分数预测器筛选候选。

title_zh: Agent-Pro：通过策略级反思与优化学习进化
one_line: Game agent reflects on lost trajectories and beliefs, rewrites behavioral-guideline and world-model prompt instructions, keeping them only if replayed score improves, via DFS policy search.
one_line_zh: 博弈智能体反思失败轨迹与信念，改写行为准则与世界建模提示指令，仅当重放得分提升时保留，并用深度优先搜索演化策略。

title_zh: 基于LLM的自我改进式客户评论回复生成
one_line: Customer-review responder iteratively rewrites its generation prompt from LLM-as-a-Judge scores and suggestions on lowest-scoring training reviews, keeping the highest-scoring prompt.
one_line_zh: 客户评论回复系统依据LLM评审对低分训练评论给出的分数与建议迭代改写生成提示，保留得分最高的提示。

title_zh: TextGrad：通过文本进行自动“微分”
one_line: Backpropagates LLM-written textual feedback through a computation graph of a compound system to update prompts, code or solutions via textual gradient descent.
one_line_zh: 在复合AI系统的计算图中反向传播LLM生成的文本反馈，以文本梯度下降更新提示、代码或解答等变量。

title_zh: Trace是下一代自动微分：基于丰富反馈、执行轨迹与LLM的生成式优化
one_line: Records workflow execution traces as a graph and lets an LLM optimizer update heterogeneous parameters (prompts, code) from output feedback over the minimal subgraph.
one_line_zh: 将工作流执行轨迹记录为计算图，让LLM优化器依据输出反馈在最小子图上更新提示与代码等异构参数。

title_zh: 符号学习使智能体能够自我进化
one_line: Back-propagates LLM language loss and per-node language gradients along an agent trajectory to update prompts, tools and pipeline, rolling back when language-loss performance drops.
one_line_zh: 沿智能体轨迹反向传播LLM语言损失与逐节点语言梯度来更新提示、工具与流水线，语言损失评估变差时回滚。

title_zh: GRAD-SUM：利用梯度汇总实现最优提示工程
one_line: Rewrites a prompt from LLM-judge critiques of failed generations, summarizing per-example gradients into one general critique, with UCB-pruned beam retaining the best prompt.
one_line_zh: 依据LLM评审对失败生成的批评改写提示，将逐样本梯度汇总为一段通用批评，并用UCB剪枝的束搜索保留最佳提示。

title_zh: 从对比提示中学习：自动化提示优化与适配
one_line: Generates prompt candidates from summarized failure reasons, then has an LLM contrast top- and bottom-scoring candidates to write a new prompt; also adapts prompts across models.
one_line_zh: 由汇总的失败原因生成候选提示，再让LLM对比高分与低分候选写出新提示，并用于跨模型与跨语言的提示适配。

title_zh: CriSPO：面向文本生成的多方面批评-建议引导自动提示优化
one_line: OPRO-style prompt optimizer enriched with LLM multi-aspect critiques and suggestions comparing outputs to references, plus suffix-only tuning to add metrics without regressing earlier ones.
one_line_zh: 在OPRO式提示优化器中加入LLM对输出与参考的多方面批评与建议，并通过只调后缀来增加新指标而不损害原指标。

title_zh: 从探索到精通：让LLM通过自驱交互掌握工具
one_line: Iteratively rewrites each tool's documentation from LLM-generated exploratory tool calls, their outputs and analyzer suggestions, stopping per tool when successive versions converge.
one_line_zh: 依据LLM自生成的探索性工具调用、返回结果与分析器建议迭代改写每个工具的文档，前后版本收敛时按工具停止。

title_zh: StraGo：利用策略引导进行提示优化
one_line: Rewrites a prompt from LLM analyses of both successful and failed cases turned into scored step-by-step strategies, crossing over and keeping top validation prompts.
one_line_zh: 让LLM同时分析成功与失败案例并生成经打分的分步策略来改写提示，通过交叉与验证集最优缓存保留提示。

title_zh: 面向软件开发的自进化多智能体协作网络
one_line: Per task at test time, compiles code against agent-generated unit tests and textually back-propagates feedback to revise, remove or add coding agents and their workflow.
one_line_zh: 在测试时针对每个任务，用智能体生成的单元测试检验代码，并以文本反向传播修改、删除或新增编码智能体及其工作流。

title_zh: REVOLVE：通过追踪文本优化中的响应演化来优化AI系统
one_line: Extends TextGrad by adding an LLM-judged similarity of responses across iterations to the textual gradient; prompt updates kept only when validation accuracy improves.
one_line_zh: 在TextGrad基础上，把LLM评估的跨迭代响应相似度加入文本梯度；仅当验证准确率提升时才保留提示更新。

title_zh: 如何在基于语言的智能体系统上正确进行语义反向传播
one_line: Semantic backpropagation computes neighbor-conditioned LLM gradients for each node prompt of an agentic graph; updates are accepted only if they beat current prompts on validation.
one_line_zh: 语义反向传播为智能体图中每个节点提示计算考虑邻居节点的LLM梯度；仅当新提示在验证集上优于当前提示时才接受更新。

title_zh: 提升高效多模态大模型的私域理解：免调参、自适应、通用的提示优化框架
one_line: Optimizes prompts for small multimodal models on private-domain tasks via epsilon-greedy search over human strategies with cross-task reward memory, then reflection on clustered error cases.
one_line_zh: 为小型多模态模型的私域任务优化提示：先以ε贪心在人类策略池上搜索并跨任务记忆奖励，再基于错误分布与典型错例反思改写。

title_zh: 提示炼金术士：面向测试用例生成的自动化LLM定制提示优化
one_line: Optimizes test-generation prompts per LLM via diversity-guided rewriting plus rules induced from DBSCAN-clustered test failures, each rule validated on a small development set.
one_line_zh: 为不同LLM优化测试用例生成提示：多样性引导改写，并从DBSCAN聚类的失败测试中归纳规则，在小开发集上验证后加入。

title_zh: 自监督提示优化
one_line: Reference-free prompt optimization: an LLM rewrites the current best prompt from its outputs on three samples, and an LLM pairwise judge keeps whichever prompt's outputs are better.
one_line_zh: 无参考提示优化：LLM依据当前最佳提示在三个样本上的输出改写提示，LLM成对评判保留输出更优的提示。

title_zh: PLAY2PROMPT：通过工具试玩实现LLM智能体的零样本工具说明优化
one_line: Plays with each tool to generate hard tool-use examples by trial and error, then beam-searches reflection-driven documentation rewrites scored on those self-generated examples.
one_line_zh: 通过试错调用每个工具生成困难的工具使用示例，再以这些自生成示例为验证集，束搜索基于反思的工具文档改写。

title_zh: 利用视觉语言评判器自我进化的视觉概念库
one_line: Evolves a concept library for concept-bottleneck classifiers: VLM scores reveal confused class pairs, and an LLM conditioned on concept history adds disambiguating concepts.
one_line_zh: 为概念瓶颈分类器演化概念库：由VLM得分找出易混淆类别对，LLM结合概念与反馈历史补充区分性概念。

title_zh: 通过基于采样的动量扩展文本梯度
one_line: Studies data scaling in textual gradient descent and adds momentum: new prompts are sampled from a mixture over past top prompts weighted by minibatch validation accuracy.
one_line_zh: 研究文本梯度下降的数据扩展问题并引入动量：按小批量验证准确率加权，从历史高分提示的混合分布中采样新提示。

title_zh: 变革的智能体：用于战略规划的自进化LLM智能体
one_line: Multi-agent system first induces a Catanatron API adapter file, then iteratively rewrites a compiled Catan player from analyst diagnosis of games against AlphaBeta, archiving past players.
one_line_zh: 多智能体系统先归纳卡坦岛环境的API适配文件，再依据分析者对与AlphaBeta对局的诊断迭代改写可执行玩家代码，并存档历史玩家。

title_zh: PersonaAgent：连接记忆与行动的个性化LLM智能体
one_line: Personalized agent whose per-user persona system prompt is optimized at test time by textual gradients on simulated recent interactions against the user's ground-truth responses.
one_line_zh: 个性化智能体：在测试时以文本梯度优化每个用户的人设系统提示，使其在模拟近期交互上的回复逼近用户真实回复。

title_zh: 以生成式代码优化学习游戏智能体
one_line: Represents Atari policies as modular Python functions and refines them with Trace/OptoPrime from rollout execution traces plus staged natural-language feedback on evaluation reward.
one_line_zh: 将Atari策略表示为模块化Python函数，利用Trace/OptoPrime依据rollout执行轨迹与基于评估奖励的分阶段自然语言反馈改写代码。

title_zh: 如何为领域任务自动优化提示？基于进化式领域知识适配的自适应提示与推理
one_line: Co-optimizes a system prompt and an expert-seeded semantic causal graph via causal-guided textual gradients, accepting each component's update only when it individually improves performance.
one_line_zh: 以因果引导的文本梯度协同优化系统提示与专家初始化的语义因果图，各组件仅在单独带来性能提升时才接受更新。

title_zh: 孔子代码智能体：面向真实代码库的可扩展智能体脚手架
one_line: A meta-agent refines a coding agent's prompts and tool-use extensions via build-test-improve, while a note-taker persists cross-session hindsight notes.
one_line_zh: 元智能体通过构建-测试-改进循环优化编码智能体的提示与工具扩展，并用笔记智能体留存跨会话经验。

title_zh: ReCreate：由经验驱动的领域智能体推理与创建
one_line: An optimizer agent inspects stored trajectories, logs and sandbox state to edit a task agent's prompts, tools, workflows and memory, consolidating instance fixes into domain-level updates.
one_line_zh: 优化智能体检查轨迹、日志与环境状态，编辑任务智能体的提示、工具、流程和记忆，并把实例级修改汇总为领域级更新。

title_zh: EvoSkill：面向多智能体系统的自动技能发现
one_line: A proposer analyzes failure traces with ground truth to create or edit skill folders; candidates enter a Pareto frontier only if they beat validation scores.
one_line_zh: 提议者结合真值分析失败轨迹以新建或修改技能文件夹，候选仅在验证分数更优时进入帕累托前沿。

title_zh: 超越标量奖励：序贯社会困境中LLM策略合成的稠密反馈
one_line: An LLM iteratively rewrites a code policy for social-dilemma games from self-play feedback, comparing scalar reward against reward plus social metrics.
one_line_zh: LLM依据自博弈反馈迭代重写社会困境博弈的代码策略，比较仅标量奖励与加入社会指标的稠密反馈。

title_zh: Polaris：基于经验抽象策略修复的小语言模型哥德尔智能体框架
one_line: A small-model Gödel agent abstracts validation failures into repair strategies and applies minimal code patches to its own policy, checked only syntactically.
one_line_zh: 小模型哥德尔智能体把验证集失败抽象为修复策略，并以最小代码补丁更新自身策略，仅做语法与执行检查。

title_zh: Meta-Harness：模型框架（harness）的端到端优化
one_line: A coding-agent proposer reads all prior harnesses' source, scores and raw traces via a filesystem to write new harness code, keeping a Pareto frontier on a search set.
one_line_zh: 编码智能体提议者通过文件系统读取所有历史harness的代码、分数和原始轨迹来编写新harness，在搜索集上保留帕累托前沿。

title_zh: 面向超表面逆向设计的自演化智能体框架
one_line: A meta-agent revises a coding agent's skill file from physics-solver per-task feedback, replacing the incumbent only when a candidate ranks strictly higher on validation.
one_line_zh: 元智能体依据物理求解器的逐任务反馈修订编码智能体的技能文件，仅当候选在验证集上严格更优时替换现有版本。

title_zh: SkillForge：在云技术支持中锻造领域专用、自演化的智能体技能
one_line: Batch failure analysis against expert ticket replies is aggregated by category, attributed to SKILL.md sections, and used to rewrite cloud-support skills each round.
one_line_zh: 将与专家工单回复不一致的失败按类别批量汇总，归因到SKILL.md具体段落，并逐轮重写云支持技能。

title_zh: 跨异构任务的自演化LLM记忆抽取
one_line: Clusters training logs by extraction scenario, analyzes each cluster separately, then synthesizes cross-cluster insights to rewrite a single memory-extraction prompt.
one_line_zh: 按抽取场景对训练日志聚类、逐簇分析，再综合跨簇洞见重写单一记忆抽取提示。

title_zh: MUSE：基于自演化画像与评分细则对齐的多领域中文用户模拟
one_line: Per dialogue, a reasoning model critiques simulated vs real conversations to iteratively rewrite a user-profile prompt, then the simulator is trained with SFT and rubric-reward RL.
one_line_zh: 逐对话由推理模型对比模拟与真实对话来迭代重写用户画像提示，随后以SFT和细则奖励RL训练模拟器。

title_zh: SAGER：面向推荐智能体的自演化用户策略技能
one_line: Each user's natural-language policy skill is incrementally refined from contrasts between chosen and unchosen items, with confidence tiers instead of full rewrites; frozen before testing.
one_line_zh: 每个用户的自然语言策略技能根据所选与未选物品的对比增量修正，用置信层级代替整体重写，测试前冻结。

title_zh: AutoVQA-G：面向自动视觉问答与定位标注的自改进智能体框架
one_line: A prompt-optimizer agent with attempt memory routes VLM-judge CoT critiques to the responsible generation module's rubric and refines it until annotations pass a consistency threshold.
one_line_zh: 带尝试记忆的提示优化智能体把VLM评判的CoT批评路由到对应生成模块的细则并改写，直到标注达到一致性阈值。

title_zh: 学会演化：基于文本参数图优化的多智能体系统自改进框架
one_line: Decomposes a multi-agent system into a textual parameter graph, clusters trace-derived textual gradients into graph-edit proposals, and retrieves past optimization outcomes to guide future proposals.
one_line_zh: 把多智能体系统分解为文本参数图，聚类轨迹文本梯度生成图编辑提案，并检索历史优化经验指导后续提案。

title_zh: 智能体框架工程：可观测性驱动的编码智能体harness自动演化
one_line: An evolve agent edits file-level harness components from distilled trace evidence, attaching predictions that next-round outcomes verify, reverting rejected edits at file granularity.
one_line_zh: 演化智能体依据提炼后的轨迹证据编辑文件级harness组件，每次编辑附带预测并由下一轮结果验证，未通过则按文件回滚。

title_zh: Skills-Coach：基于免训练GRPO的自演化技能优化器
one_line: Generates train/test tasks from a skill's own spec, refines its instructions via grouped variants and its code via rule/LLM auto-fixers, then compares original vs optimized on generated tests.
one_line_zh: 根据技能自身说明生成训练与测试任务，以分组变体优化指令、以规则和LLM自动修复优化代码，并在生成的测试集上对比。

title_zh: SHARP：面向金融交易智能体的自演化、可人工审计的规则细则策略
one_line: An attribution agent maps worst P&L days to specific rubric rules; an evolution agent makes atomic rule edits accepted only if walk-forward validation return does not drop.
one_line_zh: 归因智能体把最差盈亏日映射到具体规则，演化智能体做原子规则编辑，仅在前推验证收益不下降时接受。

title_zh: 持续框架（Continual Harness）：自改进基础智能体的在线适应
one_line: Mid-episode, a Refiner reads recent gameplay trajectory for failure signatures and applies CRUD edits to prompt, sub-agents, skills and memory without environment resets.
one_line_zh: 在不重置环境的单局中，精炼器读取近期游戏轨迹中的失败特征，对提示、子智能体、技能和记忆做增删改。

title_zh: EmbodiSkill：面向自演化具身智能体的技能感知反思
one_line: Reflections classify each trajectory against the current skill as discovery, optimization, defect or execution lapse; only non-lapse evidence edits targeted skill content, lapses go to an appendix.
one_line_zh: 反思把每条轨迹相对当前技能分类为发现、优化、缺陷或执行失误，仅非失误证据修改对应技能内容，失误写入附录。

title_zh: EGL-SCA：面向图推理智能体中指令与工具协同演化的结构化信用分配
one_line: Verifier evidence routes each graph-reasoning failure to the earliest failing stage, triggering instruction mutation or verifier-gated tool growth/repair, with Pareto retention of instruction-tool pairs.
one_line_zh: 依据验证器证据把图推理失败归因到最早出错阶段，分别触发指令变异或经验证的工具生成/修复，并以帕累托准则保留指令-工具对。

title_zh: ANNEAL：通过受治理的符号补丁学习适配LLM智能体
one_line: Localizes recurring failures to a process-graph operator, generates a typed symbolic patch, and commits it only after scoring, guardrails and canary tests, with provenance and rollback.
one_line_zh: 把反复出现的失败定位到流程图中的算子，生成类型化符号补丁，经评分、护栏和金丝雀测试后才提交，并保留溯源与回滚。

title_zh: Trace2Skill：面向长上下文EDA智能体的验证器引导技能演化
one_line: Per hard Verilog task, an oracle mines rollout traces into lessons, a mutator proposes child skills, and a pass-dominant selector with dense verifier proxies keeps survivors.
one_line_zh: 针对每个困难Verilog任务，由oracle从轨迹提炼经验、变异器提出子技能、以通过率优先并结合稠密验证信号的选择器保留存活者。

title_zh: 适配接口而非模型：确定性LLM智能体的运行时harness适配
one_line: An evolution LLM turns recurring training-trajectory failures into edits across four runtime-harness layers; a candidate replaces the incumbent only if training-batch accuracy improves, then freezes.
one_line_zh: 演化LLM把训练轨迹中的反复失败转化为四个运行时harness层的修改，仅当训练批次准确率提升才替换现有版本，之后冻结。

title_zh: MOSS：自主智能体系统中基于源码级重写的自演化
one_line: Curates batches of production failures, delegates source-level harness edits to an external coding agent, replays the batch on the candidate image, then swaps it in with health-gated rollback.
one_line_zh: 汇集生产环境失败批次，交由外部编码智能体修改harness源码，在候选镜像上重放该批次验证，再经健康检查可回滚地替换上线。

title_zh: PACE：小语言模型智能体的双时间尺度自演化
one_line: A frozen small model evolves its prompt until validation gains saturate, then proposes bounded solver-code edits committed only if they beat the current agent on validation.
one_line_zh: 冻结的小模型先演化提示直至验证增益饱和，再提出有界的求解器代码修改，仅在验证集上优于当前智能体时才提交。

title_zh: SkillOpt：自演化智能体技能的执行策略
one_line: An optimizer model turns minibatch-reflected rollouts into budget-clipped add/delete/replace edits on one skill document, accepted only if held-out selection score strictly improves.
one_line_zh: 优化器模型把小批量反思的轨迹转为受编辑预算限制的增删改操作作用于单一技能文档，仅当选择集分数严格提升时接受。

title_zh: CyberEvolver：面向网络安全智能体的即时结构化自演化
one_line: Per security target, diagnoses compressed failed trajectories into layer-attributed reports and beam-searches layer-wise scaffold mutations, choosing parents by LLM-judged progress.
one_line_zh: 针对单个安全目标，把压缩后的失败轨迹诊断为分层归因报告，并以LLM评估的进展分选择父代，对脚手架做分层变异的束搜索。

title_zh: SkillRevise：基于轨迹条件技能修订改进LLM编写的智能体技能
one_line: Per task, diagnoses verifier failures of an LLM-authored skill, binds retrieved repair principles, makes anchored span edits, re-executes, and keeps the best observed skill.
one_line_zh: 逐任务诊断LLM编写技能的验证器失败，绑定检索到的修复原则做锚定的局部编辑，重新执行并保留观测到的最佳技能。

title_zh: MobEvolve：用于可解释人类出行生成的智能体自进化启发式系统
one_line: A coding agent evolves a four-component mobility heuristic program from validation-set misalignment diagnoses, promoting only verified updates and logging trials in evolution memory.
one_line_zh: 编码智能体依据验证集上的分布/行为偏差诊断，演化四模块出行启发式程序，仅保留经验证的更新并记录试验记忆。

title_zh: 自适应自动Harness：面向开放式任务流的智能体系统持续自我改进
one_line: A stateful multi-agent evolver builds a git branch tree of regime-specific harnesses from temporally revealed stream feedback; a router picks a branch per task at solve time.
one_line_zh: 有状态多智能体演化器依据按时揭示的任务流反馈构建分支化harness树，求解时由路由器为每个任务选择分支。

title_zh: MMG2Skill：智能体能否将真实网络指南提炼为自我进化的技能？
one_line: Compiles web guides into SKILL.md files for a fixed VLM agent and revises them per task from same-model analyzer root-cause diagnoses of trajectories, with analyzer-based early stopping.
one_line_zh: 把网络指南编译为SKILL.md技能，由同一模型的分析器对轨迹做根因诊断并逐任务修订技能，用分析器判定提前停止。

title_zh: Parthenon Law：一个自我进化的法律智能体框架
one_line: A legal-agent harness whose learner turns redacted, rubric-scored failures into task-agnostic edits to skills, tools and knowledge, admitted only if per-task pass rate strictly improves.
one_line_zh: 法律智能体harness中，学习者把经脱敏的评分失败转化为与任务无关的技能/工具/知识编辑，仅在通过率严格提升时采纳。

title_zh: VASO：面向物理AI智能体的可形式化验证的自进化技能
one_line: Refines robot skill contracts (LTL rule, labeling function, plan template) by converting model-checker counterexamples into textual gradients, keeping model weights frozen.
one_line_zh: 将模型检测器的反例转为文本梯度，迭代修订机器人技能契约（LTL规则、命题标注函数、计划模板），不更新模型权重。

title_zh: 从失败轨迹到可靠的LLM智能体：诊断与修复Harness缺陷
one_line: HarnessFix compiles traces plus harness source into an aligned IR, attributes failures to steps and artifacts, clusters recurring flaws, and applies scoped patches accepted by regression-aware validation.
one_line_zh: 将轨迹与harness源码编译为对齐的中间表示，把失败归因到步骤与构件，聚合复发缺陷，施加限定范围补丁并经回归感知验证接受。

title_zh: 用轻量编码智能体适配器自动配置科学模拟器
one_line: Wraps a frozen coding agent with a simulator adapter (retrieval, memory cheatsheet, validator, stop hook); a coding-agent proposer evolves adapter text from prior trajectories, keeping improvements.
one_line_zh: 为冻结的编码智能体加上模拟器适配器（检索、记忆速查表、校验器、停止钩子），由编码智能体依据历史轨迹演化适配器内容并保留改进。

title_zh: Trace2Policy：从专家行为轨迹到自我进化的决策智能体
one_line: Distills a decision-rule document from expert traces, then refines it by clustering validation errors into MISSING/WRONG/CONFLICT, patching per cluster, and committing patches passing a regression gate.
one_line_zh: 从专家行为轨迹提炼决策规则文档，再将验证错误按缺失/错误/冲突聚类、逐簇打补丁，并仅提交通过回归门控的修改。

title_zh: HarnessX：可组合、自适应、可演化的智能体Harness工坊
one_line: Typed harness processors composed via substitution algebra; AEGIS (Digester, Planner, Evolver, Critic) proposes trace-grounded code edits admitted through a deterministic gate, optionally per task-cluster variant.
one_line_zh: 以类型化处理器组合harness，AEGIS四阶段流水线依据轨迹提出代码级编辑，经确定性门控接受，可按任务簇维护变体。

title_zh: 面向智能体安全审计的可迁移自进化行动手册
one_line: A reviser edits a text audit playbook from ground-truth-scored failure reports over chronologically streamed advisories, gated by batch selection; frozen playbooks transfer to weaker models via adapters.
one_line_zh: 修订者依据真实标注评分的失败报告，按时间流迭代编辑安全审计文本手册并经批次选择门控；冻结后通过适配器迁移给较弱模型。

title_zh: SAGE：基于智能体引导探索的随机提示优化
one_line: Hill-climbs a system prompt: multi-agent analysts write diagnostic code over all candidates' predictions and traces, generate revised prompts, and adopt one only if it strictly beats the incumbent.
one_line_zh: 对系统提示做爬山搜索：多智能体编写诊断代码分析所有候选的预测与轨迹，生成修订提示，仅在严格优于现任时采纳。

title_zh: AgentX：迈向智能体驱动的工业推荐系统自我迭代
one_line: Production multi-agent loop proposes, codes and A/B-tests recommender changes; a harness-evolution layer turns trajectories into semantic-gradient prompt updates per subagent, admitted via paired replay.
one_line_zh: 生产级多智能体闭环提出、实现并A/B测试推荐系统改动；harness演化层把轨迹转为各子智能体的语义梯度提示更新，经配对回放后采纳。

title_zh: 将智能体硬件设计视为仓库级代码演化
one_line: Compiles a Markdown harness into a git worktree project pack; a hands-free agent edits RTL artifacts, runs the benchmark evaluator, and commits passing versions or logs rejections.
one_line_zh: 将Markdown harness编译为git工作树项目包，免干预智能体编辑RTL设计、运行基准评测器，通过则提交、失败则记录。

title_zh: 用于生物实验方案自动生成与执行的自进化智能体系统
one_line: A wet-lab multi-agent system whose coding agent keeps a runtime skill library revised via create-evaluate-revise loops from rubric validators, code checks and execution feedback.
one_line_zh: 湿实验多智能体系统，其编码智能体维护运行时技能库，依据评分细则校验、代码检查与执行反馈循环创建—评估—修订技能。

title_zh: Libra：为智能体信息检索训练环境
one_line: A Healer agent rewrites in-repository Markdown catalogs from a frozen Solver's localization failures on Prompter-generated synthetic queries; catalogs persist and transfer across models.
one_line_zh: Healer智能体依据冻结Solver在合成查询上的定位失败，改写仓库内Markdown目录索引；目录持久保留并可跨模型迁移。

title_zh: ComfyClaw：面向图像生成工作流的自进化技能Harness
one_line: A ComfyUI workflow agent clusters VLM-verified success/failure traces into skill-library mutations, accepted only if reward on agent-synthesized validation prompts does not degrade.
one_line_zh: ComfyUI工作流智能体将VLM验证的成功/失败轨迹聚类为技能库变异，仅当在智能体合成的验证提示上奖励不下降时接受。

title_zh: TTHE：测试时Harness演化
one_line: On each unlabeled test batch, coding-agent proposers evolve a population of executable harnesses from traces and proxy signals; a same-model judge selects one, which seeds the next batch.
one_line_zh: 在每个无标注测试批次上，编码智能体依据执行轨迹与代理信号演化可执行harness种群，由同一模型的评判者选出一个并延续到下一批次。

title_zh: SKILL-KD：面向LLM智能体的对比式技能蒸馏
one_line: Contrasts student failures with teacher trajectories into skill patches, keeps a patch only if the frozen student then succeeds, and consolidates via trace-linked edit history.
one_line_zh: 对比学生失败轨迹与教师轨迹生成技能补丁，仅在冻结学生重跑成功后保留，并借助轨迹关联的编辑历史进行整合。

title_zh: HarnessCompass：引导自动Harness演化走向可泛化且有效的智能体Harness
one_line: Evolves a coding-agent harness under a task-agnostic generalization gate, trajectory-grounded first-person agent feedback, and separate component tracks merged afterward; unhelpful edits revert.
one_line_zh: 在任务无关的泛化门控、经轨迹核验的智能体第一人称反馈和分组件独立优化后合并的约束下演化编码智能体harness，无效编辑回滚。

title_zh: EvolveNet：面向智能体自我改进的协同Harness演化
one_line: Clients evolve a broadcast harness on local workloads; a server merges their code deltas as shared or domain-scoped mechanisms using traces, accepting merges that do not lower validation accuracy.
one_line_zh: 各客户端在本地负载上演化广播harness，服务器依据轨迹将代码增量按共享或领域限定机制合并，仅在验证准确率不下降时接受并再分发。

title_zh: 通过技能—Harness演化实现自进化具身智能体
one_line: A frozen VLM, prompted as optimizer, rewrites a planner skill then a context-building harness function from hierarchical rollout textual gradients, with beam selection on a disjoint validation set.
one_line_zh: 冻结VLM作为优化器，依据分层汇总的轨迹文本梯度先后改写规划技能与上下文构建harness函数，并在独立验证集上做束搜索选择。

title_zh: 测试时的AI4AI：通过Harness实现由强到弱的能力迁移
one_line: A strong builder coding agent iteratively writes an inference-time scaffold (routing, deterministic solvers, format checks) for a frozen weak model using a 5% labeled validation slice.
one_line_zh: 强构建者编码智能体利用5%带标注验证集，迭代为冻结弱模型编写推理时脚手架（路由、确定性求解器、格式校验）。

title_zh: AutoSaddler：基于智能体执行轨迹的持久更新式自动Harness优化
one_line: Mini-batch harness optimization: an agent diagnoses failure traces with harness source, writes typed prompt/tool/middleware patches, verifies on the batch then a dev set, and logs lessons in an evolution DAG.
one_line_zh: 小批量harness优化：智能体结合源码诊断失败轨迹，生成分类的提示/工具/中间件补丁，先在批次再在开发集验证，并将经验记入演化DAG。

title_zh: Prime Agent：一个自我改进的RLM Harness
one_line: An open-source long-horizon harness (persistent REPL, recursive subagents) whose Continual Harness refines versioned prompt notes, memories, skills and subagent specs from trajectory evidence.
one_line_zh: 开源长时程harness（持久REPL、递归子智能体），其持续harness模块依据轨迹证据修订带版本的提示笔记、记忆、技能与子智能体规格。

title_zh: EvoSafeHarness：为保障智能体安全演化特定于模型与领域的Harness
one_line: A Designer evolves a safety policy bundle plus executable enforcement code from per-channel failure traces; a blind Criticizer rejects artifact-keyed rules and a cascade allocates evaluation.
one_line_zh: 设计者依据分通道失败轨迹演化安全策略包与可执行拦截代码；盲审批评者剔除依赖基准表面特征的规则，级联测试分配评测预算。

title_zh: ModularRSI：模块化且可泛化的递归Harness自我改进
one_line: Evolves five harness modules independently on benchmark-disjoint tasks from contrastive success/failure trajectories voted across tasks, gated with rollback, then integrates modules into one harness.
one_line_zh: 在与评测基准不相交的任务上，依据跨任务投票的成功/失败对比轨迹独立演化五个harness模块，经门控与回滚后整合为统一harness。

title_zh: 智能体即评委：用智能体评估智能体
one_line: Proposes an agentic judge that gathers workspace and trajectory evidence to check hierarchical requirements on DevAI; judge is fixed, validated against human consensus, nothing retained or evolved.
one_line_zh: 提出用智能体收集工作区与轨迹证据来逐条检查DevAI层级需求的评委，以人工共识验证，评委本身不进化。

title_zh: 通过动态奖励加权学习优化多目标对齐
one_line: Adapts multi-objective RL reward weights online from hypervolume contributions or per-objective gradient influence, replacing fixed linear scalarization while training the LLM policy.
one_line_zh: 在在线强化学习中依据超体积贡献或各目标梯度影响动态调整多目标奖励权重，替代固定线性加权。

title_zh: AgenticEval：迈向大语言模型的智能体化与自进化安全评估
one_line: Multi-agent pipeline turns regulations into a search-grounded test suite, then an Analyst mines the target model's failures to generate harder tests each round.
one_line_zh: 多智能体将法规转为检索支撑的测试集，分析者再依据目标模型的失败逐轮生成更难的测试。

title_zh: 迈向搜索环境中的智能体自学习大语言模型
one_line: One shared LLM backbone RL-trains a prompt generator, search policy and generative reward model in rotation, the reward model co-evolving to track the harder synthetic tasks.
one_line_zh: 共享同一骨干的题目生成器、搜索策略与生成式奖励模型轮流强化学习，奖励模型随更难的合成任务共同进化。

title_zh: DR Tulu：基于进化评分细则的深度研究强化学习
one_line: RL for deep-research agents where per-prompt rubrics are seeded from web search and regenerated from contrasting rollouts each step, keeping only high-variance rubrics as reward.
one_line_zh: 深度研究智能体强化学习：每题评分细则先由网络检索生成，再依据对比回答逐步更新，仅保留高方差细则作为奖励。

title_zh: 用自进化评分细则强化思维链推理
one_line: One policy plays reasoner and rubricator; CoT rubrics are kept only if correlated with answer correctness, and the rubricator is RL-rewarded for proposing valid rubrics.
one_line_zh: 同一策略兼任推理者与细则生成者；只保留与答案正确性相关的思维链细则，并按有效细则比例奖励细则生成。

title_zh: CoEvoSkills：通过协同进化验证实现自进化智能体技能
one_line: A skill generator refines multi-file skill packages from an isolated surrogate verifier's tests, which escalate only when an opaque ground-truth oracle bit disagrees.
one_line_zh: 技能生成器依据隔离的代理验证器测试迭代改进多文件技能包，仅当不透明真值预言比特不一致时验证器才加强测试。

title_zh: RewardHarness：自进化的智能体式后训练
one_line: An orchestrator evolves a library of evaluation Skills and Tools for a frozen VLM judge from 100 preference labels, committing edits only if validation accuracy strictly rises.
one_line_zh: 编排者基于100条偏好标注为冻结的视觉语言评委进化评估技能与工具库，仅在验证准确率严格提升时提交修改。

title_zh: OpenComputer：面向计算机使用智能体的可验证软件世界
one_line: Builds app-state verifiers for 33 desktop apps and repairs them on cached calibration runs where they disagree with an LLM reference, then synthesizes machine-checkable tasks.
one_line_zh: 为33个桌面应用构建应用状态验证器，在缓存的校准执行上依据与LLM参考判定的分歧修复验证器，再合成可机检任务。

title_zh: 能力能否迁移到主观行为——我们的测量工具能否察觉？一种自进化、构造即可信的评估范式
one_line: An LLM proposer adds or drops rubric dimensions and scenarios, committing a change only if a multiplicative anti-gaming fitness on held-out scenarios rises; self-halts on patience.
one_line_zh: LLM提议者增删评估维度与场景，仅当留出场景上的乘积式防作弊适应度提升时提交，停滞后自动终止。

title_zh: EvoRubric：面向开放式生成的自进化评分细则驱动强化学习
one_line: A shared policy generates responses and rubrics; criteria pass a frozen meta-verifier, variance and leave-one-out consensus checks, and survive in a per-query memory pool as reward.
one_line_zh: 共享策略同时生成回答与评分细则；细则须通过冻结元验证器、方差与留一共识检验，并存入每题记忆池作为奖励。

title_zh: Elmes*：面向长尾教育场景的大语言模型细粒度评估细则自动构建
one_line: SceneGen co-evolves scenario rubrics and synthetic test data from expert seed dimensions, rewriting metrics flagged by score distributions, with frozen-pair drift checks and rollback.
one_line_zh: SceneGen从专家种子维度出发协同进化场景评分细则与合成测试数据，按分数分布改写指标，并用冻结样本检测漂移与回滚。

title_zh: OpenSkill：面向大语言模型智能体的开放世界自进化
one_line: Retrieves documentation and verification anchors from the open web, drafts skills, and refines them against an isolated verifier's anchor-grounded virtual tests; ground-truth tests touched only at evaluation.
one_line_zh: 从开放网络检索知识与可验证锚点，生成技能并用隔离验证器基于锚点构造的虚拟测试迭代改进，真值测试仅用于最终评估。

title_zh: 红皇后哥德尔机：智能体与其评估器的协同进化
one_line: Self-modifying agent search co-evolves learned evaluators in epochs; a challenger evaluator replaces the frozen one only if it scores higher on a held-out labeled anchor, erasing dependent records.
one_line_zh: 自修改智能体搜索分时期协同进化评估器；挑战者仅在留出标注锚点上得分更高时替换冻结评估器，并清除依赖旧评估器的记录。

title_zh: SkillCoach：用于评估和增强智能体技能使用的自进化评分细则
one_line: Per-task skill-use process rubrics built from gold skills are patched by a separate arbiter from real rollouts, accepted only through held-out validation gates, then used to filter SFT data.
one_line_zh: 由金标技能构建的逐任务技能使用过程细则，经独立仲裁模型依据真实轨迹打补丁，只在留出验证门通过后接受，再用于筛选SFT数据。

title_zh: 谁来评判评判者？面向自我改进LLM智能体的评估指标与技能协同进化
one_line: Evolves the grading metric as a composition of typed drawback detectors selected by ten-item anchor agreement plus consensus, validated on a locked set, and co-evolved with a skill loop.
one_line_zh: 将评分指标进化为类型化缺陷检测器的组合，按十条锚点一致性加共识选择，在锁定集上验证，并与技能循环协同进化。

title_zh: SERPO：面向开放式测试时强化学习的自进化评分细则策略优化
one_line: Test-time RL on open-ended prompts: frozen self-copies derive query rubrics from Good-Normal-Bad rollout archives, retain criteria that discriminate them, and score rollouts for GRPO.
one_line_zh: 开放式测试时强化学习：冻结的自身副本从好-中-差回答档案中归纳每题细则，保留能区分档案的细则，并为GRPO打分。

title_zh: DRACO：面向长时程智能体训练的动态评分细则细粒度信用分配
one_line: Outcome-blind GRPO for tool agents: a frozen judge generates per-task rubrics from rollouts, drops criteria nobody failed, and redistributes advantage to the steps each verdict cites.
one_line_zh: 无结果信号的工具智能体GRPO：冻结评委依据回放生成逐任务细则，丢弃无人失败的细则，并将优势按判定引用的步骤重新分配。

title_zh: EvolvingAgent：面向长时程任务的带持续世界模型的课程式自进化智能体
one_line: Embodied agent accumulates a multimodal experience pool, LoRA-tunes its LLM planner on failure experiences, and curriculum-selects experiences to update a world model with EWC.
one_line_zh: 具身智能体积累多模态经验池，用失败经验LoRA微调规划器，并以课程学习选择经验更新世界模型。

title_zh: MemGen：为自进化智能体编织生成式潜在记忆
one_line: RL-trained LoRA trigger decides when, and a LoRA weaver generates latent memory tokens inserted into a frozen reasoner, internalizing experience into adapters.
one_line_zh: RL训练的LoRA触发器决定何时调用记忆，LoRA编织器生成潜在记忆token插入冻结推理器，把经验内化到适配器中。

title_zh: LatentEvolve：潜在空间中的自进化测试时扩展
one_line: Test-time latent optimization retrieves past latent momenta from an episodic buffer (daytime) and periodically trains a latent weaver on self-rewarded high-confidence traces (nighttime).
one_line_zh: 白天从情景缓冲区检索过往潜在优化动量做测试时优化，夜间用自奖励高置信轨迹周期训练潜在编织器。

title_zh: EvolveR：基于经验驱动生命周期的自进化LLM智能体
one_line: Agent self-distills success/failure trajectories into a scored, deduplicated principle base it retrieves via a search action, while GRPO trains the policy on the same online trajectories.
one_line_zh: 智能体将成败轨迹自蒸馏为可检索、带评分去重的原则库，同时用同一批在线轨迹以GRPO训练策略。

title_zh: 自进化智能体的自我巩固
one_line: Lifelong agent extracts contrastive error/success insights as text and periodically distills many past trajectories into a few learnable prompt tokens via teacher-student consolidation.
one_line_zh: 终身学习智能体以对比反思提取成败文本经验，并周期性将大量历史轨迹蒸馏进少量可学习提示token。

title_zh: UI-Mem：面向移动GUI智能体在线强化学习的自进化经验记忆
one_line: GUI agent's GRPO rollouts are guided at stratified strengths by a hierarchical template memory (workflows, skills, failure patterns) that is re-abstracted from the same rollouts.
one_line_zh: GUI智能体的GRPO采样按分层强度注入层级模板记忆（流程、技能、失败模式），记忆又从同批轨迹中自进化。

title_zh: SkillRL：通过递归技能增强强化学习进化智能体
one_line: Teacher distills success/failure trajectories into a hierarchical SkillBank; a cold-started policy conditioned on retrieved skills is GRPO-trained while validation failures drive skill evolution.
one_line_zh: 教师模型将成败轨迹蒸馏为层级技能库，策略以检索技能为条件经冷启动SFT和GRPO训练，验证失败驱动技能演化。

title_zh: 面向LLM强化学习的进化式系统提示学习
one_line: Each RL iteration samples under several system prompts; the same rollouts update LoRA weights and TrueSkill-rate prompts, which evolve by reflective mutation and crossover.
one_line_zh: 每轮RL在多个系统提示下采样，同一批轨迹既更新LoRA权重又给提示做TrueSkill评分，提示经反思式变异与交叉进化。

title_zh: RetroAgent：通过回顾式双重内在反馈从解题走向进化
one_line: Online RL agent reflects on each episode to produce a progress-based intrinsic reward and textual lessons in a UCB-retrieved memory; the reflector itself can be RL-trained.
one_line_zh: 在线RL智能体对每回合回顾反思，产生基于进度的内在奖励与经UCB检索的文本教训记忆，反思器本身也可RL训练。

title_zh: MetaClaw：只需对话——在真实环境中元学习与进化的智能体
one_line: Deployed agent synthesizes skills from failures instantly and, during user-idle windows, LoRA-RL-trains the policy only on version-stamped post-adaptation trajectories.
one_line_zh: 部署中的智能体从失败即时合成技能，并在用户空闲时仅用带版本号的适配后轨迹对策略做LoRA强化学习。

title_zh: PsychAgent：面向自进化心理咨询师的经验驱动终身学习智能体
one_line: Counseling agent extracts skills from high-reward sessions into a hierarchical skill tree and internalizes them via rejection fine-tuning on reward-model-selected rollouts.
one_line_zh: 心理咨询智能体从高奖励会话提取技能存入层级技能树，并对奖励模型选出的轨迹做拒绝采样微调以内化技能。

title_zh: SE-GA：面向GUI智能体的记忆增强自进化
one_line: GUI agent retrieves episodic, semantic and experiential memories at test time; trajectories curated in memory feed SFT then a modified GRPO to update the policy.
one_line_zh: GUI智能体测试时检索情景、语义与经验记忆，记忆中整理的轨迹再用于SFT和改进版GRPO更新策略。

title_zh: AtlasVA：面向无教师VLM智能体的自进化视觉技能记忆
one_line: VLM agent keeps heatmap, exemplar and text-skill memory evolved from rollout statistics; the same atlases are visual prompts and potential-based shaping rewards for PPO.
one_line_zh: VLM智能体维护由轨迹统计演化的热力图、示例与文本技能记忆，同一图谱既作视觉提示又作PPO的势函数奖励塑形。

title_zh: SIA：同时更新框架（harness）与权重的自我改进AI
one_line: A Feedback-Agent first iterates the task agent's scaffold, then switches to RL on LoRA weights with an algorithm it picks once harness reward stalls.
one_line_zh: 反馈智能体先迭代任务智能体的脚手架，奖励停滞后切换到自选算法对LoRA权重做强化学习。

title_zh: HarnessForge：面向自适应智能体系统的harness与策略联合进化
one_line: Meta-agent tailors harness candidates from fault attribution under Pareto selection; the same rollout pool's successful traces train harness-conditioned LoRA adapters per survivor.
one_line_zh: 元智能体基于故障归因生成并帕累托筛选harness，同一采样池中的成功轨迹为每个幸存harness训练条件化LoRA适配器。

title_zh: Traj-Evolve：用于肺癌早筛患者轨迹建模的自进化多智能体系统
one_line: Multi-agent EHR system indexes rejection-sampled traces of verified patients as a retrieval pool and RAFT-trains worker/manager agents with leave-one-out cross-retrieval.
one_line_zh: 多智能体EHR系统将已确诊患者的拒绝采样推理轨迹建成检索经验池，并以留一交叉检索做RAFT训练工作者与管理者智能体。

title_zh: EvoTrainer：为自主智能体强化学习协同进化LLM策略与训练harness
one_line: Trainer agent co-evolves RL policy versions and a training-side diagnostic harness from rollout evidence, keeping memory and reusable skills transferred across domains.
one_line_zh: 训练者智能体依据rollout证据协同进化RL策略版本与训练侧诊断harness，并跨领域复用记忆与技能。

title_zh: 迈向Vibe Medicine：用于临床决策支持的自进化多智能体框架
one_line: Clinical multi-agent system proposes memory, model and code-level evolution from clinical feedback; only an SFT-LoRA evolved model versus base is evaluated.
one_line_zh: 临床多智能体系统提出记忆、模型与代码三级进化，但实验只评估了SFT-LoRA进化模型相对基座的提升。

title_zh: ScienceBuddy：面向交互式科学智能体的递归中递归自我改进
one_line: Inner loop edits harness skills/instructions with a fixed model under development-set acceptance; outer loop GRPO-trains the model on rubric-scored rollouts under the selected harness.
one_line_zh: 内层在模型固定时按开发集接受规则编辑harness技能与指令，外层在选定harness下以评分细则奖励对模型做GRPO训练。

title_zh: CREATOR：通过工具创建解耦大语言模型的抽象推理与具体推理
one_line: LLM creates documented code tools per problem, decides their use, executes, and rectifies from tracebacks; created tools can transfer to related queries.
one_line_zh: LLM为问题编写带文档的代码工具，再决定调用、执行并依报错回溯修正，工具可迁移到同概念的问题。

title_zh: Voyager：基于大语言模型的开放式具身智能体
one_line: Minecraft agent self-proposes curriculum tasks, writes and repairs code skills from execution feedback, admits critic-verified skills to a reusable embedding-indexed library.
one_line_zh: Minecraft智能体自拟课程任务，依执行反馈编写修复代码技能，经GPT-4自验证后存入可检索复用的技能库。

title_zh: 大语言模型作为工具制造者
one_line: A strong LLM writes and unit-test-verifies a Python tool per task type from few demos; a cheap LLM reuses it, cached as a functional cache.
one_line_zh: 强模型根据少量示例为每类任务编写并经单元测试验证的Python工具，弱模型复用，形成功能缓存。

title_zh: CRAFT：通过创建和检索专用工具集定制大语言模型
one_line: Offline, GPT-4 solves training problems in code, keeps correct solutions, abstracts and deduplicates them into a toolset retrieved at inference by multi-view matching.
one_line_zh: 离线让GPT-4用代码解训练题，保留正确解并抽象去重成工具集，推理时多视角检索调用。

title_zh: OS-Copilot：迈向具备自我改进能力的通用计算机智能体
one_line: OS agent FRIDAY self-proposes practice tasks or explores a dev set, generates and critic-refines Python tools, and stores them in a tool repository for later tasks.
one_line_zh: OS智能体FRIDAY自拟练习任务或探索开发集，生成并经批评器修正Python工具，存入工具库供后续任务复用。

title_zh: 以函数为可学习权重的语言模型智能体离线训练
one_line: AgentOptimizer LLM adds/revises/removes agent functions from training-set execution histories, with roll-back on training regressions and early stopping; functions persist across epochs.
one_line_zh: AgentOptimizer依训练集执行历史增删改智能体函数，训练集性能下降即回滚并早停，函数跨轮保留。

title_zh: 通过从GitHub自主集成工具提升大语言模型的开放域任务求解能力
one_line: Hierarchical agent searches, sets up and applies GitHub repositories as tools, learning from Issues/PRs and storing Docker images plus summarized experience for later queries.
one_line_zh: 分层智能体检索、部署并使用GitHub仓库作为工具，借鉴Issue/PR，并保存Docker镜像与经验摘要供后续查询复用。

title_zh: 通过自学习智能体实现自主微服务管理
one_line: Microservice management agents explore via an easy-to-hard self-generated curriculum, refine solutions from environment/peer feedback, and curate results into a skill library.
one_line_zh: 微服务管理智能体按由易到难的自生成课程探索，依环境与同伴反馈修正方案，并沉淀为技能库。

title_zh: LLM智能体制作智能体工具
one_line: ToolMaker installs a paper's GitHub repo in a checkpointed Docker sandbox and implements a Python tool, self-correcting from execution errors until an LLM judges success.
one_line_zh: ToolMaker在可回滚的Docker沙箱中安装论文代码仓库并实现Python工具，依执行错误闭环自修正直至LLM判定成功。

title_zh: 高级工具学习与选择系统（ATLASS）：基于LLM的闭环框架
one_line: Multi-agent pipeline analyzes tool needs, retrieves a stored tool or generates one with environment setup and fetched API docs, saving it to a tool database.
one_line_zh: 多智能体流水线分析工具需求，检索已存工具或结合环境配置与在线API文档生成新工具，并存入工具库复用。

title_zh: 为智能体任务归纳程序化技能
one_line: Web agent induces Python skill programs from LLM-judged successful episodes online, admits them after a re-execution test of correctness, usage and state change.
one_line_zh: 网页智能体在线从被判定成功的轨迹归纳Python技能程序，经重执行检验正确性、调用与状态变化后纳入动作空间。

title_zh: SkillWeaver：网页智能体通过发现与打磨技能实现自我改进
one_line: Web agent self-proposes practice tasks per website, distills reward-model-approved trajectories into Playwright API functions, unit-tests and debugs them, growing a plug-in API library.
one_line_zh: 网页智能体为每个网站自拟练习任务，把奖励模型认可的轨迹提炼为Playwright API函数，经测试调试后扩充可插拔API库。

title_zh: Alita：以最少预定义与最大自我进化实现可扩展智能体推理的通用智能体
one_line: Minimal generalist agent detects capability gaps, generates tools from searched open-source code, validates them by isolated execution, and registers them as reusable MCP servers.
one_line_zh: 极简通用智能体识别能力缺口，借助检索到的开源代码生成工具，经隔离执行验证后注册为可复用MCP。

title_zh: STELLA：面向生物医学研究的自进化LLM智能体
one_line: Multi-agent biomedical system saves successful workflows to a Template Library and has a Tool Creation Agent add tested tools to a Tool Ocean at test time.
one_line_zh: 多智能体生物医学系统把成功流程存入模板库，并由工具创建智能体在测试时向工具海洋添加经测试的工具。

title_zh: PyVision：具备动态工具生成能力的智能体视觉
one_line: MLLM generates, executes and refines Python vision tools per query in a multi-turn sandboxed loop; tools are not retained across queries.
one_line_zh: 多模态大模型在多轮沙箱循环中按查询生成、执行并修正Python视觉工具，工具不跨查询保留。

title_zh: Code2MCP：将代码仓库转化为MCP服务
one_line: Seven-agent workflow clones a GitHub repo, rebuilds its environment, generates MCP tool wrappers with tests, and repairs them in a traceback-driven Run-Review-Fix loop.
one_line_zh: 七智能体流程克隆GitHub仓库、重建环境、生成带测试的MCP工具封装，并以回溯驱动的运行-审查-修复循环修正。

title_zh: Alita-G：用于生成智能体的自进化生成式智能体
one_line: Generalist agent repeatedly runs domain tasks, harvests MCPs from successful runs, abstracts them into an MCP Box, and retrieves them via embedding RAG at inference.
one_line_zh: 通用智能体多次执行领域任务，从成功运行中收集MCP并抽象为MCP Box，推理时用向量检索选用。

title_zh: Live-SWE-agent：软件工程智能体能否在运行中自我进化？
one_line: Bash-only SWE agent is prompted after each step to reflect and create or revise custom script tools on the fly for the current issue; tools are per-issue.
one_line_zh: 仅有bash的软件工程智能体每步反思并为当前问题即时创建或修改自定义脚本工具，工具按问题生成。

title_zh: 演化的程序化技能网络
one_line: Grows a network of executable skill programs from embodied task streams, repairing skills via trace-based credit assignment and refactoring the network under rollback validation.
one_line_zh: 在具身任务流中构建可执行技能程序网络，用执行轨迹归因修复技能，并在回滚校验下重构网络。

title_zh: 超越静态工具：面向科学推理的测试时工具演化
one_line: At inference, decomposes scientific problems, synthesizes and execution-verifies missing tools, atomizes and deduplicates them into a capacity-bounded library reused by later problems.
one_line_zh: 推理时分解科学问题，按需合成并执行验证缺失工具，拆成原子工具去重后存入有容量上限的库供后续复用。

title_zh: Uni-Skill：为可泛化机器人操作构建自演化技能库
one_line: A VLM planner detects missing skills, writes new skill descriptions, and implements them few-shot from a VerbNet-organized repository of auto-annotated robot video segments.
one_line_zh: VLM规划器发现技能缺口并生成新技能描述，再从按VerbNet组织的自动标注机器人视频技能库检索示例少样本实现。

title_zh: 通过经验驱动的自我技能发现演化医学影像智能体
one_line: Mines recurring tool subsequences from answer-verified medical-imaging trajectories into registered composite tools, alongside image-feature memory and GRPO training rewarding composite use.
one_line_zh: 从答案正确的医学影像轨迹中挖掘高频工具子序列注册为复合工具，并配合图像特征记忆与奖励复合工具调用的GRPO训练。

title_zh: AgentFactory：通过可执行子智能体积累与复用实现自我演化的框架
one_line: Saves successful task-solving subagents as executable Python code, repairs them from execution feedback on later similar tasks, and reuses or exports them.
one_line_zh: 把成功解决任务的子智能体保存为可执行Python代码，在后续相似任务中依执行反馈修复，并复用或导出。

title_zh: Mem²Evolve：通过能力扩展与经验蒸馏协同演化实现自我演化智能体
one_line: Creates tools and expert agents on demand guided by distilled experience, admits tools after executing LLM-synthesized tests with self-correction, and retains assets plus lessons.
one_line_zh: 在经验引导下按需创建工具与专家智能体，工具经LLM合成测试执行验证并自我修正后入库，同时沉淀经验教训。

title_zh: 用SelfEvolve实现软件自扩展：一种运行时代码生成的智能体架构
one_line: On user requests for missing functionality, generates functions via test-driven synthesis, adjudicates by executing generated tests, and hot-loads accepted functions into a persistent knowledge base.
one_line_zh: 用户请求缺失功能时以测试驱动方式生成函数，执行生成测试裁决通过后热加载进持久知识库。

title_zh: 自我演化的软件智能体
one_line: A BDI agent with an LLM evolution module that detects unmet needs and synthesizes new goals, reasoning updates and executable plan code at runtime.
one_line_zh: 在BDI智能体旁加入LLM演化模块，发现未满足需求后运行时合成新目标、推理更新与可执行计划代码。

title_zh: 从轨迹到逻辑：面向长程智能体任务的神经符号程序化技能归纳
one_line: Lifts interaction traces into logic-grounded skill programs with branching and variable binding, checked by replay consistency against recorded traces, and grafts recovery trajectories onto failing nodes.
one_line_zh: 把交互轨迹提升为含分支与变量绑定的逻辑化技能程序，用对历史轨迹的回放一致性校验，并把恢复轨迹嫁接到失败节点。

title_zh: CoCoDA：面向工具增强智能体的协同演化组合式DAG
one_line: Folds successful trajectories into composite tools in a typed invocation DAG, admitted by acyclicity/specification checks, while GRPO trains the planner to invoke composites.
one_line_zh: 把成功轨迹折叠为类型化调用DAG中的复合工具，经无环与规格检查入库，同时用GRPO训练规划器调用复合工具。

title_zh: SkillSmith：为自我改进智能体系统协同演化技能与工具
one_line: Co-evolves a skill library and tool library under context and iteration budgets: replicator-dynamics context allocation, typed tool repair/extraction, validation-gated bundles, and delta-debugged nogoods.
one_line_zh: 在上下文与迭代预算下协同演化技能库与工具库：复制子动力学分配上下文、类型化工具修复与抽取、验证把关并用delta调试记录禁忌。

title_zh: MetaForge：按需检索、适配与锻造工具的自我演化多模态智能体
one_line: A GRPO-trained multimodal policy decides to answer, reuse, or forge tools; forged script tools pass execution and judge checks, then judge-merged and usage-retained in a capped pool.
one_line_zh: GRPO训练的多模态策略决定直接回答、复用或锻造工具；锻造的脚本工具经执行与评审校验入库，再由评审去重并按使用量保留。

title_zh: SkillDAG：面向大规模LLM技能选择的自我演化类型化技能图
one_line: Exposes a typed skill-relation graph as an agent-callable retrieval interface; the agent commits execution-backed edge edits under acyclicity, non-contradiction and rollback invariants.
one_line_zh: 把类型化技能关系图作为智能体可调用的检索接口，智能体依执行证据提交边编辑，并受无环、不矛盾与可回滚约束。

title_zh: EvoDS：具备技能学习与上下文管理的自我演化自主数据科学智能体
one_line: RL-trained hierarchical data-science agents synthesize skills when subtasks exceed their skill space, verify by execution, and permanently add skills only after repeated synthesis.
one_line_zh: 经RL训练的分层数据科学智能体在子任务超出技能空间时合成技能，执行验证后仅在多次重复合成时永久加入动作空间。

title_zh: Metis：为自我演化智能体打通文本记忆与代码记忆
one_line: Keeps reflection-distilled text memory (plans, facts, pitfalls) and promotes execution plans into sandbox-validated callable tools only after repeated reuse across distinct queries.
one_line_zh: 以反思提炼的文本记忆（计划、环境事实、陷阱）为基础，仅当执行计划在不同查询中被反复复用后才晋升为沙箱验证的可调用工具。

title_zh: 形式公理系统中的自监督定理发现
one_line: From Hilbert axioms alone, alternates goal-conditioned proof search with extraction of general, hard-to-reprove theorems that are added as lemma actions for later generations.
one_line_zh: 仅从希尔伯特公理出发，交替进行目标条件证明搜索与提取通用且难以重证的定理，并作为引理动作加入后续代际。

title_zh: ASPIRE：面向机器人的智能体技能发现
one_line: A coding agent debugs robot programs from per-primitive execution traces and evolutionary search, distilling execution-validated repairs into a reusable in-context skill library.
one_line_zh: 编码智能体依据逐原语执行轨迹与进化搜索调试机器人程序，把经执行验证的修复提炼为可复用的上下文技能库。

title_zh: FlowEvo：通过工作流与可执行技能协同演化实现自我演化智能体
one_line: Compiles verifier-passed workflows into callable skills admitted by interface, replay and safety checks, reuses them directly or as context, and suppresses skills with negative contrastive utility.
one_line_zh: 把验证通过的工作流编译为可调用技能，经接口、回放与安全检查入库，直接执行或作为上下文复用，并按对比效用抑制负迁移技能。

title_zh: DrunkAgent：针对LLM推荐智能体的隐蔽记忆污染攻击
one_line: Black-box attack that crafts adversarial item-description triggers on a surrogate to corrupt recommender agents' memory updates, promoting target items transferably and stealthily.
one_line_zh: 在代理模型上优化对抗性商品描述触发词，污染推荐智能体的记忆更新，以可迁移且隐蔽的方式推广目标商品。

title_zh: 从知识到噪声：CTIM-Rover与软件工程智能体中情景记忆的陷阱
one_line: Adds ExpeL-style cross-task and repository-level memory distilled from successful SWE trajectories to AutoCodeRover; finds it degrades held-out performance, attributing loss to noisy items.
one_line_zh: 为AutoCodeRover加入由成功轨迹蒸馏的跨任务与仓库级记忆，发现其在留出集上反而降低性能，归因于噪声记忆条目。

title_zh: SWE-Bench-CL：面向编码智能体的持续学习基准
one_line: Reorders SWE-Bench Verified into chronological repository streams with continual-learning metrics and a FAISS memory agent framework; preliminary memory-on/off runs are inconclusive.
one_line_zh: 将SWE-Bench Verified按时间重排为仓库任务流，提出持续学习指标与带FAISS记忆的智能体评测框架，初步对比结果不确定。

title_zh: 你的智能体可能误进化：自我进化LLM智能体中的涌现风险
one_line: Audits self-evolving agents before versus after evolution across model, memory, tool and workflow pathways, finding safety decay and vulnerabilities, with partial prompt-level mitigations.
one_line_zh: 对比自我进化智能体在模型、记忆、工具、工作流四条路径上进化前后的安全性，发现安全退化与漏洞，并给出部分有效的缓解措施。

title_zh: AutoEnv：用于衡量跨环境智能体学习的自动化环境
one_line: Generates 36 heterogeneous environments and casts agent learning as selection/optimization/evaluation over prompts, code or tools; fixed learning methods' gains shrink as environments diversify.
one_line_zh: 自动生成36个异构环境，把智能体学习形式化为对提示、代码或工具的选择-优化-评估过程，发现固定学习方法的收益随环境多样性下降。

title_zh: 大语言模型智能体并不总是忠实的自我进化者
one_line: Applies content-perturbing causal interventions to raw and condensed experience in four self-evolving agent frameworks, showing agents use raw trajectories but largely ignore condensed summaries.
one_line_zh: 对四种自我进化智能体框架中的原始与浓缩经验做内容扰动因果干预，发现智能体依赖原始轨迹却基本忽略浓缩总结。

title_zh: SE-Bench：以知识内化衡量自我进化
