one_line: Obfuscates NumPy into a pseudo-novel API so held-out coding tasks are impossible without internalized knowledge, then diagnoses memory, SFT, RL and self-play internalization.
one_line_zh: 将NumPy混淆为伪新库，使留出编码任务必须依赖已内化知识，从而诊断记忆、SFT、RL与自博弈的知识内化能力。

title_zh: 僵尸智能体：通过自我强化注入持久控制自我进化LLM智能体
one_line: Black-box attack that writes indirect-injection payloads into self-evolving agents' long-term memory via normal updates, with self-replication and semantic aliasing to persist across sessions.
one_line_zh: 黑盒攻击借助正常记忆更新把间接注入载荷写入自我进化智能体的长期记忆，并以自我复制与语义伪装跨会话持久存在。

title_zh: ClawArena：在演化信息环境中评测AI智能体
one_line: Benchmark of evolving multi-source information scenarios testing conflict reasoning, belief revision and implicit personalization across 18 models and five frameworks, including a skill-evolving overlay.
one_line_zh: 构建演化的多源信息场景基准，测评冲突推理、信念修正与隐式个性化，覆盖18个模型与5个框架，并对比技能自进化插件。

title_zh: SEA-Eval：超越单回合评估的自我进化智能体基准
one_line: Defines self-evolving agents via an 'evolutionary flywheel' and benchmarks frameworks on sequential task streams, using token-consumption convergence to separate genuine from pseudo-evolution.
one_line_zh: 以“进化飞轮”定义自我进化智能体，在顺序任务流上评测框架，用token消耗的收敛区分真进化与伪进化。

title_zh: Agent^2 RL-Bench：LLM智能体能否自主构建智能体强化学习后训练？
one_line: Benchmark where agents in isolated budgeted workspaces design and run post-training pipelines, submitting models to a grading API; route tracking shows online RL is rarely engineered.
one_line_zh: 智能体在隔离、限预算的工作区内设计并运行后训练流水线并向评分接口提交模型，路线追踪显示真正的在线RL很少被实现。

title_zh: Frontier-Eng：以生成式优化在真实工程任务上评测自我进化智能体
one_line: Benchmark of 47 engineering optimization tasks with frozen simulators where agents iteratively propose, execute and revise artifacts under fixed budgets; compares models and search frameworks.
one_line_zh: 包含47个工程优化任务、使用冻结仿真验证器的基准，智能体在固定预算内迭代提出、执行并修改方案，对比不同模型与搜索框架。

title_zh: 记忆迁移学习：编码智能体中记忆如何跨领域迁移
one_line: Evaluates coding agents with leave-one-benchmark-out memory pools in four abstraction formats; abstract insights transfer across domains while raw trajectories cause negative transfer.
one_line_zh: 用留一基准的记忆池在四种抽象格式下评测编码智能体，发现抽象洞见可跨域迁移，而原始轨迹会造成负迁移。

title_zh: 前沿编码智能体已能实现与外部求解器相当的AlphaZero式四子棋自博弈机器学习流水线
one_line: Proof-of-concept AI-R&D benchmark: coding agents build AlphaZero Connect Four pipelines in a sandboxed 3-hour budget, scored by solver-anchored round-robin, plus a sandbagging probe.
one_line_zh: AI研发概念验证基准：编码智能体在3小时沙箱预算内搭建AlphaZero四子棋流水线，以求解器锚定的循环赛评分，并做消极怠工探测。

title_zh: MLS-Bench：全面严格评估AI系统构建更好AI的能力
one_line: 140-task benchmark where agents edit one ML component under frozen harnesses, capacity caps and multi-setting evaluation; agents rarely beat human baselines and test-time search overfits visible settings.
one_line_zh: 140任务基准：智能体在冻结评测、容量上限与多设置评估下改进单一ML组件，很少超越人类基线，测试时搜索会过拟合可见设置。

title_zh: 自我进化智能体会遗忘吗？终身LLM智能体适应中的能力退化与保持
one_line: Shows workflow, skill, model and memory self-evolution erode previously mastered capabilities under distribution shift, and adds retention regularizers (CPE) that preserve old-task performance.
one_line_zh: 表明工作流、技能、模型与记忆的自我进化在分布迁移时会侵蚀已掌握能力，并提出保留正则化（CPE）维持旧任务表现。

title_zh: 有用的记忆在被LLM持续更新时会变得有缺陷
one_line: Holding trajectories fixed, shows LLM consolidation of agent memory degrades utility over updates, even below no-memory; episodic retention with gated consolidation mitigates it.
one_line_zh: 在固定轨迹池下表明LLM对智能体记忆的持续整合会使效用先升后降甚至低于无记忆基线，保留原始情景并门控整合可缓解。

title_zh: EvoMemBench：从自我进化视角评测智能体记忆
one_line: Benchmark crossing in/cross-episode scope with knowledge/execution content, comparing 15 memory methods against long-context baselines with token costs and frozen-memory cross-environment transfer.
one_line_zh: 按回合内/跨回合与知识/执行两轴构建基准，对比15种记忆方法与长上下文基线，报告token成本与冻结记忆的跨环境迁移。

title_zh: 从原始经验到技能消费：模型生成智能体技能的系统性研究
one_line: Extracts domain skills from a target's own trajectories with varied extractor models, measuring held-out gains versus no-skill; finds frequent negative transfer and derives a meta-skill improving extraction.
one_line_zh: 用不同提取模型从目标智能体自身轨迹提取领域技能，在留出集上对比无技能基线，发现常见负迁移，并提炼出改进提取的元技能。

title_zh: SkillEvolBench：评测从情景经验到程序性技能的演化
one_line: Benchmark where agents author skill libraries from acquisition-task trajectories and verifier feedback, then are tested frozen on shifted, adversarial and compositional tasks against no-skill and raw-trajectory controls.
one_line_zh: 智能体依据习得任务轨迹与验证反馈编写技能库，再冻结后在情境迁移、对抗捷径与组合任务上测试，并与无技能和原始轨迹对照比较。

title_zh: EvoMap幕后：刻画一个自我进化的智能体间协作网络
one_line: Measurement study of EvoMap's shared self-evolving asset hub (1.5M assets): most assets unused, quality scores driven by self-reported metadata, and validation gates bypassed by vacuous tests.
one_line_zh: 对EvoMap自我进化资产共享网络（150万资产）的测量研究：多数资产从未复用，质量评分受自报元数据主导，验证关卡被空测试绕过。

title_zh: 面向CUDA内核生成中自我进化LLM智能体的反馈到规划决策
one_line: Freezes program states at fixed generations of a self-evolving CUDA-kernel agent and injects feedback subsets, attributing planning outcomes to feedback components and interactions via Banzhaf values.
one_line_zh: 在自我进化CUDA内核智能体的固定代冻结程序状态并选择性注入反馈子集，用Banzhaf值将规划结果归因到各反馈组件及其交互。

title_zh: BenchTrace：测试LLM智能体反思能力与受控进化的基准
one_line: Benchmark of annotated failure snapshots probing reflection (detect/localize/diagnose) and a controlled evolution simulation measuring whether agents avoid previously seen failures on test snapshots.
one_line_zh: 以标注失败快照构建基准，评测反思能力（检测/定位/诊断），并在受控进化模拟中衡量智能体能否在测试快照上避免已见过的失败。

title_zh: Harness 更新能力不等于 Harness 受益能力：解耦自进化 LLM 智能体中的进化能力
one_line: Diagnoses harness self-evolution by crossing evolver and task-agent models under matched budgets, separating update quality from uptake of evolved skills/prompts/memories.
one_line_zh: 在匹配预算下交叉组合进化器与执行智能体模型，区分 harness 更新质量与对更新的利用能力。

title_zh: SAGE：智能体生态中社会化进化的定量评估
one_line: Compares compute-matched social (peer-history) vs self evolution of agents across three arenas, varying shared-history representation to isolate peer-experience effects.
one_line_zh: 在算力匹配下对比可见同伴历史的社会化进化与仅看自身历史的自进化，并消融共享历史的表示形式。

title_zh: Agent libOS：面向能力受控自进化 LLM 智能体的运行时基座
one_line: Runtime substrate letting self-evolving agents change skills, JIT tools, images and checkpoints without expanding resource authority or information flow; evaluated by deterministic safety oracles.
one_line_zh: 运行时基座让自进化智能体可改技能、JIT 工具与镜像，但不扩大资源权限与信息流，用确定性安全预言评测。

title_zh: 元智能体挑战：当前智能体能否自主开发智能体？
one_line: Benchmark where a code meta-agent iteratively programs an agent artifact against a dev-set evaluation API, scored on a hidden test split with anti-reward-hacking isolation and auditing.
one_line_zh: 基准让代码元智能体依开发集评测接口迭代编写智能体程序，在隐藏测试集上评分并有防奖励作弊的隔离与审计。

title_zh: FinEvolveBench：面向低重复、隐式奖励任务的自进化智能体基准
one_line: Chronological financial-news stream benchmark testing whether memory/reflection experience mechanisms beat a no-experience pipeline under noisy delayed feedback and non-stationarity.
one_line_zh: 基于时间顺序金融新闻流的基准，检验记忆与反思类经验机制在噪声延迟反馈和非平稳环境下是否优于无经验基线。

title_zh: SEAGym：自进化 LLM 智能体评测环境
one_line: Evaluation environment turning benchmarks into train batches plus frozen validation, held-out ID/OOD, replay and cost views to measure harness-update methods' transfer and regression.
one_line_zh: 把基准转为训练批次与冻结验证、留出 ID/OOD、回放和成本视图，衡量 harness 更新方法的迁移与退化。

title_zh: ENPIRE：真实世界中的智能体式机器人策略自我改进
one_line: Harness lets coding agents build immutable reset/verification APIs, then autonomously edit robot training code from real-world rollout feedback, sharing recipes across a robot fleet via Git.
one_line_zh: 让编码智能体先构建不可变的复位与验证接口，再依据真实机器人反馈自主改写训练代码，并在机器人集群间共享配方。

title_zh: 自进化 LLM 智能体系统的安全性：威胁、放大效应与案例研究
one_line: Security SoK mapping self-evolving agents' attack surface as a module × lifecycle matrix, with a two-framework case study showing payloads persist through evolved memory and skills.
one_line_zh: 以模块×生命周期矩阵梳理自进化智能体攻击面，并用两框架案例显示攻击载荷经进化的记忆与技能持久留存。

title_zh: EvoAgentBench：通过能力迁移评测智能体自进化
one_line: Benchmark builds trace-grounded Ability Graphs so every held-out task has train-side procedural support, then measures transfer gain of skill/memory/prompt evolution methods over no-evolution.
one_line_zh: 构建基于轨迹的能力图，保证每个留出任务都有训练侧程序支持，测量技能、记忆、提示进化方法相对无进化的迁移增益。

title_zh: 重新思考智能体 Harness 进化的评估
one_line: Re-evaluates automatic harness evolution against matched-budget parallel sampling and sequential refinement, plus held-out tasks, finding gains mostly reflect task-level search except in long-horizon games.
one_line_zh: 在匹配预算下将自动 harness 进化与并行采样、顺序修正比较并加留出任务，发现增益多来自任务级搜索，长程游戏除外。

title_zh: 幻影护栏：当自改进智能体 Harness 修复从未发生的失败
one_line: Deterministic micro-lab plants a guardrail for a provably nonexistent failure to measure when harness-optimizer proposers fabricate fixes, and shows warrant-aware acceptance excludes them.
one_line_zh: 在确定性微型实验室中植入针对不存在失败的护栏，测量 harness 优化器何时捏造修复，并表明基于依据的接受规则可排除。

title_zh: RSIBench-Data：面向递归自我改进的数据中心研究基准
one_line: Benchmark where frontier agents iteratively revise training-data strategies for a fixed target model inside a fixed SFT/serving/evaluation stack, measuring whether feedback yields consistent improvement.
one_line_zh: 基准让前沿智能体在固定的训练、服务与评测栈内为固定目标模型迭代修改训练数据策略，衡量反馈能否带来稳定提升。

title_zh: PAST-Bench：评测个人智能体递归自我改进的基础能力
one_line: Benchmark of fresh-session task families with matched persistence-on/off runs and trace-level mechanism evidence; proposes Hermes+ with five memory/skill read-write interventions.
one_line_zh: 以清空上下文的任务族和匹配的持久化开/关对照及轨迹级机制证据评测个人智能体，并提出含五项读写干预的 Hermes+。

title_zh: 一个配方，多种 Harness：自进化在不同语言与模型间编码了什么
one_line: Holds a typed-failure-routed harness evolution recipe fixed across 8 languages × 3 models, evaluating evolved prompts/hooks/memory/tools on held-out instances and analyzing what they encode.
one_line_zh: 在 8 种语言×3 个模型上固定按类型化失败信号路由的 harness 进化配方，在留出实例上评测并分析进化产物编码内容。

title_zh: 个性化技能能帮助编码智能体吗？基于开发者交互历史的实证研究
one_line: Distills per-developer SKILL.md files from interaction histories, then replays held-out sessions with a simulator against no-skill, other-developer, and generic pooled-skill controls.
one_line_zh: 从开发者交互历史提炼个性化技能文件，用模拟器回放留出会话，并与无技能、他人技能和通用技能对照比较。

title_zh: AI4AI-Bench：面向递归自我改进的 LLM 智能体算法设计基准
one_line: Benchmark: agents get 4 GPU-hours to rewrite a frozen repository's training algorithm; submitted code is rerun from scratch and scored by a hidden fixed evaluator against the original.
one_line_zh: 基准让智能体用4小时改写冻结仓库的训练算法，提交代码从零重跑并由隐藏的固定评测器与原算法对比评分。

title_zh: LongWoF-Bench：在可验证长工作流任务上评估 EvoMap 基因
one_line: Benchmark of 778 verifiable long-workflow tasks comparing no context, Skills, and Genes distilled from verifier-confirmed trajectories of the same tasks, reused by seven consumer models.
one_line_zh: 含778个可验证长工作流任务的基准，比较无上下文、技能与由同一任务验证通过轨迹提炼的基因，供七个模型复用。

title_zh: EVOMAL：自进化编码智能体中的自我投毒
one_line: Attack planting banner-wrapped malicious skills that self-evolving coding agents imitate into newly authored stored skills, traced across rounds as a worm; proposes a counter-prompt defense.
one_line_zh: 植入带诱导横幅的恶意技能，使自进化编码智能体在新编写并存储的技能中复制载荷，跨轮追踪蠕虫式传播并提出反提示防御。

title_zh: S3Gym：LLM 能否把自我测试与自我评判转化为自我改进？
one_line: Game benchmark separating permissive exploration from strict held-out evaluation, comparing history-ICL, self-judged summary memory, and fine-tuning as ways to reuse self-generated experience.
one_line_zh: 游戏基准将宽松探索与严格留出评测分离，比较历史上下文、自评摘要记忆与微调三种复用自身经验的途径。

title_zh: Aspire：模型能否从模糊目标出发自我进化？
one_line: Benchmark giving agents only a vague capability goal to evolve weights or harness, scored on a hidden expert-authored evaluation set with overlap checks on agent-registered training data.
one_line_zh: 基准只给出模糊能力目标，让智能体进化权重或 harness，并在隐藏专家评测集上评分，对训练数据做重叠检查。

title_zh: 审计自改进智能体中的 Harness 篡改
one_line: Taxonomy and fault-seeded tampered/benign edit corpus for auditing harness tampering, benchmarking LLM auditors, then auditing real self-improvement runs for prevalence and lineage persistence.
one_line_zh: 提出 harness 篡改分类法与注入的篡改/良性编辑对语料，评测审计器，并审计真实自改进运行中篡改的普遍性与谱系持久性。

title_zh: HarnessDev：LLM 能否创建并进化自己的智能体 Harness？
one_line: Benchmark where creator LLMs build a harness from a weak seed, then evolve it from feedback-set results; frozen harnesses are scored on hidden held-out tasks with compliance audits.
one_line_zh: 基准让创建者 LLM 从弱种子构建 harness 并依反馈集结果进化，冻结后在隐藏留出任务上评分并做合规审计。

title_zh: SEABench：评测自进化智能体中的内生性失准
one_line: Longitudinal personal-assistant benchmark where agents evolve controller files, memory, or skills on benign tasks, then frozen agents face safety tests against paired non-evolving baselines.
one_line_zh: 纵向个人助理基准：智能体在良性任务上进化控制文件、记忆或技能，冻结后在安全测试中与配对的非进化基线比较。

title_zh: 理性智能体中策略与效用函数的自我修改
one_line: Formal analysis: an agent that can rewrite its policy or utility keeps its goals only if its value function anticipates modifications and uses the current utility.
one_line_zh: 形式化分析：只有当价值函数预见自我修改后果并用当前效用评估未来时，可自我修改的智能体才不会偏离目标。

title_zh: 递归自我改进的一种形式化及其可能的效率
one_line: Formalizes RSI as a Markov chain of program generators; a candidate replaces the incumbent only if a precomputed consistent score ranks it better.
one_line_zh: 将递归自我改进形式化为程序生成器的马尔可夫链，仅当预先计算的一致评分更优时才替换当前程序。

title_zh: 具备自我修改能力的有限理性智能体的性能
one_line: Theory: bounded-rational self-modifying agents can lose alignment exponentially under optimization error, while knowledge errors (misalignment, ignorance, impatience) do not compound.
one_line_zh: 理论分析：有限理性智能体自我修改时，优化误差会导致对齐指数级恶化，而知识误差不会随时间累积。

title_zh: 前瞻与回顾：面向长期个性化对话智能体的反思式记忆管理
one_line: Dialogue agent keeps topic-based memory (add/merge) and trains a lightweight reranker online with REINFORCE from the generator's own citations of retrieved memories.
one_line_zh: 对话智能体以主题粒度增补/合并记忆，并用生成器对检索记忆的引用作为奖励在线训练轻量重排器。

title_zh: AgentOrchestra：基于工具-环境-智能体（TEA）协议编排多智能体智能
one_line: Hierarchical multi-agent framework whose TEA protocol versions prompts, tools, agents and memory; TextGrad/self-reflection refine them from execution feedback and register new versions.
one_line_zh: 分层多智能体框架，TEA协议对提示、工具、智能体与记忆做版本管理，用TextGrad/自反思按执行反馈改进并注册新版本。

title_zh: SEDM：面向智能体的选择性自演化分布式记忆
one_line: Shared agent-society memory admits entries via paired replay A/B tests, reweights/retires them by measured utility, and a calibrated gate decides per task whether to inject memory.
one_line_zh: 智能体社会共享记忆：用成对重放A/B测试准入，按实测效用调权与淘汰，并用校准门控逐任务决定是否注入记忆。

title_zh: 从经验到策略：用可训练图记忆赋能LLM智能体
one_line: Graph memory distills trajectories into meta-cognition strategies; REINFORCE on guided-vs-unguided reward gaps learns edge weights, and top strategies prompt the agent during RL training.
one_line_zh: 图记忆将轨迹提炼为元认知策略，用有/无指导回报差经REINFORCE学习边权，并在RL训练中以提示注入高权策略。

title_zh: 记住我，完善我：面向经验驱动智能体演化的动态程序性记忆框架
one_line: Procedural memory distills success/failure/comparative experiences, admits via LLM-judge validation, dedup and success-only addition, and deletes entries whose recall-time success utility falls below threshold.
one_line_zh: 程序性记忆从成功、失败与对比中提炼经验，经LLM评审、去重与仅成功添加准入，并删除召回成功率低于阈值的条目。

title_zh: EvoRoute：经验驱动的自路由LLM智能体系统
one_line: Per-step model router appends every step's cost/latency/success record to an experience base and picks Pareto-optimal backbones via Thompson sampling over retrieved records.
one_line_zh: 逐步模型路由器将每步成本、时延与成功记录追加入经验库，并对检索记录做帕累托过滤与汤普森采样选择骨干模型。

title_zh: MemRL：基于情景记忆运行时强化学习的自演化智能体
one_line: Frozen-LLM agent stores intent-experience-utility triplets, retrieves by similarity then learned Q-value, updates Q from environment reward, and writes every summarized trajectory back.
one_line_zh: 冻结LLM的智能体以意图-经验-效用三元组存储记忆，先相似召回再按Q值选择，用环境奖励更新Q值并回写经验。

title_zh: AgentDevel：将自演化LLM智能体重构为发布工程
one_line: Single agent blueprint is revised from implementation-blind critic symptoms and executable diagnosis; one release candidate per iteration is promoted only under pass/fail flip gating on the dev set.
one_line_zh: 依据实现盲评审的症状与可执行诊断修改单一智能体蓝图，每轮一个候选版本，仅在开发集翻转门控通过时晋升。

title_zh: Live-Evo：基于持续反馈的智能体记忆在线演化
one_line: Online forecasting agent compiles guidelines from weighted experiences; memory-on vs memory-off contrastive runs update experience weights, and new experiences are committed only on significant re-evaluated gains.
one_line_zh: 在线预测智能体由加权经验编译指南，以有/无记忆对比运行更新经验权重，新经验仅在重评显著提升时写入。

title_zh: SAHOO：递归自我改进中面向高阶优化目标的安全对齐保障
one_line: Iterative self-refinement is monitored by a calibrated Goal Drift Index, constraint-preservation checks and regression-risk estimates, halting cycles on constraint violation first.
one_line_zh: 以校准的目标漂移指数、约束保持检查与回归风险估计监控迭代自我改进，并优先在约束违反时停止循环。

title_zh: Autogenesis：一种自演化智能体协议
one_line: Protocol registers prompts, agents, tools, environments and memory as versioned resources; a reflection loop proposes edits, a same-backbone self-evaluation assesses them, and accepted versions are committed.
one_line_zh: 协议将提示、智能体、工具、环境与记忆注册为带版本资源，反思循环提出修改，由同一骨干自评后提交被接受版本。

title_zh: EvoRAG：通过反馈反向传播使基于知识图谱的RAG自动演化
one_line: KG-RAG attributes response feedback to retrieved paths via LLM judging, backpropagates utility to per-triplet contribution scores, suppresses low-utility relations and fuses high-utility shortcuts.
one_line_zh: 知识图谱RAG用LLM评判将回答反馈归因到检索路径，再反传为三元组贡献分，抑制低效关系并融合高效捷径边。

title_zh: Prism：面向多智能体开放式发现的演化记忆基底
one_line: Multi-agent memory substrate with entropy-gated tiers, causal provenance graph, bandit-evolved retrieval strategies, and replicator-decay confidence that prunes low-fitness memories.
one_line_zh: 多智能体记忆基底：熵门控分层、带溯源的因果图、赌博机演化的检索策略，以及按复制者-衰减动力学修剪低适应度记忆。

title_zh: MemQ：在溯源DAG上将Q学习融入自演化记忆智能体
one_line: Frozen-LLM agent values episodic memories with Q-values, propagating TD(λ) credit backward through a provenance DAG of which memories produced which, ranking retrieval by similarity plus Q.
one_line_zh: 冻结LLM智能体为情景记忆维护Q值，沿记录记忆生成关系的溯源DAG反向传播TD(λ)信用，并按相似度加Q值检索。

title_zh: MAGE：基于协同演化知识图谱的多智能体自演化
one_line: Frozen learner retrieves from an append-only graph of teacher corrections and its own correct traces; retrieval/routing bandits learn from reward, with rollback of mutable slots.
one_line_zh: 冻结学习者从只增知识图谱检索教师写的纠错与自身正确推理，检索与路由赌博机由同一奖励更新，可变槽位可回滚。

title_zh: GraphMind：从运维轨迹到自演化的工作流自动化
one_line: Workflow graph extracted from incident traces guides multi-agent traversal; ant-colony reinforcement deposits weight on LLM-judged high-quality paths and decays stale edges.
one_line_zh: 从事件处理轨迹抽取工作流图指导多智能体遍历，蚁群式强化在LLM评判高质量路径上沉积权重并衰减陈旧边。

title_zh: SkillsVote：智能体技能从收集、推荐到演化的全生命周期治理
one_line: Skill library governance: agentic recommendation filters which skills are exposed, subtask-level outcome attribution decides responsibility, and only successful reusable discoveries pass evidence-gated edits or new skills.
one_line_zh: 技能库治理：智能体式推荐筛选暴露技能，子任务级结果归因判定责任，仅成功且可复用的发现经证据门控修改或新建技能。

title_zh: 库漂移：诊断并修复自演化LLM技能库中的一种静默失效模式
one_line: Frozen LLM writes, routes, and retires its own skills; outcome-driven retirement, bounded active cap and a meta-skill authoring prior govern which skills persist.
one_line_zh: 冻结LLM自写、路由并淘汰技能，用基于结果的淘汰、活跃上限与元技能写作先验来管理技能留存。

title_zh: Ratchet：LLM评审需要多可靠才能淘汰一个技能？
one_line: Skill library evicts skills on measured per-skill contribution under a width cap and authoring prior; proves when an LLM judge's error direction disables eviction.
one_line_zh: 技能库按实测贡献淘汰技能并限制容量，证明LLM评审哪类错误方向会使淘汰规则失效。

title_zh: 基于去中心化记忆的自演化多智能体系统
one_line: Each agent keeps private exploit/explore memory pools; an LLM judge's stage scores reweight pool routing, and all explored pieces are consolidated into memory.
one_line_zh: 每个智能体维护私有的利用/探索双记忆池，由LLM评审的阶段分数在线调整池路由权重，探索记忆全部并入。

title_zh: Verilog-Evolve：反馈驱动且技能自演化的Verilog生成
one_line: Verilog generator promotes tool-scored candidates across versions and evolves a skill registry from logged histories, gating new skills by verifiers and replay validation.
one_line_zh: 按工具反馈评分择优晋级Verilog候选版本，并从日志演化技能库，新技能经验证器与回放验证后发布。

title_zh: 自我改进智能体的相对可计算性理论
one_line: Theory: oracle-relative model of agents that revise solvers, evaluators and improvers; effective self-revision stays within the resource's Turing layer.
one_line_zh: 理论工作：以相对可计算性刻画可修改求解器、评估器与改进器的智能体，证明有效自我修订不越出资源对应的图灵层级。

title_zh: SkillBrew：面向LLM智能体技能库的多目标策展
one_line: Curates a skill bank via leave-one-out replay credit and Add/Rewrite/Remove edits, keeping candidate banks by Pareto selection on a held-out query split.
one_line_zh: 用留一回放评估技能边际贡献并增删改技能，在留出查询集上按效用约束的帕累托选择保留技能库。

title_zh: GRASP：面向自我改进LLM智能体的门控回归感知技能提议器
one_line: Edits a bounded skill library from grouped failures, committing an edit only if it nets fixes over regressions on a held-out probe under a hard regression budget.
one_line_zh: 按失败模式提议有界技能库的增改删，仅当在留出探针上净修复且不超回归预算时才提交编辑。

title_zh: PACE：面向自演化智能体的任意时刻有效接受检验
one_line: Prompt-evolving agent commits a proposed edit only when a paired testing-by-betting e-process versus the incumbent crosses an anytime-valid threshold, replacing greedy dev-score acceptance.
one_line_zh: 自演化提示的智能体仅在与现任配置配对比较的下注式e过程越过任意时刻有效阈值时才提交修改，取代贪心验证集接受。

title_zh: 经验成就技能：通过自演化技能记忆实现可泛化的医疗智能体推理
one_line: Medical agent distills trajectories into a branched skill repo, credits skills by category-normalized outcome advantage, and governs retrieval, promotion, merging, deprecation and capacity.
one_line_zh: 医疗智能体将轨迹蒸馏为多分支技能库，按类别归一化的结果优势估计技能效用，并据此检索、晋升、合并、淘汰与限容。

title_zh: VisualClaw：面向物理世界的实时个性化智能体
one_line: Multimodal agent evolves a skill bank from failures via a memory-conditioned offline evolver, with name dedup and pruning of skills whose hit rate lags the bank mean.
one_line_zh: 多模态智能体由记忆辅助的离线演化器从失败中更新技能库，并以名称去重和低于均值命中率的剪枝维护技能库。

title_zh: SkillWiki：面向智能体技能的活知识基础设施
one_line: Infrastructure turning knowledge materials into versioned skill assets with provenance graph, lifecycle states and Git-style review; execution feedback triggers maintenance proposals.
one_line_zh: 将知识材料转化为带溯源图、生命周期状态和Git式审阅的版本化技能资产的基础设施，执行反馈触发维护提案。

title_zh: EvolveNav：用于零样本目标导航的前瞻式预反思与自演化记忆
one_line: Navigation agent distills rules from each test episode, scores them by semantic-similarity credit, and ranks retrieval by UCB over rule success; rules are never removed.
one_line_zh: 导航智能体每回合从轨迹提炼规则，按语义相似度增益赋分，并以UCB结合历史成功率排序检索，规则不删除。

title_zh: 基于留出选择的递归自演化智能体
one_line: Frozen LLM rewrites a three-layer strategy/skills/playbook state from its trajectories, committing only strict improvements on a disjoint validation split with empty-state fallback.
one_line_zh: 冻结LLM依据自身轨迹重写策略/技能/操作手册三层状态，仅在不相交验证集上严格提升时提交，否则回退为空状态。

title_zh: M2Note：通过错题本学习实现视觉语言模型的持续演化
one_line: VLM turns failed answers into subject-guidance notes in a retrievable notebook; batch edits commit only if rerunning the same batch improves accuracy, else roll back.
one_line_zh: VLM将错误回答提炼为主题-指导笔记存入可检索错题本，批次更新仅在同批重跑准确率提升时提交，否则回滚。

title_zh: 具有任意时刻有效证书的自演化智能体
one_line: Frozen-base agent self-modifies a steering-directive adapter and versioned harness only through anytime-valid gates issuing certificates, fed by self-authored verifier signals.
one_line_zh: 冻结基座的智能体仅通过发出证书的任意时刻有效门控来修改引导适配器与版本化框架，信号来自自写验证器。

title_zh: 启发式自我改进智能体中自写验证不可靠
one_line: Agent co-evolves policy code and its own tests; SEAL accepts a candidate only if a sealed, agent-invisible audit shows no clear regression versus the incumbent.
one_line_zh: 智能体同时演化策略代码与自写测试；SEAL仅在智能体不可见的封闭审计显示无明显退化时接受候选，否则保留原状态。

title_zh: 自我改进LLM智能体中的记忆奖励膨胀
one_line: Self-graded episodic memory inflates scores of wrong episodes that compound through reuse; LUCID demotes stored rewards flagged by answer-free execution, degeneracy and grounding checks.
one_line_zh: 自评分情景记忆会抬高错误记忆的分数并经复用放大；LUCID用无答案的执行、退化与实体对照信号降低被标记记忆的存储奖励。

title_zh: Argus：面向长时程任务的通用智能体推理运行时
one_line: Manager/Planner/Engineer/Reviewer runtime persists memories, skills, verifiers and routing across missions, admitting them after role-owned review and task-native verification when available.
one_line_zh: 由管理者/规划者/工程师/评审者组成的运行时跨任务持久化记忆、技能、验证器与路由，经角色评审及可用的任务原生验证后才收录。

title_zh: 当自演化适得其反：针对LLM智能体技能污染的提交前门控
one_line: Distilled skills start invisible and enter the agent context only after schema, single-skill held-out A-B replay and LLM checks, then marginal-gain joint subset selection.
one_line_zh: 蒸馏出的技能默认不可见，须通过格式校验、留出集单技能A/B回放和LLM审查，再经边际增益联合子集选择才进入上下文。

title_zh: 从单一提示到功能库：演化功能库实现LLM持续学习
one_line: Replaces one optimized prompt with a repertoire of prompt functions; reflective updates commit only if train and validation improve and a historical consistency check passes, else spawn new functions.
one_line_zh: 以提示函数库取代单一优化提示，反思式更新须同时提升训练与验证表现并通过历史一致性检查才提交，否则新增函数。

title_zh: SCM：用自控记忆框架增强大语言模型
one_line: LLM agent appends every interaction (with summary and embedding) to a memory stream; an LLM controller decides when to retrieve and whether summaries suffice.
one_line_zh: 把每轮交互及其摘要、嵌入写入记忆流，由LLM控制器决定何时检索、用原文还是摘要。

title_zh: MemoryBank：为大语言模型增加长期记忆
one_line: Stores dialogue turns, LLM-written daily/global event and personality summaries in a dense-indexed bank, with Ebbinghaus-style decay reinforced on recall.
one_line_zh: 将对话、LLM生成的每日/全局事件与人格摘要存入稠密检索库，按艾宾浩斯遗忘曲线衰减、被召回则强化。

title_zh: MemGPT：迈向作为操作系统的大语言模型
one_line: LLM pages information between a fixed main context and external recall/archival storage via self-issued function calls, triggered by memory-pressure warnings.
one_line_zh: LLM通过自发函数调用在主上下文与外部召回/归档存储间分页搬运信息，由内存压力警告触发。

title_zh: 探索、选择、推导与回忆：用类人记忆增强大语言模型的移动任务自动化
one_line: Mobile agent stores completed tasks as parameterized sub-task function calls in a task/sub-task/action hierarchy and recalls and re-binds them on later instructions.
one_line_zh: 移动端智能体把完成的任务存为参数化子任务函数调用的三级层次记忆，在新指令中回忆并重新绑定参数复用。

title_zh: Richelieu：面向AI外交的自进化大语言模型智能体
one_line: Diplomacy agent logs per-turn states, negotiations, actions and sub-goals from self-play into memory, retrieving similar past experiences to reflect on new sub-goals.
one_line_zh: 外交智能体将自博弈中每回合的状态、谈判、行动与子目标记入记忆，检索相似经验来反思修正新子目标。

title_zh: 智能体工作流记忆
one_line: Web agent induces de-instantiated sub-routine workflows from training or self-judged successful trajectories and adds them to memory to guide later tasks.
one_line_zh: 网页智能体从训练样例或自判成功的轨迹中归纳去实例化的子流程工作流，写入记忆指导后续任务。

title_zh: CoPS：以可证明的跨任务经验共享增强LLM智能体
one_line: Agent appends trial trajectories to a memory bank and samples successful cross-task experiences by pessimism-based embedding-distance matching to the current initial state.
one_line_zh: 智能体将试次轨迹存入记忆库，按悲观原则的嵌入距离匹配从中采样成功的跨任务经验放入提示。

title_zh: 迈向智能安全的云：大语言模型赋能的主动防御
one_line: Multi-agent LLM DoS defense pipeline with a defense database of deployable mechanisms and a memory feedback loop that avoids repeating ineffective actions.
one_line_zh: 多智能体LLM云端DoS主动防御架构，含可部署防御库与避免重复无效动作的记忆反馈。

title_zh: ChemAgent：自更新库提升大语言模型的化学推理
one_line: Builds a library of decomposed chemistry sub-tasks with solutions from a development set, retrieves them by similarity threshold, and keeps adding newly solved sub-tasks at runtime.
one_line_zh: 从开发集分解化学题为子任务及解法建库，按相似度阈值检索，推理时持续加入新解出的子任务。

title_zh: Zep：面向智能体记忆的时序知识图谱架构
one_line: Agent memory service ingests conversations into a bi-temporal knowledge graph of episodes, LLM-extracted entities/facts with edge invalidation, and incrementally updated communities.
one_line_zh: 将对话写入双时态知识图谱：原始情节、LLM抽取的实体/事实及失效机制，并增量维护社区节点。

title_zh: MemInsight：面向LLM智能体的自主记忆增强
one_line: LLM annotates stored interactions with mined entity/conversation attributes, then retrieves memories by attribute filtering or attribute-embedding similarity.
one_line_zh: LLM为存储的交互自动挖掘实体/对话属性作标注，再按属性过滤或属性嵌入相似度检索记忆。

title_zh: 面向真实临床交互的自进化多智能体模拟
one_line: Clinical simulation where doctor agents store correctly diagnosed cases and corrected-misdiagnosis reflections in KNN-retrieved buffers reused in later consultations.
one_line_zh: 临床模拟中医生智能体把诊断正确的病例与纠错反思分别存入缓冲区，后续问诊用KNN检索复用。

title_zh: 从实践中获取经验：具备记录与回放能力的LLM智能体
one_line: Proposes recording agent or user traces, summarizing them into multi-level experiences with user-audited check functions, and replaying them on similar tasks via an experience store.
one_line_zh: 提出记录智能体或用户轨迹，归纳为多层级经验并配用户审核的检查函数，在相似任务中通过经验库回放。

title_zh: AI智能体的记忆操作系统
one_line: Three-tier dialogue memory (short/mid/long-term persona) with FIFO migration, topic-segmented paging, heat-based eviction and promotion, and two-stage segment-then-page retrieval.
one_line_zh: 三级对话记忆（短期/中期/长期人格），FIFO迁移、按主题分段分页、热度淘汰与晋升，先段后页两阶段检索。

title_zh: G-Memory：面向多智能体系统的层次化记忆追踪
one_line: Multi-agent memory as insight/query/interaction graphs: retrieve similar queries, traverse up to insights and down to sparsified dialogues per agent role, then append new nodes and insights.
one_line_zh: 以洞见/查询/交互三层图管理多智能体记忆：检索相似查询，向上取洞见、向下取精简对话按角色注入，再追加新节点与洞见。

title_zh: EXPEREPAIR：双记忆增强的LLM仓库级程序修复
one_line: Repair agents store past repair trajectories as BM25-retrieved episodic demonstrations and LLM-edited capped semantic insights, composing prompts from both for new issues.
one_line_zh: 修复智能体把历史修复轨迹存为BM25检索的情景示例和LLM增删改、限量的语义洞见，组合成新问题的提示。

title_zh: Xolver：像奥赛团队一样进行整体经验学习的多智能体推理
one_line: Multi-agent reasoning loop with judge-scored shared memory, BM25 episodic retrieval, and an episodic store that appends each solved problem's top-ranked trace for later problems.
one_line_zh: 多智能体迭代推理，评审打分的共享记忆+BM25情景检索，并把每题最优推理轨迹追加进情景库供后续题使用。

title_zh: NavMorph：面向连续环境视觉语言导航的自进化世界模型
one_line: VLN world model with a Contextual Evolution Memory of scene features retrieved by cosine top-k and refined by forward updates during training and online testing.
one_line_zh: 视觉语言导航世界模型，含场景特征的上下文进化记忆，按余弦top-k检索并在训练与在线测试中前向更新。

title_zh: Agent KB：利用跨领域经验进行智能体问题求解
one_line: Shared cross-framework knowledge base of abstracted trajectories from other benchmarks, hybrid-retrieved at planning and feedback stages, adapted, and applied only through a disagreement gate.
one_line_zh: 跨框架共享知识库，存入其他基准轨迹抽象出的经验，在规划与反馈阶段混合检索、改写，并经分歧门控后才采用。

title_zh: MLC-Agent：LLM赋能智能体仿真环境中基于记忆-学习协同的认知模型
one_line: Artificial-society agent model with individual memory, a buffer pool, and a collective memory set, promoting buffered items to the group store by multi-indicator evaluation.
one_line_zh: 人工社会智能体模型，含个体记忆、缓冲池与群体记忆集，按多指标评估把缓冲项晋升到群体记忆。

title_zh: 面向LLM智能体高效长期推理的层次化记忆
one_line: LLM extracts each dialogue into a four-layer domain/category/trace/episode memory whose vectors carry child pointers for top-down index-routed retrieval, with feedback-weighted forgetting.
one_line_zh: LLM把每轮对话抽取为领域/类别/记忆痕迹/情节四层记忆，向量带子指针以自顶向下索引路由检索，并按反馈调权遗忘。

title_zh: SWE-Exp：经验驱动的软件问题修复
one_line: Extracts generalized comprehension and modification experiences from ground-truth-labeled success/failure repair trajectories, indexes them by issue type, and injects one reranked experience per new issue.
one_line_zh: 从按真值标注成败的修复轨迹中抽取泛化的理解与修改经验，按问题类型建索引，为新问题注入一条重排后的经验。

title_zh: 看、听、记、推理：具有长期记忆的多模态智能体
one_line: Multimodal agent builds an entity-centric episodic/semantic memory graph from video streams with a fine-tuned memorizer, and an RL-trained controller retrieves it over multiple turns.
one_line_zh: 多模态智能体用微调的记忆模型从视频流构建以实体为中心的情节/语义记忆图，由RL训练的控制器多轮检索作答。

title_zh: Memento：无需微调大模型即可微调LLM智能体
one_line: Deep-research planner stores (task, plan, success) cases in a case bank and retrieves them by similarity or an online soft-Q-learned retrieval policy to guide planning.
one_line_zh: 深度研究规划器把（任务、计划、成败）案例存入案例库，按相似度或在线软Q学习的检索策略取回案例指导规划。

title_zh: SEFRQO：自演化的微调RAG查询优化器
one_line: Keeps a vector store of past query executions and their latencies, retrieving similar-query records and same-query history into prompts so hint generation improves with repeated runs.
one_line_zh: 维护历史查询执行与延迟的向量库，检索相似查询与同查询历史拼入提示，使提示随重复执行不断改进。

title_zh: SGMem：面向长期对话智能体的句子图记忆
one_line: Organizes dialogue history into sentence-level graphs linked to turn/round/session chunks plus LLM-generated summaries/facts, retrieved by similarity and graph expansion for QA.
one_line_zh: 把对话历史组织为句子级图并链接到轮次/会话块与LLM生成的摘要事实，通过相似度与图扩展检索用于问答。

title_zh: 利用仓库记忆改进代码定位
one_line: Gives a localization agent tools over episodic memory of prior commits/issues and LLM summaries of frequently edited files, built from repository history before each issue.
one_line_zh: 为代码定位智能体提供基于历史提交/问题的情景记忆与高频修改文件摘要的语义记忆检索工具。

title_zh: CAM：面向LLM阅读理解的建构主义智能体记忆
one_line: Builds hierarchical reading memory over document chunks via incremental overlapping clustering with LLM summaries, locally updated per batch and explored by prune-and-grow retrieval.
one_line_zh: 用增量重叠聚类与LLM摘要把文档块组织成层次记忆，按批局部更新，并以剪枝-生长策略检索。

title_zh: MemoTime：记忆增强的时序知识图谱LLM推理
one_line: Temporal KGQA agent stores LLM-verified sub-question traces and toolkit choices in an experience pool, retrieved by temporal type and similarity for later questions.
one_line_zh: 时序知识图谱问答中把经LLM验证的子问题推理轨迹与工具选择存入经验池，按时序类型与相似度检索复用。

title_zh: RGMem：受重整化群启发的语言智能体记忆演化
one_line: Turns dialogue into episodic facts and a hierarchical knowledge graph, updating relation and concept summaries via LLM only when accumulated evidence crosses thresholds, forming an evolving user profile.
one_line_zh: 将对话转为情景事实与层次知识图谱，仅当证据累积超过阈值时由LLM更新关系与概念摘要，形成演化的用户画像。

title_zh: LightMem：轻量高效的记忆增强生成
one_line: Compresses dialogue tokens, segments by topic into LLM-summarized memory entries, inserts them online and defers deduplication/consolidation to offline parallel sleep-time updates.
one_line_zh: 压缩对话token并按主题分段生成LLM摘要记忆条目，在线直接插入，把去重与整合推迟到离线并行的睡眠期更新。

title_zh: WebCoach：具有跨会话记忆指导的自演化网页智能体
one_line: Condenses completed web-navigation trajectories into an embedding memory; a coach LLM retrieves similar episodes and injects advice only when it predicts failure or a better path.
one_line_zh: 把完成的网页导航轨迹压缩存入向量记忆，教练LLM检索相似经验，仅在预测失败或有更优路径时注入建议。

title_zh: 基于深度研究的通用智能体记忆
one_line: Memorizer writes lightweight memos plus full raw pages to a page-store; at request time a researcher agent plans, searches, and reflects over pages to compile a task-specific context.
one_line_zh: 记忆器写入轻量备忘与完整原始页面存储；请求时研究者智能体规划、检索并反思，即时编译任务专用上下文。

title_zh: TeleMem：为智能体AI构建长期多模态记忆
one_line: Batches dialogue summaries, clusters them with retrieved memories for LLM consolidation, and organizes nodes into a pruned temporal DAG with local re-insertion and closure-based retrieval.
one_line_zh: 批量摘要对话、与检索到的记忆聚类后由LLM整合，并组织为剪枝的时序DAG，支持局部重插入与闭包式检索。

title_zh: ExpSeek：网页智能体的自触发经验寻求
one_line: Builds a topic-grouped base of mistake/guidance triplets from paired train trajectories; at inference, step entropy thresholds trigger an experience model to generate step-level guidance.
one_line_zh: 由训练集成功/失败轨迹对构建按主题分组的错误-指导三元组库；推理时以步级熵阈值触发经验模型生成指导。

title_zh: 超越RAG的智能体记忆：通过解耦与聚合进行检索
one_line: Decouples interaction segments into memory components, groups them under a sparsity–faithfulness objective with incremental split/merge, and retrieves top-down with uncertainty-gated expansion to raw text.
one_line_zh: 把交互片段解耦为记忆组件，以稀疏-语义忠实目标增量分裂/合并成组，自顶向下检索并按不确定性决定是否展开原文。

title_zh: Memora：兼顾抽象与具体性的和谐记忆表示
one_line: Stores memory entries under LLM-induced primary abstractions with create-or-merge consolidation and many-to-many cue anchors, retrieved by a budgeted policy that traverses abstraction and cue links.
one_line_zh: 以LLM归纳的主抽象组织记忆条目并创建或合并，辅以多对多线索锚点，由带预算的策略沿抽象与锚点链接检索。

title_zh: 面向软件工程智能体的结构对齐子任务级记忆
one_line: Segments SWE agent trajectories into categorized subtasks, distills de-instantiated experience per subtask via LLM, and retrieves by category filter then intent similarity, accumulating online.
one_line_zh: 将软件工程智能体轨迹切分为带类别的子任务，用LLM提炼去实例化经验，先按类别过滤再按意图相似检索，在线累积。

title_zh: 让代码智能体借助结构化记忆与你共同成长
one_line: LLM-structures past commits into keyword-indexed problem/root-cause/solution entries retrieved with reranking for a SWE agent, and internalizes human-validated solutions into long-term memory.
one_line_zh: 用LLM把历史提交结构化为关键词索引的问题/根因/方案条目，经重排检索供代码智能体使用，并把人工验证的方案写回长期记忆。

title_zh: CLAG：面向小模型智能体的智能体驱动聚类自适应记忆组织
one_line: An SLM routes memory notes into profiled clusters, evolves and links notes only within the assigned cluster, and retrieves by first selecting clusters via profiles.
one_line_zh: 小模型把记忆笔记路由到带画像的簇中，仅在所属簇内链接与演化，检索时先按簇画像选簇再簇内检索。

title_zh: ArtiCAD：基于多智能体代码生成的铰接CAD装配设计
one_line: Multi-agent CAD assembly generator with design-stage connector contracts and cross-stage rollback; a secondary experience store accumulates Review-Agent design knowledge for retrieval in later tasks.
one_line_zh: 多智能体CAD装配生成，设计阶段确定连接器契约并跨阶段回滚；辅以经验库累积评审智能体的设计知识供后续任务检索。

title_zh: Thought-Retriever：不只检索原始数据，而是检索记忆增强智能体系统中的“思考”
one_line: After answering queries, an LLM distills query-conditioned thoughts, admits them by self-rated confidence and novelty threshold, and retrieves thoughts alongside raw chunks for later queries.
one_line_zh: 回答查询后由LLM提炼与查询相关的“思考”，按自评置信度与新颖性阈值写入记忆，之后与原始片段一同检索。

title_zh: MEMRES：面向智能体Python依赖解析的记忆增强置信级联求解器
one_line: Dependency resolver with a deterministic confidence cascade over curated KBs, plus intra-session memory of Docker-validated shortcuts reused on similar import sets; LLM only as last resort.
one_line_zh: 依赖解析器以人工整理知识库的确定性置信级联为主，辅以会话内记忆复用经Docker验证的相似导入解法，LLM仅作兜底。

title_zh: GenericAgent：通过最大化上下文信息密度实现高效token的自演化LLM智能体
one_line: General agent with minimal atomic tools, a hierarchical memory exposing only a small always-on layer, trajectory-to-SOP/code self-evolution, and context truncation to keep context dense.
one_line_zh: 通用智能体采用极简原子工具、仅常驻小型索引层的分层按需记忆、把轨迹沉淀为SOP与代码的自演化，以及上下文截断压缩。

title_zh: 迈向多智能体系统中自我改进的错误诊断
one_line: MAS failure-attribution team that commits diagnosed error patterns to an episodic memory only after tool-grounded reproduction and arbiter confidence, retrieving them by signature with a strict threshold.
one_line_zh: 多智能体失败归因团队仅在工具复现与仲裁置信度通过后才把错误模式写入情景记忆，并按签名以严格阈值检索复用。

title_zh: 重新思考自演化语言模型智能体中的经验利用
one_line: Keeps existing frameworks' experience stores unchanged and lets the agent emit a retrieve token mid-reasoning to consult experience only when needed, versus init-only and always-on injection.
one_line_zh: 保持各框架经验库构建不变，让智能体在推理中按需发出检索标记调用经验，并与仅初始化注入和每步注入对比。

title_zh: RFAmpDesigner：面向射频放大器自动设计的自演化多智能体LLM框架
one_line: Multi-agent LNA sizing via a resource-allocation tool middleware over simulators; a RAG experience base reuses past designs in a retrieve-and-refine mode.
one_line_zh: 通过资源分配工具中间件调用仿真器进行多智能体低噪放尺寸设计，并以RAG经验库在检索-精修模式中复用历史设计。

title_zh: GRAFT-ATHENA：用于自主发现与演化数值算法的自我改进智能体团队
one_line: Encodes problems and methods as factored scientific graphs with semantic fingerprints; a solved-case repository of evaluated method outcomes and rewards forms similarity-weighted priors for new problems.
one_line_zh: 把问题与方法编码为分解的科学图并生成语义指纹；已解案例库记录方法结果与奖励，按指纹相似度为新问题构造先验。

title_zh: DrugSAGE：面向高效最先进药物发现的自进化智能体经验
one_line: Accumulates cross-task memory of sandbox-validated skills, solution/edit records and error fixes from drug-prediction searches, reusing it to guide MCTS or transfer solutions zero-shot.
one_line_zh: 跨任务积累经沙箱验证的技能、解与编辑记录及报错修复，用于引导MCTS搜索或零搜索直接迁移解。

title_zh: TopoEvo：面向微服务根因分析的拓扑感知自进化多智能体框架
one_line: Microservice RCA multi-agent system whose self-evolving module refreshes a hierarchical incident memory keyed by VQ symptom tokens and adapts the encoder with high-confidence pseudo-labels.
one_line_zh: 微服务根因分析多智能体框架，自进化模块以VQ症状token为键刷新分层事故记忆，并用高置信伪标签做测试时适配。

title_zh: H-Mem：基于混合结构的智能体记忆演化与检索新机制
one_line: Organizes conversational agent memory into an incrementally built temporal-semantic summary tree plus entity knowledge graph, retrieved via query decomposition, graph expansion and scoped tree search.
one_line_zh: 将对话记忆增量组织为时间-语义摘要树与实体知识图谱，通过查询分解、图扩展与限定范围的树检索取证。

title_zh: MemRepair：面向智能体仓库级漏洞修复的分层记忆
one_line: Vulnerability-repair agent with three memory tiers (historical fixes, oracle-verified security insights, failure-to-success trajectories), retrieved by project/CWE/language priority and grown from verified repairs.
one_line_zh: 漏洞修复智能体，含历史修复、经验证的安全模式与失败到成功轨迹三层记忆，按项目/CWE/语言优先级检索，仅积累验证通过的修复。

title_zh: EXG：基于经验图的自进化智能体
one_line: Turns each attempt into a golden or warning case node in a growing experience graph with task, similarity and fix edges; retrieves, reranks and injects capped hints.
one_line_zh: 将每次尝试抽象为成功/警示案例节点加入经验图（任务、相似、修复边），检索重排后注入有上限的经验提示。

title_zh: EvoIR-Agent：基于经验驱动学习的自进化图像复原智能体系统
one_line: Image-restoration agent keeps a hierarchical experience pool (insight, degradation-type, degradation-pattern) of tool/order rankings, re-estimated from IQA-scored exhaustive tool trials via Bradley-Terry-Davidson updates.
one_line_zh: 图像复原智能体维护洞察/退化类型/退化模式三级经验池，用IQA评分的穷举工具试验经BTD模型迭代更新工具与顺序排序。

title_zh: SetupX：LLM智能体能否在功能正确的代码仓库环境配置中从过往失败中学习？
one_line: Repository-setup agent distills trajectories into indexed experience units (error signals, advice, executable atoms) with outcome telemetry, retrieving and trialing them under snapshot rollback.
one_line_zh: 仓库环境配置智能体把轨迹蒸馏为带错误信号索引、建议与可执行操作的经验单元并记录成效遥测，检索后在快照回滚下试用。

title_zh: EvoRepair：通过基于经验的自进化增强漏洞修复智能体
one_line: Vulnerability-repair agent cyclically retrieves past repair experiences, extracts new ones from repair trajectories, and updates an experience bank with quality-aware scoring.
one_line_zh: 漏洞修复智能体循环检索历史修复经验、从修复轨迹提取新经验，并以质量感知评分更新经验库。

title_zh: 任意场景检测：具备经验感知推理的目标检测智能体框架
one_line: Agentic detector composes restoration and detector tools; DetAS-X adds a profile-keyed memory of per-node tool performance harvested once from 50 annotated training images.
one_line_zh: 智能体式检测框架组合复原与检测工具；DetAS-X 额外用50张带标注训练图一次性收集按场景画像索引的各决策节点工具表现记忆。

title_zh: OctoT2I：自进化智能体式文生图路由器
one_line: T2I router builds a tool knowledge base from scratch via a Propose-Solve-Evaluate-Learn loop over self-defined concept combinations, storing verifier-scored prompt records and tool profiles.
one_line_zh: 文生图路由智能体通过对自定义概念维度组合执行提出-求解-评估-学习循环，从零构建记录验证器评分提示与工具画像的知识库。

title_zh: EvoMemNav：面向零样本具身导航的高效自进化细粒度记忆
one_line: Navigation agent keeps raw views in a room-view-object memory graph, searches it with a budgeted coarse-to-fine VLM policy, and writes subtask outcomes back as graph-attached priors.
one_line_zh: 导航智能体以房间-视角-物体记忆图保存原始视图，用预算化粗到细VLM策略检索，并把子任务结果作为图上先验回写。

title_zh: 基于自进化多智能体数字孪生的自主多相催化剂发现
one_line: Catalysis multi-agent digital twin whose NEB-endpoint design loop stores reward-labelled cases, knowledge and skill templates, retrieved Memento-style with a bandit-chosen workflow strategy.
one_line_zh: 催化数字孪生多智能体系统，其NEB端点设计环存储带奖励的案例、知识与技能模板，按Memento式检索并由bandit选择工作流策略。

title_zh: 超越回忆的记忆：面向自进化LLM智能体的双过程认知记忆系统
one_line: User-memory system: a synchronous writer stores facts with doubly linked supersedes chains; an asynchronous nightly engine induces schemas, intentions and cross-domain core schemas linked to evidence.
one_line_zh: 用户记忆系统：同步写入器以双向替代链记录事实修订，异步夜间引擎归纳图式、意图与跨领域核心图式并链接证据。

title_zh: FinAcumen：基于自进化经验记忆框架的金融多模态推理
one_line: Financial VLM agent distills gold-scored training trajectories into a frozen memory of strategies and cautionary rules, injected only above a similarity threshold with fallback, alongside deterministic tools.
one_line_zh: 金融多模态智能体把按标准答案评分的训练轨迹蒸馏为策略与警示规则的冻结记忆，仅在相似度超阈值时注入否则回退，并配确定性工具。

title_zh: PixJail：面向文生图越狱评测的自进化论文到流水线复现
one_line: Paper-to-pipeline agent reproduces T2I jailbreak papers via planner-implementor-auditor loops and writes digests, templates, failures and artifacts into a memory bank reused for later reproductions.
one_line_zh: 论文到流水线智能体以规划-实现-审计循环复现文生图越狱论文，并把摘要、模板、失败案例与产物写入记忆库供后续复现复用。

title_zh: 面向C到可综合C转换与验证的证据驱动LLM智能体
one_line: C-to-HLS-C repair agent closed by a four-stage Vitis verifier, with mismatch localization and a family-routed repair-card RAG pool grown from human-audited successful repair chains.
one_line_zh: 由Vitis四阶段验证器闭环的C到HLS-C修复智能体，配不匹配定位链与按故障族路由的修复卡RAG池，卡池由人工审核的成功修复链扩充。

title_zh: 基于审慎规划与直觉执行的自进化智能体图像复原
one_line: Restoration agent stores reward-passing P-MCTS tool trajectories in an episodic memory keyed by quantized degradation fingerprints, reusing them through a reward-verified shortcut gate with search fallback.
one_line_zh: 复原智能体将通过奖励阈值的P-MCTS工具轨迹存入以量化退化指纹为键的情景记忆，经奖励校验门复用，否则回退搜索。

title_zh: 经验图：自我改进智能体的数据基础
one_line: Position/system paper: store agents' reward-bearing search trees as governed database state (Trellis), enabling vector-seeded cross-session reuse, recovery and training views; demonstrated on KernelEvolve.
one_line_zh: 立场/系统论文：把智能体带奖励的搜索树作为受治理的数据库状态（Trellis）存储，支持向量种子跨会话复用、恢复与训练视图，在KernelEvolve上展示。

title_zh: AgRefactor：面向HLS兼容性与性能的自进化智能体工作流
one_line: HLS-refactoring multi-agent workflow accumulates de-identified plans and log-derived critiques from training programs, retrieving top matches by program-plus-item distance for unseen programs, plus tool integration.
one_line_zh: HLS重构多智能体工作流从训练程序积累去标识化的计划与基于日志的批评，按程序与问题项联合距离为新程序检索，并集成自动重构工具。

title_zh: Harness Handbook：让持续演化的智能体框架可读、可导航、可编辑
one_line: Builds a behavior-centric L1-L3 handbook of an agent harness codebase with source-validated locators, guides edit planning by progressive disclosure, and incrementally resynchronizes it after each diff.
one_line_zh: 从智能体框架代码自动构建以行为为中心、带源码校验定位符的L1–L3手册，以渐进披露引导修改规划，并在每次代码变更后增量重同步。

title_zh: MemoHarness：从经验中学习的智能体框架
one_line: Searches a six-dimension agent harness using a dual-layer bank of per-case diagnoses and distilled patterns, then adapts the global harness per test case from the frozen bank.
one_line_zh: 在六维可编辑框架空间中借助逐案诊断与蒸馏全局模式的双层经验库搜索全局框架，测试时用冻结经验库按案例自适应。

title_zh: AnchorGUI：面向GUI导航双尺度学习的非对称记忆
one_line: GUI agent records expected-versus-observed transition verdicts per step, keeps screenshots only for mismatches, and distills a cross-trial rule set from this asymmetric memory for retries.
one_line_zh: GUI智能体逐步记录预期与观测转移的一致性判定，仅为不一致步骤保留截图，并从该非对称记忆蒸馏跨尝试规则集用于重试。

title_zh: 有界递归自我改进
one_line: Seed-based autocatalytic architecture that models itself and environment from experience, scheduling reasoning threads by value; abstract only, no measurable evidence.
one_line_zh: 基于种子的自催化架构，随经验积累对自身与环境建模并按价值调度推理线程；仅有摘要。

title_zh: Promptbreeder：通过提示进化实现自指式自我改进
one_line: Evolves task-prompts with LLM mutation governed by mutation-prompts that are themselves evolved (hyper-mutation); units selected by task-prompt fitness on training batches.
one_line_zh: 用LLM按变异提示进化任务提示，变异提示自身也被超变异进化；按训练批上任务提示适应度选择单元。

title_zh: 自学优化器（STOP）：递归自我改进的代码生成
one_line: A seed LM-scaffolded improver program is run on its own code; the improved improver is scored by the utility of programs it produces downstream.
one_line_zh: 以语言模型脚手架的种子改进器改进自身代码，按其在下游任务产出程序的效用评估改进后的改进器。

title_zh: 哥德尔智能体：用于递归自我改进的自指智能体框架
one_line: LLM agent inspects and monkey-patches its own runtime code, including its self-update logic, guided by validation-set utility feedback; final optimized agent tested on test set.
one_line_zh: LLM智能体通过猴子补丁读取并改写自身运行时代码（含自我更新逻辑），以验证集效用为反馈，最终在测试集上评估。

title_zh: 一个自我改进的编码智能体
one_line: Coding agent edits its own codebase (tools, sub-agents, prompts); best archived agent becomes next meta-agent, selected by benchmark-score/time/cost utility on fixed subsets.
one_line_zh: 编码智能体改写自身代码库（工具、子智能体、提示），以固定子集上的分数/时间/成本效用选出最优存档智能体作下一轮元智能体。

title_zh: metaTextGrad：自动优化语言模型优化器
one_line: A meta-optimizer rewrites LLM optimizers' prompts and composes optimizers into new structures, scoring each optimizer by the task performance of programs it optimizes.
one_line_zh: 元优化器改写LLM优化器的提示并组合优化器结构，以其所优化程序的任务表现为优化器打分。

title_zh: 赫胥黎-哥德尔机：通过近似最优自我改进机器实现人类水平的编码智能体开发
one_line: Self-modifying coding agents grow a tree; parents chosen by Thompson sampling on estimated clade-metaproductivity (descendants' benchmark success), with expansion and evaluation decoupled.
one_line_zh: 自修改编码智能体构成树，按估计的谱系元生产力（后代基准成功率）用汤普森采样选父节点，扩展与评估解耦。

title_zh: MemEvolve：智能体记忆系统的元进化
one_line: Outer loop diagnoses and redesigns modular memory architectures (encode/store/retrieve/manage code), scoring each by inner-loop task success, tokens and latency after accumulating experience.
one_line_zh: 外层循环诊断并重设计模块化记忆架构（编码/存储/检索/管理代码），按内层积累经验后的任务成功率、token与延迟打分。

title_zh: 通过智能体技能进化实现元上下文工程
one_line: Meta-agent evolves context-engineering skills (instructions+code) by agentic crossover over skill history; base agent executes them to build context files; best kept by validation score.
one_line_zh: 元智能体基于技能历史以智能体交叉进化上下文工程技能（指令+代码），基础智能体执行技能构建上下文文件，按验证分保留最优。

title_zh: MemSkill：为自进化智能体学习并进化记忆技能
one_line: Memory operations become an evolving skill bank: RL controller selects skills, fixed LLM designer refines/adds skills from hard cases, rolling back skill banks that degrade performance.
one_line_zh: 将记忆操作变为可进化技能库：RL控制器选技能，固定LLM设计器依据困难案例改进/新增技能，性能下降则回滚。

title_zh: 群体进化智能体：通过经验共享实现开放式自我改进
one_line: Self-editing coding agents evolve as groups: parents picked by performance-novelty from an archive, sharing pooled evolutionary traces to generate framework patches; compiling offspring archived.
one_line_zh: 自改写编码智能体以群体为单位进化：按性能-新颖度从存档选父群，共享汇总进化轨迹生成框架补丁，可编译后代入档。

title_zh: 通过元学习智能体记忆设计实现持续学习的学习
one_line: A meta agent samples an archive of code-level memory designs (update/retrieve), proposes new ones, scores each by a fixed agent's deployment success after memory collection.
one_line_zh: 元智能体从代码级记忆设计（更新/检索）存档中采样并提出新设计，以固定智能体在记忆收集后的部署成功率打分。

title_zh: 双层自动研究：对自动研究本身进行元自动研究
one_line: An outer LLM loop reads the inner autoresearch loop's code and traces, generates and injects Python search mechanisms at runtime; inner loop keeps changes improving val_bpb.
one_line_zh: 外层LLM循环读取内层自动研究循环的代码与轨迹，运行时生成并注入Python搜索机制；内层按val_bpb保留改动。

title_zh: Meta-TTL：为语言智能体元学习自我改进策略
one_line: Meta-learns the natural-language meta-prompt governing cross-episode prompt rewriting via reflective meta-training; candidates replace the incumbent only if balanced validation TTL improvement is positive.
one_line_zh: 以反思式元训练学习控制跨回合提示改写的元提示，候选仅在验证集平衡改进分为正时替换现任。

title_zh: M*：每个任务都值得拥有自己的记忆框架
one_line: Evolves task-specific memory programs (Python schema, storage logic, instructions) via reflective coding-agent mutation over a softmax-sampled population, selected on static validation, reported on held-out test.
one_line_zh: 以反思式编码智能体变异与softmax采样种群进化任务专属记忆程序（模式、存储逻辑、指令），按静态验证集选择、留出测试集报告。

title_zh: 你将构建的最后一个框架
one_line: Proposes a harness evolution loop (worker, adversarial evaluator, evolution agent) plus a meta-loop that rewrites the whole blueprint, including evaluator and scoring; no experiments reported.
one_line_zh: 提出由执行者、对抗评估者、进化智能体组成的框架进化循环，以及改写整个蓝图（含评估器与打分）的元循环；无实验。

title_zh: AEL：在开放式环境中进化智能体框架
one_line: Thompson-sampling bandit picks memory-retrieval policies per episode; slow LLM reflection diagnoses degradation and injects new retrieval policies as bandit arms; learning frozen at test.
one_line_zh: 汤普森采样老虎机逐回合选择记忆检索策略；慢速LLM反思诊断性能下降并注入新检索策略为新臂；测试时冻结学习。

title_zh: EvolveMem：通过自动研究实现LLM智能体的自进化记忆架构
one_line: LLM diagnosis reads per-question failure logs and adjusts a structured retrieval-configuration action space; a meta-analyzer reverts regressions; evolution scored on the evaluation questions.
one_line_zh: LLM诊断模块读取逐题失败日志并调整结构化检索配置空间，元分析器回滚退化；进化以评测问题得分为目标。

title_zh: SePO：用于系统提示优化的自进化提示智能体
one_line: A prompt agent optimizes task agents' system prompts and its own via archive-based evolutionary search; pre-trained on a multi-task pool, then fine-tuned per target task.
one_line_zh: 提示智能体以基于存档的进化搜索同时优化任务智能体与自身的系统提示；先在多任务池预训练，再针对目标任务微调。

title_zh: MetaSkill-Evolve：通过双时间尺度元技能进化实现LLM智能体递归自我改进
one_line: Each branch carries a task skill and a five-part meta-skill parameterizing the improvement pipeline; fast loop evolves skills, slow loop applies the same pipeline to meta-skills by meta-productivity.
one_line_zh: 每个分支携带任务技能与参数化改进流程的五部分元技能；快循环进化任务技能，慢循环按元生产力用同一流程进化元技能。

title_zh: 孟德尔-哥德尔机：通过比较式进化实现递归自我改进的编码智能体
one_line: Archive-based self-modifying coding agents add reaction-norm mutation (multi-task trajectories) and cross-lineage hybridization (reference agent on same task) to HGM's Thompson-sampled tree search.
one_line_zh: 基于存档的自修改编码智能体，在HGM的汤普森采样树搜索上增加反应规范变异（多任务轨迹）与跨谱系杂交（同任务参考智能体）。

title_zh: Ouroboros：通过审查式核心进化实现自我开发的前沿编码智能体
one_line: Agent harness rewrites its own tools, prompts, context assembly and core code through LLM-reviewed commits, driven by free-evolution tasks and work/social feedback; frozen snapshots benchmarked.
one_line_zh: 智能体框架经LLM审查的提交改写自身工具、提示、上下文组装与核心代码，由自由进化任务与工作/社交反馈驱动；以冻结快照评测。

title_zh: Meta^n：通过涌现深度实现递归自我改进
one_line: A fixed meta-operation repeatedly reads solver-stack traces and code, writing new layers (pre-process plus helper library); depth grows until no improvement, with an archive over layer chains.
one_line_zh: 固定元操作反复读取求解器栈的轨迹与代码，写出新层（预处理与辅助函数库），深度增长至不再改进，并以存档搜索层链。

title_zh: MetaRSI / RSI2：面向递归自我改进系统本身的元递归自我改进系统
one_line: Composes Data-, Harness- and Model-RSI operators under one loop kernel with fixed adjudication; a scheduler orders operators and rewrites their proposal policies, and a meta agent revises scheduling.
one_line_zh: 在固定裁决的统一循环内核下组合数据、框架与模型三类RSI算子；调度器决定顺序并改写算子提议策略，元智能体修订调度规则。

title_zh: AI研究智能体的递归自我改进
one_line: An outer research agent rewrites the inner research agent's code (search policy, memory), accepting a rewrite only if its fixed-budget grade on private held-out task data improves.
one_line_zh: 外层研究智能体改写内层研究智能体代码（搜索策略、记忆），仅当其在固定预算下私有留出数据上的评分提升时才接受。

title_zh: SelfSearch：面向自我改进智能体的无奖励搜索
one_line: Agents edit their own repository using records of previous self-modification episodes, with no downstream rewards during search; each successor becomes the next improver across two lineages.
one_line_zh: 智能体利用以往自修改回合的记录改写自身代码库，搜索期间不使用下游奖励；每个后继成为下一轮改进者，共两条谱系。

title_zh: AutoML-Zero：从零开始进化机器学习算法
one_line: Regularized evolution with random instruction mutations searches whole ML algorithms (Setup/Predict/Learn programs), scored by accuracy on proxy tasks, with duplicate-fingerprint rejection.
one_line_zh: 用正则化进化与随机指令变异从基本数学运算搜索完整机器学习算法，以代理任务准确率为适应度并用功能等价指纹去重。

title_zh: GrIPS：面向大语言模型提示的无梯度、基于编辑的指令搜索
one_line: Greedy/beam local search applies random phrase-level edits (delete, swap, paraphrase, add) to task instructions, keeping the edit that raises balanced-accuracy-plus-entropy on a score set.
one_line_zh: 对任务指令随机施加短语级编辑（删除、交换、改写、添加），在打分集上按平衡准确率加熵贪心或束搜索保留最佳指令。

title_zh: GPS：面向高效小样本学习的遗传提示搜索
one_line: Genetic algorithm over hard prompts: generative models (back-translation, cloze, sentence continuation) reproduce top-K prompts, rescored by accuracy on a 32-example dev set.
one_line_zh: 对硬提示做遗传搜索：用回译、填空或句子续写模型繁殖得分前K的提示，并在32条开发样本上按准确率重新打分选择。

title_zh: 大语言模型是人类水平的提示工程师
one_line: APE: an LLM induces candidate instructions from demonstrations, adaptive multi-stage filtering scores them by execution accuracy, optional resampling near top candidates; the best instruction is kept.
one_line_zh: APE：LLM依据示例归纳候选指令，以多阶段自适应过滤按执行准确率打分，可在高分候选附近迭代重采样，保留最佳指令。

title_zh: 大语言模型作为优化器
one_line: OPRO: an optimizer LLM reads a meta-prompt of past instructions sorted by training accuracy and proposes new ones; scored candidates are added back, top-20 kept in the trajectory.
one_line_zh: OPRO：优化器LLM读取按训练准确率排序的历史指令元提示并生成新指令，评分后加入轨迹，保留前20条。

title_zh: EvoPrompt：将大语言模型与进化算法结合得到强大的提示优化器
one_line: An LLM executes GA crossover/mutation or DE difference-mutation over a prompt population; children scored on a dev set, top prompts retained, best reported on test.
one_line_zh: 让LLM在提示种群上执行遗传算法交叉变异或差分进化变异，按开发集得分保留优胜提示，最佳提示在测试集上报告。

title_zh: DSPy：将声明式语言模型调用编译为自我改进的流水线
one_line: DSPy compiles declarative LM pipelines: teleprompters simulate the program on training inputs, bootstrap metric-passing traces as per-module demonstrations, and keep the best compiled program.
one_line_zh: DSPy把声明式LM流水线编译优化：teleprompter在训练输入上运行程序，把通过指标的轨迹自举为各模块示例并保留最佳编译程序。

title_zh: Eureka：通过编程大语言模型实现人类水平的奖励设计
one_line: GPT-4 samples reward-function code from environment source, trains RL policies to score each, and mutates the best reward using textual reflection on per-component training statistics.
one_line_zh: GPT-4以环境源码为上下文批量生成奖励函数代码，经RL训练打分，再基于各奖励分量训练统计的文本反思变异最佳奖励。

title_zh: Plum：基于元启发式算法的提示学习
one_line: Plum plugs classic metaheuristics (hill climbing, annealing, GA, tabu, harmony search) over GrIPS-style phrase edits, scoring prompts by score-set accuracy; best prompt kept.
one_line_zh: Plum把爬山、模拟退火、遗传、禁忌、和声搜索等经典元启发式套在GrIPS式短语编辑上，按打分集准确率保留最佳提示。

title_zh: 释放大语言模型作为提示优化器的潜力：与基于梯度的模型优化器的类比分析
one_line: GPO: an LLM optimizer retrieves relevant past prompts with scores as update direction, generates new prompts under cosine-decayed edit distance, and keeps the best per step.
one_line_zh: GPO：LLM优化器检索相关历史提示及得分作为更新方向，在余弦衰减的编辑距离约束下生成新提示，每步保留最佳提示。

title_zh: 基于人类反馈的提示优化
one_line: APOHF: over an LLM-generated prompt pool, an NN fit to pairwise human preferences picks a greedy and a UCB prompt per round (dueling bandit); predicted-best prompt is reported.
one_line_zh: APOHF：在LLM生成的提示池上，用拟合成对人类偏好的神经网络按贪心与UCB每轮选一对提示（对决老虎机），报告预测最佳提示。

title_zh: 面向多阶段语言模型程序的指令与示例联合优化
one_line: MIPRO: grounded LM proposals of per-module instructions plus bootstrapped demos, combined via a TPE surrogate over minibatch end-to-end scores; MIPRO++ also learns proposal hyperparameters.
one_line_zh: MIPRO：以数据与程序摘要为依据由LM为各模块提出指令并自举示例，用TPE代理模型按小批量端到端得分组合；MIPRO++还学习提议超参数。

title_zh: 基于进化算法的高性价比代码生成自动提示工程
one_line: EPiC evolves per-problem code-generation prompts: LLM-elaborated initial population, fitness = pass rate on LLM-generated tests, fitness-proportional selection, elitism, LLM or similar-word mutation.
one_line_zh: EPiC针对每道题进化代码生成提示：LLM扩写初始种群，以LLM生成测试的通过率为适应度，按比例选择加精英保留，再用LLM或近义词变异。

title_zh: EvoFlow：即时进化多样化的智能体工作流
one_line: EvoFlow evolves a population of heterogeneous-LLM agentic workflows: tag-retrieved parents, LLM crossover plus LLM/prompt/operator mutation, niching selection on cost-performance Pareto dominance.
one_line_zh: EvoFlow进化异构LLM智能体工作流种群：按标签检索父代，LLM交叉及模型、提示、算子变异，在成本-性能帕累托支配下做小生境选择。

title_zh: 提示锦标赛：通过结构化辩论与Elo评分进化LLM指令
one_line: DEEVO evolves prompts without ground truth: pairwise multi-agent debates judge outputs, Elo ratings act as fitness, debate transcripts guide LLM crossover and mutation, Elo-based survival.
one_line_zh: DEEVO无需标注进化提示：以多智能体辩论两两评判输出，Elo评分作适应度，辩论记录指导LLM交叉与变异，按Elo选择存活。

title_zh: AlphaEvolve：用于科学与算法发现的编程智能体
one_line: AlphaEvolve: Gemini ensemble proposes diff edits to marked code blocks, sampled from a program database with rendered evaluation results; automated evaluators (with cascades) score children for evolutionary selection.
one_line_zh: AlphaEvolve：Gemini模型组合基于程序库采样及评测结果对标记代码块提出diff修改，由自动评测器（含级联）打分并进化选择。

title_zh: ShinkaEvolve：迈向开放式且样本高效的程序进化
one_line: ShinkaEvolve: island-archive LLM code evolution with exploration-aware parent sampling, embedding-plus-LLM novelty rejection, UCB bandit over mutation LLMs by parent-relative gain, and meta-scratchpad guidance.
one_line_zh: ShinkaEvolve：岛屿档案式LLM代码进化，含兼顾探索的父代采样、嵌入加LLM的新颖性拒绝采样、按相对父代增益的UCB选模型及元草稿指导。

title_zh: 用深度研究增强AlphaEvolve以发现科学算法
one_line: DeepEvolve adds web deep-research proposal writing, multi-file coding and debugging agents to an AlphaEvolve-style island/MAP-Elites database; evaluated algorithms are stored and sampled for next proposals.
one_line_zh: DeepEvolve在AlphaEvolve式岛屿/MAP-Elites数据库上加入联网深度研究写提案、跨文件编码与调试智能体，评测后的算法入库供后续采样。

title_zh: EvoTest：面向自我改进智能体系统的进化式测试时学习
one_line: EvoTest: between episodes of the same game, an Evolver LLM reads the transcript and mutates the whole agent configuration (prompt, success/failure memory, hyperparameters, tools); UCB picks parent or child.
one_line_zh: EvoTest：同一游戏的回合之间，进化者LLM读取轨迹并变异整个智能体配置（提示、成功/失败记忆、超参数、工具），用UCB在父代与子代间选择。

title_zh: DRO-InstructZero：面向大语言模型的分布鲁棒提示优化
one_line: DRO-InstructZero: Bayesian optimization over soft prompts that an open LLM decodes into instructions, with a robust acquisition maximizing worst-case expected accuracy over an f-divergence ambiguity set.
one_line_zh: DRO-InstructZero：对软提示做贝叶斯优化（由开源LLM解码为指令），以鲁棒采集函数最大化f散度模糊集内最坏情况期望准确率。

title_zh: DelvePO：方向引导的自进化灵活提示优化框架
one_line: DelvePO decomposes prompts into typed components and evolves them with LLM mutation/crossover guided by component memory (score-ordered before/after value pairs) and prompt memory; top-N kept on dev scores.
one_line_zh: DelvePO将提示拆为若干类型化组件，借组件记忆（按得分排序的变异前后取值对）和提示记忆引导LLM变异与交叉，按开发集得分保留前N。

title_zh: AccelOpt：面向AI加速器内核优化的自我改进LLM智能体系统
one_line: AccelOpt: beam search over Trainium kernels with planner/executor/summarizer agents using profiler feedback, plus a bounded optimization memory of positive and negative slow-fast kernel pairs with distilled strategies.
one_line_zh: AccelOpt：以规划、执行、总结智能体结合剖析反馈对Trainium内核做束搜索，并维护含正负慢-快内核对及提炼策略的有界优化记忆。

title_zh: 追求卓越：基于LLM的智能体自动优化
one_line: Applies the ARTEMIS platform: LLM semantic mutation/crossover over discovered agent components (prompts, tool descriptions, parameters), Bayesian combination search, and tiered cheap-to-full benchmark evaluation.
one_line_zh: 应用ARTEMIS平台：对自动发现的智能体组件（提示、工具描述、参数）做LLM语义变异与交叉，贝叶斯组合搜索，并分级从廉价评估到完整基准评测。

title_zh: RoboPhD：通过自主智能体进化实现自我改进的Text-to-SQL
one_line: RoboPhD: a Claude Code evolution agent analyzes failures and cross-pollinates top agents to write new database-analysis scripts and SQL instructions; ELO ratings over training databases select survivors.
one_line_zh: RoboPhD：Claude Code进化智能体分析失败并融合优胜智能体，生成新的数据库分析脚本与SQL生成指令，按训练库上的ELO评分选择存活者。

title_zh: PACEvolve：实现进度感知的一致性进化
one_line: PACEvolve governs LLM evolutionary search with a hierarchical idea/hypothesis memory (pruning plus permanent failure record), momentum-triggered backtracking on stalled relative progress, and adaptive cross-island crossover.
one_line_zh: PACEvolve用分层的想法/假设记忆（剪枝并永久记录失败）、按相对进展动量触发的回溯以及自适应跨岛交叉来调控LLM进化搜索。

title_zh: 迈向以执行为基础的自动化AI研究
one_line: Builds a parallel GPU executor that implements LLM research ideas as code diffs and scores them; a simple exploit/explore evolutionary ideation loop (vs RL on the ideator) uses those scores.
one_line_zh: 构建并行GPU执行器把LLM研究想法实现为代码补丁并打分；简单的利用/探索进化式构思循环（对比对构思模型做RL）以这些分数为反馈。

title_zh: PathWise：基于世界模型规划、由自进化LLM进行自动启发式设计
one_line: PathWise evolves combinatorial-optimization heuristics over an entailment graph memory: a policy agent picks parents and derivation directives, a world-model agent writes code rollouts, critics route contrastive reflections.
one_line_zh: PathWise在蕴含图记忆上进化组合优化启发式：策略智能体选择父代与推导指令，世界模型智能体生成代码，评论者提供对比式反思。

title_zh: ImprovEvolve：盆地跳跃与LLM引导的进化搜索相结合
one_line: ImprovEvolve evolves (via GigaEvo MAP-Elites) a class of initialization, improve, and perturb operators whose fitness is the result of a basin-hopping run, instead of a monolithic end-to-end optimizer.
one_line_zh: ImprovEvolve借助GigaEvo的MAP-Elites进化由初始化、局部改进与扰动算子组成的类，以盆地跳跃运行结果为适应度，取代整体式端到端优化程序。

title_zh: AutoHarness：通过自动合成代码外壳改进LLM智能体
one_line: Gemini-Flash refines per-game code harnesses (legal-action verifier or full policy) in a Thompson-sampling code tree, using environment illegal-move feedback and legal-move accuracy as node value.
one_line_zh: Gemini-Flash在汤普森采样的代码树中为每个游戏改进代码外壳（合法动作校验器或完整策略），以环境的非法动作反馈和合法率作节点价值。

title_zh: CORAL：迈向面向开放式发现的自主多智能体进化
one_line: CORAL replaces fixed evolutionary rules with long-running coding agents that decide retrieval, local testing and evaluation, sharing attempts, notes and skills via a file-system memory, with heartbeat reflection prompts.
one_line_zh: CORAL以长时运行的编码智能体取代固定进化规则，由其自主决定检索、本地测试与评测，通过文件系统共享尝试、笔记与技能，并以心跳提示反思。

title_zh: 面向深度研究的自优化多智能体系统
one_line: Applies GEPA- and TextGrad-style reflective prompt optimization to a multi-agent Deep Research system's agent prompts, selecting candidates on a dev split with rubric LLM-judge scores.
one_line_zh: 将GEPA和TextGrad式反思提示优化用于多智能体深度研究系统各智能体提示，用量规式LLM评审在开发集上选择候选。

title_zh: InferenceEvolve：通过自进化AI自动发现因果效应估计器
one_line: OpenEvolve/MAP-Elites evolves causal-effect estimator programs with LLM mutation, scored on training replicates (ground-truth or proxy objectives), evaluated on held-out replicates.
one_line_zh: 基于OpenEvolve与MAP-Elites用LLM变异进化因果效应估计器程序，在训练副本上以真值或代理目标评分，在留出副本上评测。

title_zh: RoboPhD：在紧评测预算下进化多样复杂智能体
one_line: Evolves agent code with Claude Code using validation-free Elo tournaments on fresh training samples, comparative error reports and self-instrumenting print diagnostics, versus GEPA and Autoresearch at 1,500 evaluations.
one_line_zh: 用Claude Code进化智能体代码，以无验证集的Elo锦标赛、对比错误报告和自插桩诊断驱动，在1500次评测预算下对比GEPA与Autoresearch。

title_zh: Autopoiesis：运行时动态下LLM服务的自进化系统范式
one_line: Continuously rewrites LLM-serving scheduling policy code via LLM-driven evolutionary program synthesis on snapshotted runtime traces, deploying superior policies to the live data plane.
one_line_zh: 在服务过程中基于运行时轨迹快照，用LLM驱动的进化程序合成持续重写调度策略代码，并将更优策略部署到数据面。

title_zh: SkillMOO：面向软件工程的智能体技能多目标优化
one_line: Evolves per-task coding-agent skill bundles via LLM-proposed edits and NSGA-II Pareto selection on test-suite pass rate and inference cost, retaining a Pareto archive.
one_line_zh: 用LLM提出的编辑和NSGA-II帕累托选择按通过率与推理成本进化每个任务的技能包，并保留帕累托存档。

title_zh: EDA工具的自主进化：多智能体自进化ABC
one_line: Planner plus three subsystem coding agents iteratively rewrite ABC's C code, gated by compilation and equivalence checking, retaining changes that improve QoR on benchmark suites.
one_line_zh: 规划智能体与三个子系统编码智能体迭代改写ABC的C代码，经编译与等价性检查把关，保留在基准上提升QoR的改动。

title_zh: EvoMaster：面向规模化智能体科学的基础进化智能体框架
one_line: General agent framework with nested Execution/Exploration/Evolution loops: evidence-based candidate selection within studies and distillation of skills, prompts and memories carried across studies.
one_line_zh: 通用智能体框架，含执行、探索、进化三层嵌套循环：研究内按证据选择候选，跨研究蒸馏并累积技能、提示和记忆。

title_zh: AgenticRecTune：带自进化技能库的多智能体推荐系统优化
one_line: Actor/Critic agents propose recommender configuration candidates from Pareto elites, online A/B tests score them, and Insight/Skill agents distill results into an evolving Skillhub.
one_line_zh: Actor与Critic智能体基于帕累托精英提出推荐系统配置候选，经线上A/B测试评估，Insight与Skill智能体将结果提炼进自进化技能库。

title_zh: LLM改进LLM：面向测试时扩展的智能体式发现
one_line: Claude Code iteratively edits test-time-scaling controller code in an offline replay environment, guided by execution-trace history and beta parameterization; best controller selected on AIME24.
one_line_zh: Claude Code在离线回放环境中迭代编辑测试时扩展控制器代码，以执行轨迹历史和beta参数化引导，在AIME24上选出最优控制器。

title_zh: 神经架构的智能体式发现：AIRA-Compose与AIRA-Design
one_line: LLM agents in AIRA-dojo greedy tree search propose primitive arrangements or new attention/training code, scored by isolated evaluators; top small-scale designs are aggregated and scaled up.
one_line_zh: LLM智能体在AIRA-dojo贪心树搜索中提出原语排列或新注意力与训练代码，由独立评测脚本打分，优秀小规模设计经聚合后放大评测。

title_zh: FORGE：通过种群广播实现无需权重更新的自进化智能体记忆
one_line: Parallel Reflexion instances turn failed CAGE-2 trajectories into rules/examples memory; after each stage the best checkpoint instance's memory is broadcast to all, converged instances graduate.
one_line_zh: 并行Reflexion实例将CAGE-2失败轨迹转为规则或示例记忆，每阶段后把检查点最优实例的记忆广播给全体，收敛实例毕业冻结。

title_zh: APEX：面向自进化LLM智能体的自主策略探索
one_line: Agent maintains a cross-episode DAG strategy map of milestones with bandit statistics; Fork Discovery adds unexplored milestones, Thompson-sampling Policy Selection and DAG return propagation guide exploration.
one_line_zh: 智能体跨回合维护里程碑DAG策略图及老虎机统计，分叉发现加入未探索里程碑，用汤普森采样选择策略并沿DAG回传回报。

title_zh: 当搜索成为记忆：用自进化技能加速机器人设计发现
one_line: Distills EvoGym morphology-search traces into a skill library of archetypes and gain-credited positive/negative rules that conditions LLM edits of elites alongside GA mutation; library transfers across scales.
one_line_zh: 将EvoGym形态搜索轨迹提炼为含原型及按增益记分的正负规则的技能库，引导LLM编辑精英个体并保留GA变异，技能库可跨尺度迁移。

title_zh: 自进化LLM的计算分配：从深度-广度到多臂老虎机
one_line: Studies depth-breadth allocation of a fixed LLM-call budget in LLM-guided evolutionary program search and proposes BaSE, a bandit routing calls across parallel trajectories by observed fitness.
one_line_zh: 研究LLM引导进化程序搜索中固定调用预算的深度与广度分配，并提出BaSE用多臂老虎机按观测适应度在并行轨迹间分配调用。

title_zh: 面向双组件耦合组合优化的LLM驱动协同进化自动启发式设计
one_line: Co-evolves two LLM-generated operator populations (e.g., route and packing) for TTP/TPP, scoring operator pairs jointly under the full objective with synergy scores and cross-component crossover.
one_line_zh: 为TTP/TPP协同进化两个LLM生成的算子种群（如路径与装包），在完整目标下联合评估算子对并记录协同分数，进行跨组件交叉。

title_zh: EvoDrive：基于自改进LLM智能体的安全关键自动驾驶帕累托进化
one_line: LLM actor proposes bounded edits to driving-scenario generators, critics and validators filter them, a self-updating world evaluator routes simulation budget, and a Pareto archive keeps attack-realism trade-offs.
one_line_zh: LLM执行者对驾驶场景生成器提出有界编辑，评论者与验证器过滤，自更新世界评估器分配仿真预算，帕累托存档保留攻击性与真实性权衡。

title_zh: MLEvolve：面向自动化机器学习算法发现的自进化框架
one_line: MLE agent searches ML pipeline code via progressive Monte Carlo graph search with cross-branch reference edges, entropy-scheduled exploitation, and a retrospective memory of task experience.
one_line_zh: MLE智能体以带跨分支参考边和熵调度利用的渐进式蒙特卡洛图搜索探索ML流水线代码，并用回顾式记忆积累任务经验。

title_zh: 自进化科学智能体设计具物理推理的白盒流体控制
one_line: EvE population of knowledge-carrying agents revises white-box swimmer controller code from CFD rollout evidence; agents are Elo-scored by a fixed simulator, frozen controllers tested on perturbed flows.
one_line_zh: 携带设计知识的EvE智能体种群依据CFD仿真证据修改白盒游动控制器代码，固定仿真器评分并对智能体做Elo更新，冻结控制器在扰动流场中测试。

title_zh: EEVEE：面向自改进智能体的真实世界测试时提示学习
one_line: Co-evolves an LLM router and slot-specific prompts on mixed-dataset streams via interleaved reflective mutation, keeping per-example Pareto-front prompt pools gated above the empty prompt.
one_line_zh: 在多数据集混合流上交替进行反思式变异，协同进化LLM路由器与各槽位提示，保留优于空提示的逐样本帕累托前沿提示池。

title_zh: REFLEX：基于LLM经验的反思式进化
one_line: Program evolution where a vision Critic diagnoses behavioral-evidence images, BM25 retrieves credited code snippets from a persistent Skill Memory, an Actor writes children; snippets credited by child-parent fitness change.
one_line_zh: 程序进化中视觉评论者诊断行为证据图像，以BM25从持久技能记忆检索代码片段，执行者生成子程序，片段按子代相对父代的适应度变化记分。

title_zh: 当规则学会学习：面向法律案例检索的自进化智能体
one_line: LLM agent creates query-rewriting rules for BM25 legal retrieval, plans rule-combination experiments scored by dev-set recall, and eliminates rules by self-consistency vote; best subset tested held-out.
one_line_zh: LLM智能体为BM25法律检索生成查询改写规则，规划规则组合实验并以开发集召回率评分，通过自洽投票淘汰规则，最优组合在留出集测试。

title_zh: AlphaMemo：面向自进化因子挖掘智能体的结构化搜索过程记忆
one_line: LLM alpha-factor search keeps an edit-level memory of AST-diff motifs credited by residual child-vs-expected quality, confidence-gated over a search-ledger prior, with high-confidence failure vetoes.
one_line_zh: LLM因子搜索维护基于AST差分编辑模式的记忆，按子代相对预期质量的残差记分，在搜索账本先验上做置信门控，并对高置信失败模式否决。

title_zh: A-Evolve-Training：30B模型的自主后训练
one_line: Memory-free agents explore post-training recipe axes from a fixed substrate; a meta agent rewrites the rolling search policy and dead-end registry from round evidence.
one_line_zh: 每轮从固定基底派生无记忆全栈智能体探索后训练配方，元智能体在冻结宪章约束下依据轮次证据改写滚动搜索策略和死路登记表。

title_zh: EvoRec：自进化智能体推荐系统
one_line: Research and Code agents iterate recommender model code each round, logging trajectories to persistent Memory, while a Skill Evolver periodically distills and refines a methodology Skill library from it.
one_line_zh: 研究与编码智能体每轮迭代推荐模型代码并将轨迹写入持久记忆，技能进化器定期从记忆中提炼并更新方法论技能库。

title_zh: TacEvo：基于LLM驱动质量-多样性搜索的机器人触觉感知自进化架构发现
one_line: LLM code-level mutation/crossover of tactile-perception CNNs inside a CVT MAP-Elites archive over diversity and efficiency descriptors, with low-fidelity validation-loss fitness and logged prompt archive.
one_line_zh: 在以架构多样性和效率比为描述子的CVT MAP-Elites存档中，用LLM对触觉感知网络代码做变异与交叉，以低保真验证损失为适应度并记录提示存档。

title_zh: 从失败到通过：为LLM代码生成进化自然语言提示优化规则
one_line: GEPA-style Pareto evolution of IF-THEN-EXCEPT task-description rewriting rules from categorized pass/fail feedback; selected rules serve as fallback after error-based repair in DualFix.
one_line_zh: 以GEPA式帕累托进化，依据分类的通过/失败反馈进化IF-THEN-EXCEPT题面改写规则，选定规则在DualFix中作为基于错误修复后的兜底。

title_zh: HarnessBank：带门控验证的语义基因库搜索用于智能体框架自进化
one_line: Evolver agent diagnoses task-agent failures and proposes harness patches; a semantic gene bank keyed by component and pathology keeps elites, admitted via validity, activation and paired-significance gates.
one_line_zh: 进化智能体诊断任务智能体失败并提出框架补丁，以修改部位与病因为键的语义基因库保留精英，候选须通过有效性、激活与配对显著性门控。

title_zh: DarwinX：通过自然选择进化智能体框架
one_line: Population search over agent harnesses (skills and code) with a preserve-and-extend admission contract, archive of complementary specialists merged across lineages, and failure/teacher/self-derived edit signals.
one_line_zh: 在智能体框架（技能与代码）种群上搜索，以保留并扩展的准入契约接纳变体，存档互补专精体并跨谱系合并，编辑信号来自失败、教师与自身对比。

title_zh: SoL-Pi：递归扩展自动研究循环以获得高效智能体框架
one_line: Broad-to-deep auto-research loops propose harness mechanisms from trace analysis, retained only if capability stays within fixed tolerances and efficiency improves; four mechanisms combined, validated on isolated benchmarks.
one_line_zh: 广到深的自动研究循环依据轨迹分析提出框架机制，仅在能力保持于固定容差内且效率提升时保留，四个机制组合后在隔离基准上验证。

title_zh: AutoRef：面向智能体多参考图像生成的框架优化
one_line: Coding agent rewrites image-generation harness code from training-task feedback, while a separate validation split, hidden from the proposer, selects a beam of top harnesses as next parents.
one_line_zh: 编码智能体依据训练任务反馈改写图像生成框架代码，另设对提议者隐藏的验证集选出排名靠前的框架束作为下一轮父代。

title_zh: 将语言智能体视为可优化的图
one_line: Represents agents as computational graphs and optimizes node prompts and inter-agent edge probabilities (REINFORCE) from task utility, retaining the learned edge distribution.
one_line_zh: 把智能体表示为计算图，依据任务效用优化节点提示与智能体间连边概率（REINFORCE），保留学到的连边分布。

title_zh: EvoAgent：通过进化算法自动生成多智能体
one_line: Per query, LLM-simulated crossover/mutation rewrites an initial agent's role/skill settings into new specialist agents, selected by an LLM quality check, and merges their answers.
one_line_zh: 对每个查询，用LLM模拟交叉/变异改写初始智能体的角色与技能设定生成新专家，经LLM质检筛选后融合其答案。

title_zh: 智能体系统的自动化设计
one_line: A meta agent programs new agents in code conditioned on an ever-growing archive of validation-scored designs; best designs are frozen and tested held-out and transferred.
one_line_zh: 元智能体基于不断增长、带验证分数的设计档案用代码编写新智能体，最佳设计冻结后在留出集测试并跨域迁移。

title_zh: AgentSquare：模块化设计空间中的LLM智能体自动搜索
one_line: Searches combinations of standardized planning/reasoning/tool/memory modules via LLM recombination and module evolution, filtering candidates with an in-context performance predictor before execution.
one_line_zh: 在规划/推理/工具/记忆标准化模块空间中通过LLM重组与模块进化搜索智能体，并用上下文代理预测器在执行前过滤候选。

title_zh: AFlow：自动化智能体工作流生成
one_line: MCTS over code-represented workflows: an LLM optimizer edits prompts/operators using a tree of recorded modifications and their validation-measured effects; best workflow evaluated on test.
one_line_zh: 在代码表示的工作流上做MCTS：LLM优化器依据记录各修改及其验证集效果的经验树编辑提示与算子，最佳工作流在测试集评估。

title_zh: 多智能体设计：用更好的提示与拓扑优化智能体
one_line: Three-stage MAS search: block-level prompt optimization, then topology search over a pruned influential space, then workflow-level prompt retuning, all validated then tested held-out.
one_line_zh: 三阶段多智能体搜索：先块级提示优化，再在剪枝后的有效拓扑空间搜索，最后全局提示重调，验证集选择后在留出测试集评估。

title_zh: AgentNet：基于LLM的多智能体系统的去中心化进化协调
one_line: Decentralized agents keep RAG memories of successful trajectory fragments and a success-weighted edge matrix pruned by threshold, evolving routing and specialization over a training stream.
one_line_zh: 去中心化智能体保存成功轨迹片段的检索记忆，并按成功率加权更新、阈值剪枝连边，在训练任务流中进化路由与专长。

title_zh: MAS-ZERO：零监督设计多智能体系统
one_line: Per problem at inference, a meta-agent iteratively designs, critiques (solvability/completeness) and refines MAS code, then selects among evolved and simple building-block answers.
one_line_zh: 推理时对每个问题，元智能体依据可解性与完备性反馈迭代设计并改进多智能体代码，最后在进化方案与简单基础方案答案中择优。

title_zh: SEW：面向自动代码生成的自进化智能体工作流
one_line: LLM mutation prompts (direct or hyper-evolved) rewrite text-encoded coding workflows and then each agent's prompt; compares five workflow representation schemes by parse/execution rates.
one_line_zh: 用LLM变异提示（直接或超进化）改写文本编码的代码生成工作流及各智能体提示，并按可解析/可执行率比较五种工作流表示方案。

title_zh: MermaidFlow：通过安全约束进化编程重新定义智能体工作流生成
one_line: Encodes workflows as statically typed Mermaid graphs and evolves them with type-preserving mutation/crossover operators, translating survivors to Python, to keep candidates executable.
one_line_zh: 将工作流编码为静态类型的Mermaid图，用保持类型的变异/交叉算子进化并翻译为Python，使候选始终可执行。

title_zh: EvoAgentX：用于进化智能体工作流的自动化框架
one_line: Open-source platform wrapping existing optimizers (TextGrad, MIPRO, AFlow, SEW) to refine agent prompts and workflow graphs from task-metric feedback on standard benchmarks and GAIA.
one_line_zh: 开源平台，封装TextGrad、MIPRO、AFlow、SEW等已有优化器，依据任务指标反馈改进智能体提示与工作流图。

title_zh: MetaAgent：基于有限状态机自动构建多智能体系统
one_line: From a task description an LLM designs agents and an FSM of states/transition conditions, then merges states an LLM judges role-redundant; the frozen FSM is deployed per task type.
one_line_zh: LLM依据任务描述设计智能体与带转移条件的有限状态机，再由LLM判定角色冗余的状态进行合并，冻结后按任务类型部署。

title_zh: JudgeFlow：基于块级评判的智能体工作流优化
one_line: Workflows built from logic blocks; an LLM judge rank-blames blocks on failed traces, the optimizer edits the most-blamed block, and top-scoring workflows are kept in a pool.
one_line_zh: 工作流由逻辑块组成；LLM评判对失败轨迹中的块排名归责，优化器修改最受归责的块，并按得分保留前若干工作流。

title_zh: AgenticRed：为红队测试进化智能体系统
one_line: A meta agent programs red-teaming systems from an archive; per generation only the highest-ASR offspring on a small subset is kept, with failed/successful prompt memories passed down.
one_line_zh: 元智能体基于档案编写红队系统，每代仅保留小子集上攻击成功率最高的后代，并向后代传递失败与成功提示记忆。

title_zh: MetaGen：面向多智能体LLM推理的自进化角色与拓扑
one_line: At inference, an Architect generates/rewrites query-conditioned roles and edits a DAG; reward-weighted priors and a cache of roles from passing runs persist across instances.
one_line_zh: 推理时由架构师智能体生成/改写查询相关角色并编辑DAG；跨实例保留奖励加权的选择先验以及来自通过执行的角色缓存。

title_zh: SEMAG：自进化多智能体代码生成
one_line: Per coding task, escalates from direct generation to planning, trace debugging, then multi-agent discussion on test failure; web-search agents vote to switch the backbone model.
one_line_zh: 对每个编程任务在测试失败时由直接生成逐级升级到规划、轨迹调试和多智能体讨论；联网检索智能体投票切换骨干模型。

title_zh: Mimosa框架：面向科学研究的进化多智能体系统
one_line: Per scientific task, a meta-orchestrator synthesizes a multi-agent workflow and hill-climbs single edits (prompt, agent, edge) accepted when an LLM judge's score improves.
one_line_zh: 对每个科研任务，元编排器生成多智能体工作流，并以单步编辑（提示、智能体、连边）爬山，LLM评审分数提升才接受。

title_zh: 以经验为指南针：编排与智能体提示共同进化的多智能体RAG
one_line: Orchestrator samples agent sequences, ranks them by F1 then tokens, distills insights into a utility-scored experience library; blamed agents get prompt evolution, persistent failures trigger topology mutation.
one_line_zh: 编排器采样智能体序列，按F1与token排序并提炼洞见存入带效用分的经验库；被归责智能体做提示进化，持续失败时触发拓扑变异。

title_zh: EvolveRouter：面向多智能体问答的路由与提示协同进化
one_line: Alternates training a KG-GNN router over 24 agents with rewriting prompts of low-F1, high-weight agents, accepting rewrites via a validation gate and reverting regressing router updates.
one_line_zh: 交替训练基于知识图的GNN路由器与改写低F1高权重智能体的提示，改写须过验证门，路由更新退化则回滚。

title_zh: SkillGraph：基于多模态图拓扑的自进化多智能体协作
one_line: A trained multimodal graph transformer predicts query-conditioned agent edges while a Skill Designer rewrites/creates skills from failure buffers; updated skill embeddings feed back into the topology predictor.
one_line_zh: 训练的多模态图Transformer预测查询相关的智能体连边，技能设计器依据失败缓冲改写或新建技能，更新的技能嵌入回馈拓扑预测器。

title_zh: 协同进化智能体架构与可解释推理以实现自动化优化
one_line: OR-agent workflows become AOE graphs; a fitness-weighted architecture graph is grown and pruned while a population of reasoning trajectories evolves by path recombination and semantic mutation.
one_line_zh: 将运筹智能体工作流表示为AOE图，维护按适应度加权、可增删的架构图，并通过路径重组与语义变异进化推理轨迹种群。

title_zh: TacoMAS：LLM多智能体系统拓扑与能力的测试时协同进化
one_line: Within each query, a fast loop refines agent prompts/memory from meta-judge contribution scores and a slow meta-LLM loop applies budgeted agent birth-death and edge edits.
one_line_zh: 在每个查询内，快循环依据元评审贡献分改进智能体提示与记忆，慢循环由元LLM执行有预算限制的智能体增删与连边编辑。

title_zh: EVOCHAMBER：个体、团队与种群三尺度的多智能体系统测试时协同进化
one_line: Over a task stream, agents keep niche experience and reward-tracked competence; failed teams distill insights routed to weak agents, leaders learn structures, and lifecycle ops fork/merge/prune agents.
one_line_zh: 在任务流中智能体保存分领域经验与基于奖励的能力估计；团队失败时提炼洞见传给弱智能体，组长在线学习协作结构，生命周期算子分叉/合并/剪除智能体。

title_zh: 带护栏的角色：多智能体结构化推理中保持契约的角色进化
one_line: A trained bandit controller proposes add/remove edits to a typed role-card pool; edits commit only if five structural contracts hold and the task score improves over the unedited pool.
one_line_zh: 训练的上下文老虎机控制器对类型化角色卡池提出增删编辑，仅当满足五项结构契约且任务分数优于未编辑池时才提交。

title_zh: 以团队方式进化：基于LLM的多智能体系统协作式自进化
one_line: After each evolution task, agents keep local contexts and discuss post hoc to update agent scaffolds, teammate profiles, and team roster/constitution; frozen artifacts are tested held-out.
one_line_zh: 每个进化任务后，智能体保留本地上下文并事后协作讨论，更新个体脚手架、队友画像以及团队编制与章程，冻结后在留出集测试。

title_zh: DataEvolver：通过多层自进化实现大语言模型的自动数据准备
one_line: Builds data-preparation pipelines as operator DAGs: repairs plans and synthesizes missing operators, then refines code from an LLM judge comparing trial outputs to 20 seed examples.
one_line_zh: 将数据准备流程构建为算子DAG：修复逻辑计划并合成缺失算子，再依据LLM评审对比试运行输出与20条种子样例来改进代码。
