title_zh: POWERPLAY：通过持续搜索最简单的尚不可解问题来训练日益通用的问题求解器
one_line: Searches task/solver-modification pairs where the old solver fails the new task; accepts a modification only if it provably solves all prior tasks plus the new one.
one_line_zh: 搜索旧求解器无法解决的新任务及求解器修改，仅当新求解器可证明解决全部旧任务和新任务时才接受修改。

title_zh: 成对开放式开拓者（POET）：无止境地生成日益复杂多样的学习环境及其解
one_line: Mutates a population of walker environments, admits children passing a not-too-hard/not-too-easy criterion with novelty priority, co-optimizes paired agents and transfers agents across environments.
one_line_zh: 变异环境种群，按难度适中准则与新颖性接纳子环境，同时优化配对智能体并在环境间迁移。

title_zh: 基于无监督环境设计的涌现复杂性与零样本迁移
one_line: An environment adversary is trained to maximize protagonist–antagonist regret, producing solvable frontier environments; the protagonist trains on them and is tested zero-shot on unseen mazes.
one_line_zh: 训练环境对手最大化主角与对手智能体的遗憾，生成可解的前沿环境，主角在其上训练并零样本迁移到新迷宫。

title_zh: WizardLM：赋能大型预训练语言模型遵循复杂指令
one_line: An LLM iteratively rewrites seed instructions into harder or broader variants via fixed evolving prompts, filters failures with ChatGPT and heuristics, and fine-tunes LLaMA on the merged pool.
one_line_zh: 用固定进化提示让LLM逐轮把种子指令改写得更难或更广，经ChatGPT与规则过滤失败样本后合并微调LLaMA。

title_zh: Confucius：基于易到难课程与内省反馈的迭代式工具学习
one_line: Fine-tunes LLaMA on tool-use data through staged curriculum, then iteratively regenerates data via ChatGPT self-instruct seeded by the model's high-perplexity instances.
one_line_zh: 先按分阶段课程微调工具使用模型，再以模型高困惑度样本为种子用ChatGPT自指令迭代扩充训练集。

title_zh: WebRL：通过自我进化的在线课程强化学习训练LLM网页智能体
one_line: Each phase rewrites the agent's failed WebArena instructions into new tasks, filters by critic-score band and GPT-4o feasibility, and trains with KL-constrained RL under a learned outcome reward model.
one_line_zh: 每阶段以失败指令为种子生成新网页任务，按价值评分区间与GPT-4o可行性过滤，用学习的结果奖励模型做KL约束强化学习。

title_zh: LADDER：通过递归问题分解实现LLM自我改进
one_line: The model recursively generates simpler variant trees of training integrals, verified numerically, and is trained with GRPO on them; TTRL repeats this on test-problem variants.
one_line_zh: 模型为训练积分题递归生成更简单的变体树，以数值积分验证并用GRPO训练；TTRL在测试题变体上重复此过程。

title_zh: 绝对零：零数据的强化自博弈推理
one_line: One LLM proposes code reasoning tasks rewarded for solver learnability and solves them, with a code executor validating tasks and verifying answers; no external data.
one_line_zh: 同一LLM提出按可学性奖励的代码推理任务并求解，由代码执行器验证任务与答案，不用外部数据。

title_zh: 面向LLM推理的自我进化课程
one_line: A non-stationary bandit over problem categories, rewarded by batch absolute advantage and updated by TD(0), chooses which categories each RL fine-tuning batch draws from.
one_line_zh: 以批次绝对优势为奖励、TD(0)更新的非平稳多臂老虎机，在RL微调中逐步选择问题类别构成训练批。

title_zh: TaskCraft：智能体任务的自动生成
one_line: Generates tool-necessity-verified atomic agentic tasks from documents, composes them by depth/width extension checked by a judge LLM, and bootstraps generator prompts from accepted tasks.
one_line_zh: 从文档生成经工具必要性验证的原子智能体任务，按深度/宽度扩展组合并由判别LLM校验，再用通过的任务自举优化生成提示。

title_zh: SyncLoop：面向自我改进数学推理的多模态双循环框架
one_line: Each iteration synthesizes harder geometry problems (auxiliary-line diagrams plus composed sub-problems, answers by DeepSeek-R1 consensus), keeps samples the current model often fails, then runs SFT+RL.
one_line_zh: 每轮生成带辅助线图与组合子问题的更难几何题（答案由DeepSeek-R1一致性给出），保留当前模型高错误率样本后做SFT+RL。

title_zh: 自我提问的语言模型
one_line: Asymmetric self-play: a proposer generates topic problems rewarded for being neither too easy nor too hard, a solver is rewarded by majority vote or proposer-written unit tests.
one_line_zh: 非对称自博弈：提问者生成难度适中的题目获奖励，求解者以多数投票或提问者生成的单元测试为奖励。

title_zh: SEAgent：从经验中自主学习的自我进化计算机使用智能体
one_line: An LLM curriculum generator updates a software guidebook from judged trajectories and proposes harder tasks each phase; a learned world-state judge gives step rewards for RL of the GUI agent.
one_line_zh: 课程生成器依据评判后的轨迹更新软件指南并逐阶段提出更难任务，学习型世界状态模型给出步级奖励训练GUI智能体。

title_zh: R-Zero：从零数据自我进化的推理LLM
one_line: A Challenger is RL-trained to generate math questions maximizing Solver uncertainty; band-filtered questions with majority-vote pseudo-labels train the Solver, alternating each iteration.
one_line_zh: 挑战者经RL训练生成令求解者最不确定的数学题，按一致性区间过滤并以多数投票伪标签训练求解者，逐轮交替。

title_zh: Middo：基于闭环学习、由模型驱动的动态数据优化以增强LLM微调
one_line: Each SFT round, the fine-tuned model's loss, embedding sparsity and self-alignment scores flag samples that GPT-4o-mini simplifies, augments or rewrites, keeping dataset size fixed.
one_line_zh: 每轮微调后用模型自身损失、嵌入稀疏度与自评分标出样本，由GPT-4o-mini简化、扩充或改写，保持数据规模不变。

title_zh: SPELL：用于进化长上下文语言模型的自博弈强化学习
one_line: One policy plays questioner, responder and verifier over raw documents; questions get a Gaussian frontier reward, a history memory escalates difficulty, rewards combine exact match and self-verifier votes.
one_line_zh: 单一策略在原始文档上扮演提问、回答、验证三角色；提问按高斯前沿奖励，历史记忆提升难度，奖励结合精确匹配与自验证投票。

title_zh: Socratic-Zero：通过无数据智能体协同进化引导推理
one_line: A fixed teacher LLM verifies solver attempts and rewrites failed problems into new ones each iteration; a generator distills this refinement weighted by solver-frontier utility; the solver trains with DPO.
one_line_zh: 固定教师LLM验证求解者答案并将失败题改写成新题，生成器按前沿效用加权蒸馏该改写策略，求解者以DPO训练。

title_zh: 搜索自博弈：无监督推进智能体能力前沿
one_line: One search agent proposes deep-search questions for given answers, verified by RAG over its own retrieved documents, and solves them; proposer rewarded by solver failure, both trained by RL.
one_line_zh: 同一搜索智能体针对给定答案提出深度搜索问题，用其检索文档做RAG验证后再求解；提问者以求解失败为奖励，双方RL训练。

title_zh: 多智能体进化：LLM通过协同进化实现自我改进
one_line: One LLM plays Proposer, Solver and Judge; questions get judge-quality plus solver-failure difficulty rewards and enter a pool if judged qualified; all roles are RL-updated jointly.
one_line_zh: 同一LLM扮演提问者、求解者与评判者；问题依评判质量分和求解失败难度获奖励，合格者入池，三角色联合RL更新。

title_zh: SPICE：在语料环境中自博弈提升推理能力
one_line: One model as Challenger mines corpus documents into questions with document-extracted answers, rewarded for Reasoner pass-rate variance; the Reasoner answers without the document under rule-based verification.
one_line_zh: 模型作为挑战者从语料文档生成带文档答案的问题，以推理者通过率方差为奖励；推理者不看文档作答并按规则验证。

title_zh: 通过经验合成扩展智能体学习
one_line: A trained reasoning experience model simulates environment transitions and rewards for agent RL, and each iteration generates variations of seed tasks with high reward entropy as a curriculum.
one_line_zh: 训练的推理式经验模型模拟环境状态转移与奖励供智能体RL，并每轮对高奖励熵的种子任务生成变体作为课程。

title_zh: RLVE：用自适应可验证环境扩展语言模型强化学习
one_line: 400 hand-engineered procedural environments with algorithmic verifiers each raise their difficulty window once the policy's accuracy at the current top level passes a threshold during RL.
one_line_zh: 400个人工构建、带算法验证器的程序化环境，在RL中当策略于当前最高难度准确率超阈值时各自上调难度窗口。

title_zh: AgentEvolver：迈向高效的自我进化智能体系统
one_line: An LLM explores tool environments guided by profiles to synthesize training tasks judged by an LLM, reuses past experiences to guide rollouts, and assigns LLM-attributed step rewards for GRPO.
one_line_zh: LLM按环境画像探索工具环境合成训练任务并由LLM评判，复用历史经验引导采样，并以LLM归因的步级奖励做GRPO。

title_zh: Agent0：通过工具集成推理从零数据释放自进化智能体
one_line: Curriculum agent RL-trained on executor uncertainty and tool-use rewards proposes tasks; executor trains on band-filtered tasks with majority-vote pseudo-labels, iterated.
one_line_zh: 课程智能体以执行者不确定性和工具调用为奖励生成任务，执行者用多数投票伪标签在筛选任务上训练，迭代共进化。

title_zh: 最少人类监督下的引导式自进化大语言模型
one_line: Challenger generates questions grounded by few-shot human anchor examples and similarity reward; solver trains on mid-success-rate synthetic plus human items each iteration.
one_line_zh: 挑战者以少量人类锚点示例和相似度奖励引导出题，求解者每轮按成功率选中等难度的合成与人类题训练。

title_zh: 迈向超级智能软件智能体：自博弈SWE-RL
one_line: One policy injects execution-validated bugs into real repositories and repairs them, turning failed repairs into higher-order bugs; injector rewarded by consistency and solve rate.
one_line_zh: 同一策略在真实代码库中注入经执行验证的bug并修复，失败修复转为高阶bug，注入者按一致性与解决率获奖励。

title_zh: GenEnv：LLM智能体与环境模拟器之间难度对齐的共进化
one_line: LLM environment simulator, trained by reward-weighted regression on an alpha success-band reward, generates task variations each epoch for a GRPO-trained agent.
one_line_zh: LLM环境模拟器以目标成功率带奖励做加权回归训练，每轮为GRPO训练的智能体生成任务变体。

title_zh: Dr. Zero：无需训练数据的自进化搜索智能体
one_line: Search-equipped proposer, trained with hop-grouped RL on solver pass-rate reward, generates multi-hop QA each iteration for a GRPO-trained solver, without curated data.
one_line_zh: 带搜索的出题者以求解者通过率为奖励、用按跳数分组的RL训练，每轮生成多跳问答供求解者训练，无需人工数据。

title_zh: TTCS：面向自进化的测试时课程合成
one_line: At test time a co-trained synthesizer generates structure-preserving variants of test questions near solver frontier; solver trains on them with majority-vote rewards.
one_line_zh: 测试时由共训练合成器围绕测试题生成保留推理结构、贴近能力边界的变体，求解者用多数投票奖励在其上训练。

title_zh: CPMöbius：面向无数据强化学习的迭代式教练-选手推理
one_line: Coach generates band-filtered math tasks and is rewarded by the Player's accuracy gain on a fixed held-out validation set; Player trains on majority-vote labels.
one_line_zh: 教练生成经难度过滤的数学题，并以选手在固定留出验证集上的准确率提升为奖励；选手用多数投票标签训练。

title_zh: Tool-R0：从零数据自进化的工具学习LLM智能体
one_line: Generator RL-trained with format, rule-based validity and solver-success band rewards synthesizes tool-calling tasks each iteration; solver trains on cross-verified, difficulty-ordered sets.
one_line_zh: 生成器以格式、规则有效性与求解成功率带奖励训练，每轮合成工具调用任务；求解者在交叉验证、按难度排序的数据上训练。

title_zh: 只有当自合成管线保证可学习信息增益时自博弈才会进化
one_line: Position paper: argues proposer-solver-verifier self-play needs growing learnable information (epiplexity); diagnostic coding self-play experiments, no implemented improvement loop evaluated.
one_line_zh: 立场论文：主张提议-求解-验证自博弈需保证可学习信息（epiplexity）递增，仅做编码自博弈诊断实验，未评测实际改进闭环。

title_zh: MM-Zero：从零数据自进化的多模型视觉语言模型
one_line: Proposer writes captions and questions, coder renders them as executable SVG, solver trains with majority-vote rewards; proposer rewarded on rendering, easy-question solvability and difficulty.
one_line_zh: 出题者写描述与问题，编码者生成可执行SVG渲染图像，求解者用多数投票奖励训练；出题者按渲染、易题可解与难度获奖励。

title_zh: SAGE：面向LLM推理的多智能体自进化
one_line: Challenger, Planner, Solver, Critic share one backbone; challenger generates seeded tasks with verifiers, rewarded by solver verified failure and critic quality, filtered before training.
one_line_zh: 挑战者、规划者、求解者、评审共享骨干；挑战者基于种子生成带验证器的任务，按求解失败率与评审质量获奖励并经过滤后训练。

title_zh: GASP：面向代码LLM的引导式非对称自博弈
one_line: Teacher turns unsolved real goalpost coding problems into easier lemma then harder lift variants, accepted by student pass-rate band and execution checks; student trains on them.
one_line_zh: 教师把未解决的真实目标编程题改写为更易的引理题再生成更难的提升题，经通过率带与执行检查后供学生训练。

title_zh: 通过任务-能力共进化发现新型LLM专家
one_line: Coevolves an archive of merged LLMs (quality-diversity selection) with scientist-generated tasks carrying Python scoring functions, adapted up or down from population pass rates.
one_line_zh: 共进化合并LLM档案（质量-多样性选择）与科学家LLM生成、带Python评分函数的任务，按群体通过率调高或调低难度。

title_zh: CoEvolve：通过智能体-数据相互进化训练LLM智能体
one_line: Forgetting, boundary and rare-action signals from RL rollouts guide LLM environment re-exploration; abstracted tasks are execution-validated and appended to the evolving training set.
one_line_zh: 从RL轨迹提取遗忘、边界与稀有行为信号，引导LLM重新探索环境，抽象出的任务经环境执行验证后加入训练集。

title_zh: Agent-World：规模化真实世界环境合成以进化通用智能体
one_line: Mines real-world databases and unit-tested tools into environments, synthesizes execution-verified tasks; a diagnostic arena finds capability gaps each round and drives targeted environment-task expansion.
one_line_zh: 挖掘真实数据库与经单元测试的工具构建环境并合成执行可验证任务，诊断竞技场每轮识别能力缺口并驱动定向扩展。

title_zh: 从上下文到技能：语言模型能否熟练地从上下文中学习？
one_line: Challenger and Reasoner co-evolve Markdown skill sets: LLM-judged failures drive Reasoner skill rewrites, easy successes harden Challenger; cross-time replay selects the most balanced skill set.
one_line_zh: 挑战者与推理者共进化Markdown技能集：LLM评判的失败驱动推理者技能重写，易解案例强化挑战者，跨时回放选出最均衡技能集。

title_zh: ASH：在长时程世界中自我磨砺的智能体
one_line: When stuck (no new key moment), agent retrains its inverse dynamics model on own trajectories, retrieves similar internet video, pseudo-labels it, and retrains policy plus key-moment memory.
one_line_zh: 卡住时用自身轨迹更新逆动力学模型，检索相似网络视频并伪标注动作，再训练策略并更新关键时刻长期记忆。

title_zh: 学会构建环境：通过可验证环境合成实现自进化推理强化学习
one_line: Single policy writes Python reasoning environments with frozen oracle/scorer; admitted after layered validation, self-review, solver pass-rate band and novelty checks, then trains solver on them.
one_line_zh: 单一策略编写带冻结oracle与评分器的Python推理环境，经分层验证、自审、通过率带与新颖性检查后入池供求解训练。

title_zh: ANDES：面向自主指令对齐的智能体原生数据进化合成工具
one_line: Data-synthesis skill for a post-training agent: self-expanding topic World Tree routing, LLM QA generation and refinement, and diversity reports that steer the agent's next synthesis call.
one_line_zh: 供后训练智能体调用的数据合成技能：自扩展主题世界树路由、LLM问答生成与精修，并以多样性报告引导下一次合成调用。

title_zh: Socratic-SWE：基于轨迹衍生智能体技能的自进化编程智能体
one_line: Distills solver traces into a skill registry that guides generation of repository repair tasks; tasks pass execution validation and are rewarded by gradient alignment with held-out validation.
one_line_zh: 将求解轨迹提炼为技能库以引导生成真实仓库修复任务，任务经执行验证，并按与留出验证集梯度的对齐度奖励。

title_zh: 技能自博弈：以共进化技能推动LLM能力前沿
one_line: Proposer generates tasks conditioned on routed skill packages with executable validators; reward gated by validity times frontier difficulty; controller refines, prunes and induces skills from feedback.
one_line_zh: 出题者基于路由技能包（含可执行验证器）生成任务，奖励为有效性门控乘难度；控制器依据反馈精修、剪除并归纳新技能。

title_zh: 面向长时程终端任务的递归合成
one_line: Recursively extends verified terminal tasks' reference solutions, realigns verifier and instruction, validates in fresh sandbox, and reuses accepted tasks as next-round seeds for SFT/RL data.
one_line_zh: 递归扩展已验证终端任务的参考解，重新对齐验证器与指令并在新沙箱验证，通过的任务作为下一轮种子并用于SFT/RL训练。

title_zh: EnvHarness：唤醒静态世界以促进智能体学习
one_line: EnvRigger diagnoses policy trajectories and writes Stage/Contract/Chain wrappers around static environments, keeping original verifiers, accepting only those validated by fresh rollouts; skills or RL follow.
one_line_zh: EnvRigger诊断策略轨迹，为静态环境编写Stage/Contract/Chain包装组件并保留原验证器，经新rollout验证后接受，再用于技能提取或RL。

title_zh: GEPA：反思式提示进化可以胜过强化学习
one_line: Evolves module prompts of a compound AI system via LLM reflection on execution/evaluation traces, keeping a per-instance Pareto frontier of candidates selected on validation.
one_line_zh: 用LLM反思执行与评测轨迹来变异复合系统各模块提示，按逐实例帕累托前沿保留候选并在验证集上选择。

title_zh: RRSI：智能体框架（harness）的正则化递归自我改进
one_line: Evolves agent harness code from evolve-set feedback under regularized proposal (annealed edit budget, credit history) and selection (leakage critic, noise floor, cost gate, pruning).
one_line_zh: 基于评测反馈演化智能体harness，用编辑预算、泄漏审查、噪声阈值、成本约束与剪枝来正则化提议与保留。

title_zh: Harness^2：面向开放世界的递归式智能体框架构建
one_line: Refines each task's execution harness via contrastive propose-probe-compose without verifiers, and keeps adopted harnesses plus lessons in a library that guides future harness edits.
one_line_zh: 无验证器下用对比式提议-探测-组合改进当前任务harness，并把采纳的harness与经验存入库以指导后续改进。

title_zh: Evo-Harness：面向自进化智能体的上下文到harness技能编译
one_line: A frozen agent reflects on failed executions in a task stream and an evolver compiles the lessons into general and topic-level skill entries of an external harness.
one_line_zh: 冻结智能体在任务流中反思失败执行，由演化器把经验编译为通用与主题级技能，持续更新外部harness。

title_zh: 智能体式上下文工程：为自我改进的语言模型演化上下文
one_line: Generator-Reflector-Curator turn execution feedback into itemized delta bullets merged into an evolving playbook context, with de-duplication, offline (system prompt) or online (memory).
one_line_zh: 生成-反思-整理三角色把执行反馈提炼为条目式增量，合并进不断演化的上下文手册，并去重维护。

title_zh: 达尔文哥德尔机：自我改进智能体的开放式进化
one_line: Coding agents edit their own codebase from benchmark logs; children that keep editing ability join an open-ended archive, parents sampled by score and novelty.
one_line_zh: 编码智能体依据评测日志修改自身代码，保留可编辑的子代进入开放式档案库，按得分与探索度选父代。

title_zh: Self-Harness：自我改进的智能体框架
one_line: The fixed agent model clusters its verifier-grounded failures, proposes minimal edits to its own harness definition, and promotes edits that pass a held-in/held-out non-regression gate.
one_line_zh: 固定模型聚类自身失败轨迹，提出最小化harness修改，仅当在内外两划分上不退化时才晋升修改。

title_zh: HarnessEvolve：从参考轨迹学习以实现可靠的智能体自我进化
one_line: Aligns failed runs against answer-conditioned reference trajectories, clusters root-cause errors into harness edits, and keeps edits passing a leakage/bloat gate and a no-regression batch gate.
one_line_zh: 将失败轨迹与给定答案生成的参考轨迹对齐找根因并聚类，生成harness修改，经泄漏/膨胀与不退化双门控后保留。

title_zh: 超智能体（Hyperagents）
one_line: A single editable program holding task agent and meta agent rewrites both, including its own modification procedure; variants are archived DGM-style and scored on task performance.
one_line_zh: 任务智能体与元智能体合为一个可编辑程序，可改写包括自身改进过程在内的代码，变体按DGM方式存档择优。

title_zh: HELIX：面向递归自我改进的模型-框架协同进化
one_line: Decomposes agent harnesses into typed, source-traceable components, enumerates a 65-recipe portfolio for a fixed model, and exports verified sibling trajectories as training records for a future model update.
one_line_zh: 把harness拆成可追溯的类型化组件，为固定模型枚举65个组合，并把验证过的同题轨迹导出为后续模型训练数据。
